3.8.10.s: suvāṅ nabhrāḍ aṅghāre bambhārā ity ete vai devānāṃ somarakṣaya etebhyo vā adhi chandāṃsi somam āharaṃs te somapīthena vyārdhyata ta etāni dvitīyāni nāmāny adhatta maṅgalechāyai somapītho nā upanamād iti tasmād ete dvināmanas te vā anvāyaṃs te na prāpnuvaṃs tasmād ete 'tihāya vaṣaṭ kriyante na hi prāpnuvaṃs teṣāṃ vā eṣa loko yāvad abhi nyupyate tad yo 'vidvān ākrāmaty ārttim ārchaty atha ya evaṃ vidvān ākrāmati na sadasyām ārttim ārchati teṣāṃ vā eṣa bhāgo yad vyāghāryante ta evāsmai tenābhīṣṭāḥ prītā bhavanti yajñamukhaṃ vai pavamāno yat pavamāne stute 'gnayo vihriyante yajñamukhād evādhivihriyante jambho vai nāmāsura āsīt sa yajñam agirat sa āgnīdhraṃ na prāpnot tam āgnīdhrāt punar vyarujad etad vai jīvaṃ tasmād āgnīdhrād vihriyante dakṣiṇato vai devān asurā yajñam ajayaṃs ta udañcā āgnīdhraṃ samātiṣṭhaṃs tam āgnīdhrāt punar abhyajayann etad vā anabhijitaṃ tasmād āgnīdhrād vihriyanta etat prati vai devān asurā yajñam ajayaṃs ta āgnīdhrād adhi bahiṣpavamānena yajñam abhijityāgnīn ādhāya barhir astṛṇata parājijñānā vā etat sarpanti yad bahiṣpavamānaṃ stoṣyantaḥ sarpanti yad bahiṣpavamāne stuta āha || agnīd agnīn vihara barhiḥ stṛṇāhi || ity āgnīdhrād vā etad adhi bahiṣpavamānena yajñam abhijityāgnīn ādhāya barhiḥ stṛṇate 'tra vā etarhi yajño yatrāstutaṃ stotraṃ yatraiva yajñas tad abhiparyāvṛtya juhoti śukravatī vai pūrve savane aśukraṃ tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ yaj jyotiṣmatīs tṛtīyasavane vyāghārayanti tena tṛtīyasavanaṃ śukravat saṃvatsaro vā agniṣṭomas tasya vā etās tanvo yad dhiṣṇyās tā vā asyaitat samuddharṣayitvā jyotiṣmatīḥ kṛtvāthāgniṣṭomena stuvate saṃvatsaro vā agniṣṭomo dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaro yat prācīr āhutayo hūyante pratyañco dhiṣṇyā vyāghāryante saṃvatsarasya vidhṛtyay ubhayato vai devān asurāḥ parīyattā āsan purastād anye paścād anye yat prācīr āhutayo hūyante ye purastād āsaṃs tāṃs tenāpānudanta yat pratyañco dhiṣṇyā vyāghāryante ye paścād āsaṃs tāṃs tenāpānudanta tad bhrātṛvyasya vā eṣa vinodo 'dhvaryuṇā vai yajño vidhṛta idam iva vā etad yajñasya yad dhiṣṇyā yad adhvaryuḥ pratyaṅ dhiṣṇyān atīyāt prāṇāt saṃkarṣeta pramāyukaḥ syād yady atīyād yajñaparuṣy atīyād aindrīm anubrūyād aindraṃ hi sadaḥ svayaivainad devatayopacaraty ātmano 'hiṃsāyai prācīnaṃ vai dhiṣṇyebhyo 'dhvaryor loko yad adhvaryuḥ pratyaṅ dhiṣṇyān atīyād anyajanatāsya kṣetram abhyārohukā syān ny anya upyante nānye tad eṣāṃ mithunaṃ prajāyati niruktā anye 'niruktā anye ye niruktās te 'smai lokāya ye 'niruktās te 'muṣmai kṣayāya yathā vā idaṃ mekhalāṃ paryasyate medhyasya cāmedhyasya ca vidhṛtyā evaṃ vā ete nyupyante yajñasya vidhṛtyai yat prācīnaṃ dhiṣṇyebhyas tad devānāṃ yat pratīcīnaṃ tan manuṣyāṇāṃ tasmāt somaṃ pibate prāñco dhiṣṇyā nātisṛpe janaṃ hy eti devalokam abhyārohati cātvālād vihriyanta eṣa vā agnīnāṃ yoniḥ svād eva yoner vihriyante 'skannatvāya teṣāṃ vā etad abhyavāyanaṃ codayanaṃ ca yad antarā cātvālaṃ cāgnīdhraṃ caitad vai yajñasya tīrthaṃ tasmād etena saṃcarati tena yo 'vidvānt saṃcaraty ārtim ārchaty atha ya evaṃ vidvānt saṃcarati na sadasyām ārtim ārchati || ity uparikāṇḍe asurāṇāṃ nāma aṣṭamaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ samāptaḥ ||
3.8.10.d: सुवाङ् नभ्राड् अङ्घारे बम्भारा इत्य् एते वै देवानां सोमरक्षय एतेभ्यो वा अधि छन्दांसि सोमम् आहरंस् ते सोमपीथेन व्यार्ध्यत त एतानि द्वितीयानि नामान्य् अधत्त मङ्गलेछायै सोमपीथो ना उपनमाद् इति तस्माद् एते द्विनामनस् ते वा अन्वायंस् ते न प्राप्नुवंस् तस्माद् एते ऽतिहाय वषट् क्रियन्ते न हि प्राप्नुवंस् तेषां वा एष लोको यावद् अभि न्युप्यते तद् यो ऽविद्वान् आक्रामत्य् आर्त्तिम् आर्छत्य् अथ य एवं विद्वान् आक्रामति न सदस्याम् आर्त्तिम् आर्छति तेषां वा एष भागो यद् व्याघार्यन्ते त एवास्मै तेनाभीष्टाः प्रीता भवन्ति यज्ञमुखं वै पवमानो यत् पवमाने स्तुते ऽग्नयो विह्रियन्ते यज्ञमुखाद् एवाधिविह्रियन्ते जम्भो वै नामासुर आसीत् स यज्ञम् अगिरत् स आग्नीध्रं न प्राप्नोत् तम् आग्नीध्रात् पुनर् व्यरुजद् एतद् वै जीवं तस्माद् आग्नीध्राद् विह्रियन्ते दक्षिणतो वै देवान् असुरा यज्ञम् अजयंस् त उदञ्चा आग्नीध्रं समातिष्ठंस् तम् आग्नीध्रात् पुनर् अभ्यजयन्न् एतद् वा अनभिजितं तस्माद् आग्नीध्राद् विह्रियन्त एतत् प्रति वै देवान् असुरा यज्ञम् अजयंस् त आग्नीध्राद् अधि बहिष्पवमानेन यज्ञम् अभिजित्याग्नीन् आधाय बर्हिर् अस्तृणत पराजिज्ञाना वा एतत् सर्पन्ति यद् बहिष्पवमानं स्तोष्यन्तः सर्पन्ति यद् बहिष्पवमाने स्तुत आह ॥ अग्नीद् अग्नीन् विहर बर्हिः स्तृणाहि ॥ इत्य् आग्नीध्राद् वा एतद् अधि बहिष्पवमानेन यज्ञम् अभिजित्याग्नीन् आधाय बर्हिः स्तृणते ऽत्र वा एतर्हि यज्ञो यत्रास्तुतं स्तोत्रं यत्रैव यज्ञस् तद् अभिपर्यावृत्य जुहोति शुक्रवती वै पूर्वे सवने अशुक्रं तृतीयं सवनं यज् ज्योतिष्मतीस् तृतीयसवने व्याघारयन्ति तेन तृतीयसवनं शुक्रवत् संवत्सरो वा अग्निष्टोमस् तस्य वा एतास् तन्वो यद् धिष्ण्यास् ता वा अस्यैतत् समुद्धर्षयित्वा ज्योतिष्मतीः कृत्वाथाग्निष्टोमेन स्तुवते संवत्सरो वा अग्निष्टोमो द्वादश मासाः संवत्सरो यत् प्राचीर् आहुतयो हूयन्ते प्रत्यञ्चो धिष्ण्या व्याघार्यन्ते संवत्सरस्य विधृत्यय् उभयतो वै देवान् असुराः परीयत्ता आसन् पुरस्ताद् अन्ये पश्चाद् अन्ये यत् प्राचीर् आहुतयो हूयन्ते ये पुरस्ताद् आसंस् तांस् तेनापानुदन्त यत् प्रत्यञ्चो धिष्ण्या व्याघार्यन्ते ये पश्चाद् आसंस् तांस् तेनापानुदन्त तद् भ्रातृव्यस्य वा एष विनोदो ऽध्वर्युणा वै यज्ञो विधृत इदम् इव वा एतद् यज्ञस्य यद् धिष्ण्या यद् अध्वर्युः प्रत्यङ् धिष्ण्यान् अतीयात् प्राणात् संकर्षेत प्रमायुकः स्याद् यद्य् अतीयाद् यज्ञपरुष्य् अतीयाद् ऐन्द्रीम् अनुब्रूयाद् ऐन्द्रं हि सदः स्वयैवैनद् देवतयोपचरत्य् आत्मनो ऽहिंसायै प्राचीनं वै धिष्ण्येभ्यो ऽध्वर्योर् लोको यद् अध्वर्युः प्रत्यङ् धिष्ण्यान् अतीयाद् अन्यजनतास्य क्षेत्रम् अभ्यारोहुका स्यान् न्य् अन्य उप्यन्ते नान्ये तद् एषां मिथुनं प्रजायति निरुक्ता अन्ये ऽनिरुक्ता अन्ये ये निरुक्तास् ते ऽस्मै लोकाय ये ऽनिरुक्तास् ते ऽमुष्मै क्षयाय यथा वा इदं मेखलां पर्यस्यते मेध्यस्य चामेध्यस्य च विधृत्या एवं वा एते न्युप्यन्ते यज्ञस्य विधृत्यै यत् प्राचीनं धिष्ण्येभ्यस् तद् देवानां यत् प्रतीचीनं तन् मनुष्याणां तस्मात् सोमं पिबते प्राञ्चो धिष्ण्या नातिसृपे जनं ह्य् एति देवलोकम् अभ्यारोहति चात्वालाद् विह्रियन्त एष वा अग्नीनां योनिः स्वाद् एव योनेर् विह्रियन्ते ऽस्कन्नत्वाय तेषां वा एतद् अभ्यवायनं चोदयनं च यद् अन्तरा चात्वालं चाग्नीध्रं चैतद् वै यज्ञस्य तीर्थं तस्माद् एतेन संचरति तेन यो ऽविद्वान्त् संचरत्य् आर्तिम् आर्छत्य् अथ य एवं विद्वान्त् संचरति न सदस्याम् आर्तिम् आर्छति ॥ इत्य् उपरिकाण्डे असुराणां नाम अष्टमः प्रपाठकः समाप्तः ॥
3.8.10.m:
"Sūvāṅ, Nabhrāj, Aṅghāri, Bambhāri": / these indeed were the Soma-guardians of the gods. / From them indeed the meters brought the Soma. / They were deprived of the Soma-draught. / They assumed these second names wishing for good fortune, [thinking:] / "May the Soma-draught come to us." / Therefore these have two names. / They indeed went after [it]. / They did not reach [it]. / Therefore, passing over these, the Vaṣaṭ-call is made; / for they did not reach [it]. / Their world indeed is as far as [the earth] is heaped down. / Therefore he who, not knowing, steps across [it], incurs misfortune. / But he who, knowing thus, steps across [it], does not incur misfortune among the members of the Sadas. / This indeed is their share, that [the dhiṣṇyas] are besprinkled. / So they, desired and pleased by that, become favorable to him. / The Pavamāna is indeed the mouth of the sacrifice. / When the fires are carried out while the Pavamāna is being chanted, / they are carried out right from the mouth of the sacrifice. / Jambha indeed was an Asura by name; / he swallowed the sacrifice. / He did not reach the Āgnīdhra. / Out of the Āgnīdhra [the gods] broke him open again. / This indeed is living; / therefore they are carried out from the Āgnīdhra. / From the south the Asuras conquered the sacrifice from the gods. / They stood together facing north at the Āgnīdhra. / From the Āgnīdhra they conquered it back. / This indeed was unconquered; / therefore they are carried out from the Āgnīdhra. / There indeed the Asuras conquered the sacrifice over against the gods. / Having conquered the sacrifice from the Āgnīdhra by means of the Bahiṣpavamāna, having placed the fires, they strewed the barhis. / Desiring to know what is beyond, they crawl forward, when they crawl forward about to chant the Bahiṣpavamāna. / When, the Bahiṣpavamāna having been chanted, he says: / "Āgnīdh, distribute the fires; / strew the barhis," / having conquered the sacrifice from the Āgnīdhra by means of the Bahiṣpavamāna, having placed the fires, they strew the barhis. / Here indeed at this time is the sacrifice where the unchanted stotra is. / Right where the sacrifice is, turning towards that, he offers. / Containing the bright [cup] indeed are the two prior pressings; / without the bright [cup] is the third pressing. / When they besprinkle the luminous [dhiṣṇyas] at the third pressing, / thereby the third pressing contains the bright [cup]. / The year indeed is the Agniṣṭoma. / The dhiṣṇyas are indeed its bodies. / Having energized these [bodies] of his, having made them luminous, they then praise with the Agniṣṭoma. / The year indeed is the Agniṣṭoma. / Twelve months are the year. / When the oblations are offered facing east, and the dhiṣṇyas are besprinkled facing west, / [it is] for the support of the year. / From both sides indeed the Asuras surrounded the gods: / some in front, others behind. / When the oblations are offered facing east, / those who were in front, those they drove away thereby. / When the dhiṣṇyas are besprinkled facing west, / those who were behind, those they drove away thereby. / That indeed is the driving away of the rival. / By the Adhvaryu indeed the sacrifice is supported. / Like this [world] indeed of the sacrifice are the dhiṣṇyas. / If the Adhvaryu were to pass west of the dhiṣṇyas, he would be pulled away from his breath; he would be prone to die. / If he should pass, he should pass during a joint of the sacrifice. / He should recite [a verse] addressed to Indra, / for the Sadas belongs to Indra. / With its own deity he serves it, / for the non-injury of himself. / East of the dhiṣṇyas indeed is the Adhvaryu's world. / If the Adhvaryu were to pass west of the dhiṣṇyas, another people would overrun his land. / Some are heaped down, others are not. / That is a pair of them; / he propagates. / Some are expressed, others unexpressed. / Those that are expressed are for this world; / those that are unexpressed are for yonder abode. / Just as one ties around the girdle for the distinction of what is pure and impure, so these are heaped down for the support of the sacrifice. / What is east of the dhiṣṇyas, that belongs to the gods; / what is west, that belongs to mortals. / Therefore, for one drinking Soma, the dhiṣṇyas facing east are not to be overstepped. / For he goes to the people, / he mounts up to the world of the gods. / From the cātvāla [trench] they are carried out; / this indeed is the womb of the fires. / From their own womb they are carried out, / for the sake of not spilling. / Their approaching and going out is this: what is between the cātvāla and the Āgnīdhra. / This indeed is the path of the sacrifice; / therefore he moves through this. / He who, not knowing, moves through it, incurs misfortune. / But he who, knowing thus, moves through it, does not incur misfortune among the members of the Sadas.
Thus ends the eighth prapāṭhaka, named "The Asuras", in the Upper Section.

3.9.1.s: yajño vā eṣa saṃkrāmann eti prāyaṇīyād adhy ātithyam ātithyād adhy upasadaḥ sa upasadbhyo 'dhi prāṅ praṇīyate yad agṛhītvājyāni praṇayeyur apaghnīta yajamānam atha yad gṛhītvājyāni praṇayanti yajñaṃ vā etad yajamāno 'nvārabhate prāñcaḥ somena prayanti prācī patnī pūrvam agnim abhyudaiti somena vā etad rājñābhijayanto yanti yasya vai manuṣyarājo gṛham āgachati tasya vai tarhi tad aiśvarye yadā vai sa tataḥ plāyate 'tha teṣāṃ tat punar bhavati tasmād āhur apivratā ity api hy eṣāṃ tasmin vrataṃ somo vā etad rājā gṛhaṃ prāpa tasya vai tarhi tad aiśvarye yadā vai sa tataḥ pracyavate 'tha sa tat tebhyo visṛjate tad vaisarjanānāṃ vaisarjanatvaṃ tvaṃ soma tanukṛdbhyā iti yad eva tanukṛtaṃ cānyakṛtaṃ cainas tad etenāvayajati dvābhyāṃ gārhapatye juhoti dvipād yajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityay āgneyyāgnīdhre 'ntarikṣam eva prāpyānyad eva rūpam akar vaiṣṇavyā havirdhāne 'da eva prāpya viṣṇur vai yajño viṣṇum eva yajñam akar asurā vā etaṃ devānām āditsanta taṃ devā aptuṃ kṛtvāmuṃ lokam aharan yad aptumatyā juhoty aptum evainaṃ kṛtvāmuṃ lokaṃ haranti sarvebhyo vā eṣa bhūtebhyā āhriyate yat saumyā juhoti manuṣyebhyas tenāhriyate yad aptumatyā pitṛbhyas tena yad āgneyyā devebhyas tena yad vaiṣṇavyā yajñāya tena sarvā vā etat prajā varuṇo gṛhṇāti yat saumyā juhoti manuṣyāṃs tena varuṇān muñcati yad aptumatyā pitṝṃs tena yad āgneyyā devāṃs tena yad vaiṣṇavyā yajñaṃ tena sarvā vā etat prajā varuṇān muñcaty agninā vai mukhena devā imāṃl lokān abhyajanayan gārhapatyenemaṃ lokam āgnīdhreṇāntarikṣam āhavanīyenāmuṃ lokaṃ tasmāt tredhā agnayā ādhīyanta eṣāṃ lokānām abhijityaīndrāgnī vā aparā agnī agnir apara indraḥ pūrvaḥ prajāpatir āhavanīyas tasmād eṣa upopte sādyata uttaro hi pitā putrād uttaro bhrātṛvyād bhavati ya evaṃ vedāgreṇa praṇayed gataśrīḥ śriya eva parigṛhītyai saumyo vai brāhmaṇo devatayā svayaiva devatayā prajā vai paśavo 'ṃśavo rudra āhavanīyo yad agreṇa praṇayed rudrāyāsya paśūn apidadhyāt paścād eva prāṅ praṇīyaḥ paśūnāṃ gopīthāyorv antarikṣaṃ vīhīty antarikṣadevatyo vā eṣa etarhi pracyuta ito 'prāpto 'mutrādityāḥ sadā āsīdety ādityo vai yajño 'ditiḥ somasya yoniḥ sva evainaṃ yonau dadhāti deva savitar eṣa te somā iti manuṣyeṣu vā eṣa purābhūd devebhya evainaṃ saṃprādād etat tvaṃ deva soma devān upāvṛtā iti devo hy eṣa devān upāvartata idam ahaṃ manuṣyānt saha rāyaspoṣeṇa prajayā copāvartatā ity āśiṣam evāśāste namo devebhyaḥ svadhā pitṛbhyā iti namaskāro devānāṃ svadhākāraḥ pitṛṇāṃ nir varuṇasya pāśād amukṣīti varuṇapāśād eva nirmucyata ātmano 'hiṃsāyai svar abhivyakśam iti yajño vai svar yajñam evābhivipaśyati jyotir vaiśvānaram ity asau vā ādityo jyotir vaiśvānaram agninā vā eṣa tanvaṃ viparidhatte yo dīkṣate 'gnī rudro yad agninā punar yathāyathaṃ tanvaṃ na viparidadhīta rudra enam abhimānukaḥ syād yad āhāgne vratapate yā tava tanūr mayy abhūd eṣā sā tvayy agne vratapate yā mama tanūs tvayy abhūd iyaṃ sā mayīty agninā vā etat punar yathāyathaṃ tanvaṃ viparidhatta ātmano 'hiṃsāyai ||
3.9.1.d: यज्ञो वा एष संक्रामन्न् एति प्रायणीयाद् अध्य् आतिथ्यम् आतिथ्याद् अध्य् उपसदः स उपसद्भ्यो ऽधि प्राङ् प्रणीयते यद् अगृहीत्वाज्यानि प्रणयेयुर् अपघ्नीत यजमानम् अथ यद् गृहीत्वाज्यानि प्रणयन्ति यज्ञं वा एतद् यजमानो ऽन्वारभते प्राञ्चः सोमेन प्रयन्ति प्राची पत्नी पूर्वम् अग्निम् अभ्युदैति सोमेन वा एतद् राज्ञाभिजयन्तो यन्ति यस्य वै मनुष्यराजो गृहम् आगछति तस्य वै तर्हि तद् ऐश्वर्ये यदा वै स ततः प्लायते ऽथ तेषां तत् पुनर् भवति तस्माद् आहुर् अपिव्रता इत्य् अपि ह्य् एषां तस्मिन् व्रतं सोमो वा एतद् राजा गृहं प्राप तस्य वै तर्हि तद् ऐश्वर्ये यदा वै स ततः प्रच्यवते ऽथ स तत् तेभ्यो विसृजते तद् वैसर्जनानां वैसर्जनत्वं त्वं सोम तनुकृद्भ्या इति यद् एव तनुकृतं चान्यकृतं चैनस् तद् एतेनावयजति द्वाभ्यां गार्हपत्ये जुहोति द्विपाद् यजमानः प्रतिष्ठित्यय् आग्नेय्याग्नीध्रे ऽन्तरिक्षम् एव प्राप्यान्यद् एव रूपम् अकर् वैष्णव्या हविर्धाने ऽद एव प्राप्य विष्णुर् वै यज्ञो विष्णुम् एव यज्ञम् अकर् असुरा वा एतं देवानाम् आदित्सन्त तं देवा अप्तुं कृत्वामुं लोकम् अहरन् यद् अप्तुमत्या जुहोत्य् अप्तुम् एवैनं कृत्वामुं लोकं हरन्ति सर्वेभ्यो वा एष भूतेभ्या आह्रियते यत् सौम्या जुहोति मनुष्येभ्यस् तेनाह्रियते यद् अप्तुमत्या पितृभ्यस् तेन यद् आग्नेय्या देवेभ्यस् तेन यद् वैष्णव्या यज्ञाय तेन सर्वा वा एतत् प्रजा वरुणो गृह्णाति यत् सौम्या जुहोति मनुष्यांस् तेन वरुणान् मुञ्चति यद् अप्तुमत्या पितॄंस् तेन यद् आग्नेय्या देवांस् तेन यद् वैष्णव्या यज्ञं तेन सर्वा वा एतत् प्रजा वरुणान् मुञ्चत्य् अग्निना वै मुखेन देवा इमांल् लोकान् अभ्यजनयन् गार्हपत्येनेमं लोकम् आग्नीध्रेणान्तरिक्षम् आहवनीयेनामुं लोकं तस्मात् त्रेधा अग्नया आधीयन्त एषां लोकानाम् अभिजित्यईन्द्राग्नी वा अपरा अग्नी अग्निर् अपर इन्द्रः पूर्वः प्रजापतिर् आहवनीयस् तस्माद् एष उपोप्ते साद्यत उत्तरो हि पिता पुत्राद् उत्तरो भ्रातृव्याद् भवति य एवं वेदाग्रेण प्रणयेद् गतश्रीः श्रिय एव परिगृहीत्यै सौम्यो वै ब्राह्मणो देवतया स्वयैव देवतया प्रजा वै पशवो ऽंशवो रुद्र आहवनीयो यद् अग्रेण प्रणयेद् रुद्रायास्य पशून् अपिदध्यात् पश्चाद् एव प्राङ् प्रणीयः पशूनां गोपीथायोर्व् अन्तरिक्षं वीहीत्य् अन्तरिक्षदेवत्यो वा एष एतर्हि प्रच्युत इतो ऽप्राप्तो ऽमुत्रादित्याः सदा आसीदेत्य् आदित्यो वै यज्ञो ऽदितिः सोमस्य योनिः स्व एवैनं योनौ दधाति देव सवितर् एष ते सोमा इति मनुष्येषु वा एष पुराभूद् देवेभ्य एवैनं संप्रादाद् एतत् त्वं देव सोम देवान् उपावृता इति देवो ह्य् एष देवान् उपावर्तत इदम् अहं मनुष्यान्त् सह रायस्पोषेण प्रजया चोपावर्तता इत्य् आशिषम् एवाशास्ते नमो देवेभ्यः स्वधा पितृभ्या इति नमस्कारो देवानां स्वधाकारः पितृणां निर् वरुणस्य पाशाद् अमुक्षीति वरुणपाशाद् एव निर्मुच्यत आत्मनो ऽहिंसायै स्वर् अभिव्यक्शम् इति यज्ञो वै स्वर् यज्ञम् एवाभिविपश्यति ज्योतिर् वैश्वानरम् इत्य् असौ वा आदित्यो ज्योतिर् वैश्वानरम् अग्निना वा एष तन्वं विपरिधत्ते यो दीक्षते ऽग्नी रुद्रो यद् अग्निना पुनर् यथायथं तन्वं न विपरिदधीत रुद्र एनम् अभिमानुकः स्याद् यद् आहाग्ने व्रतपते या तव तनूर् मय्य् अभूद् एषा सा त्वय्य् अग्ने व्रतपते या मम तनूस् त्वय्य् अभूद् इयं सा मयीत्य् अग्निना वा एतत् पुनर् यथायथं तन्वं विपरिधत्त आत्मनो ऽहिंसायै ॥
3.9.1.m: This sacrifice indeed goes passing over from the Prāyaṇīya to the hospitality [offering], / from the hospitality [offering] to the Upasads. / From the Upasads it is carried forward towards the east. / If they were to carry it forward without having taken the clarified butter, it would strike down the sacrificer. / But when they carry it forward having taken the clarified butter, / the sacrificer then holds on to the sacrifice. / Eastward they go forth with the Soma; the wife goes forward towards the east, facing the eastern fire. / With King Soma they indeed go conquering. / Truly, to whose house a human king comes, it is at that time in his dominion. / When he moves on from there, then it becomes theirs again. / Therefore they say, "They share in the vow-food." / For their vow-food is in him. / King Soma indeed arrived at the house. / It is at that time in his dominion. / When he departs from there, then he releases that to them. / That is the releasing nature of the Vaisarjana [oblations]. / "You, O Soma, for the body-makers," [he says]. / Whatever sin has been committed by oneself and committed by another, that he atones for by this. / With two [verses] he offers in the Gārhapatya [fire]. / Two-footed is the sacrificer, / for firm standing. / In the Āgnīdhra [fire he offers] with a verse to Agni. / Having reached the intermediate space, he has made another form. / In the Havirdhāna with a verse to Viṣṇu. / Having reached yonder [world], / Viṣṇu is indeed the sacrifice; / he has made the sacrifice Viṣṇu. / The Asuras indeed wished to take this away from the gods. / The gods, having made him water-rich, took [him] to yonder world. / When he offers with a [verse] containing [the word] aptú, / having made him water-rich, they take him to yonder world. / Indeed for all beings this is brought. / When he offers with a [verse] to Soma, / by that it is brought for men. / When with one containing [the word] aptú, / by that for the fathers. / When with one to Agni, / by that for the gods. / When with one to Viṣṇu, / by that for the sacrifice. / Varuṇa indeed seizes all these creatures. / When he offers with a [verse] to Soma, / by that he frees men from Varuṇa. / When with one containing [the word] aptú, / by that the fathers. / When with one to Agni, / by that the gods. / When with one to Viṣṇu, / by that the sacrifice. / Thus he frees all creatures from Varuṇa. / With Agni as their mouth the gods brought forth these worlds: / this world with the Gārhapatya, / the intermediate space with the Āgnīdhra, / yonder world with the Āhavanīya. / Therefore the fires are established threefold, / for the conquest of these worlds. / The two western fires are Indra and Agni: / Agni is the western one, / Indra the eastern one. / Prajāpati is the Āhavanīya; / therefore it is set down upon earth that has been heaped up. / For the father is higher than the son. / Higher than his rival becomes he who knows thus. / One who has attained fortune should carry [it] forward in front, / for the grasping of fortune. / A Brahmin is of the deity Soma by his divinity; / by his own divinity [he carries it]. / Offshoots are offspring, cattle. / Rudra is the Āhavanīya. / If he were to carry [it] forward in front, he would consign his cattle to Rudra. / It is to be carried forward towards the east behind [the fire], / for the protection of cattle. / "Traverse the wide intermediate space," [he says]. / For belonging to the deity of the intermediate space is he at this time, / having departed from here and not yet reached yonder. / "Sit on the seat of Aditi," [he says]. / Aditi's is the sacrifice; / Aditi is the womb of Soma; / he places him in his own womb. / "O god Savitṛ, this is your Soma," [he says]. / Formerly he was among men; / he hands him over to the gods. / "Thus have you, O divine Soma, turned toward the gods," [he says]. / For, being a god, he turns toward the gods. / "Here have I turned toward men, together with abundance of wealth and with offspring," [he says]. / He thus invokes a blessing. / "Homage to the gods; Svadhā to the fathers," [he says]. / The homage is of the gods; / the Svadhā-call is of the fathers. / "I have been released from Varuṇa's noose," [he says]; / from Varuṇa's noose he is indeed released, / for the non-injury of himself. / "I have looked upon the heavenly world," [he says]. / The heavenly world is indeed the sacrifice; / he looks upon the sacrifice. / "The light common to all men," [he says]. / Yonder sun is indeed the light common to all men. / With fire he indeed interchanges his body who undergoes consecration. / The two fires are Rudra. / If he were not to interchange his body with fire again according to its proper place, Rudra would be liable to harm him. / When he says: / "O Agni, lord of vows, what body of yours was in me, here is that in you; / O Agni, lord of vows, what body of mine was in you, this is that in me," / thus he interchanges his body with fire again according to its proper place, / for the non-injury of himself.

3.9.2.s: na yūpam achaiṣyatā hotavyaṃ na hi dīkṣitasyāgnau juhvati vaiṣṇavīm anūcyāchetyo vaiṣṇavo hi yūpas tad āhur hotavyam eva paruṣy eva juhoty āyatanā iti tan na sūrkṣyaṃ yūpasyaivānte 'gniṃ mathitvātha hotavyaṃ tat svid ubhayam akar juhoty āha na dīkṣitasyāgnau juhoty aty anyān agāṃ nānyān upāgām ity atī hy anyān eti nānyān upaity arvāk tvā parebhyaḥ paro 'varebhyo 'vidam ity arvāg ghy enaṃ parebhyaḥ paro 'varebhyo vindati taṃ tvā juṣāmahe devayajyāyā ity etaṃ hy eṣa juṣate juṣṭaṃ viṣṇavā iti yajñāyaivainaṃ juṣṭaṃ viṣṇave 'kar viṣṇave tveti paryanakti havirbhūtam evainaṃ vṛścaty atho abhighṛtam eva ya itthaṃ vetthaṃ vā hurṇo medhāt so 'pāvṛtto ya ṛjur ūrdhvaśalkaḥ sa vāva medham upasthito ya ṛjur upariṣṭād upāvanato yo 'dhiśākhyo yoniḥ sa yo vā asyā adhijāyate sa yonimān iyaṃ hi vanaspatīnāṃ yoniḥ paruṣi vraścyo yad aparuṣi vṛśced yathā paruṣy avakṛttam evaṃ syād anakṣamaṅgaṃ sthāṇur uñśiṣyo yad akṣasaṅgaṃ sthāṇum uñśiṃṣed vajro bhūtvā yajamānasya paśūn pratihanyāt pañcāratniḥ kāryaḥ paṅktyā saṃmitaḥ ṣaḍaratniḥ kāryā ṛtubhiḥ saṃmitaḥ saptāratniḥ kāryaḥ saptapadayā śakvaryā saṃmito 'ṣṭāratniḥ kāryo gāyatryā saṃmito navāratniḥ kāryas tejasā trivṛtā saṃmito daśāratniḥ kāryo virājā saṃmita ekādaśāratniḥ kāryaḥ triṣṭubhā saṃmito dvādaśāratniḥ kāryo jagatyā saṃmitas trayodaśāratniḥ kāryas trayodaśena prajāpatinā saṃmitaḥ pañcadaśāratniḥ kāryaḥ pañcadaśena vajreṇa saṃmitaḥ saptadaśāratniḥ kāryaḥ saptadaśena prajāpatinā saṃmita ekaviṃśatyaratniḥ kārya ekaviṃśena saṃmitas trayoviṃśatyaratniḥ kāryas trayoviṃśena saṃmitaḥ pañcaviṃśatyaratniḥ kāryaḥ pañcaviṃśena saṃmitaḥ saptaviṃśatyaratniḥ kāryas triṇavena saṃmita ekatriṃśadaratniḥ kārya ekatriṃśena saṃmitas trayastriṃśadaratniḥ kāryas trayastriṃśena saṃmito yāvān puruṣa ūrdhvabāhus tāvān kāryo gṛhṇāti bhūmānam asya paśavo 'nūpatiṣṭhante ||
3.9.2.d: न यूपम् अछैष्यता होतव्यं न हि दीक्षितस्याग्नौ जुह्वति वैष्णवीम् अनूच्याछेत्यो वैष्णवो हि यूपस् तद् आहुर् होतव्यम् एव परुष्य् एव जुहोत्य् आयतना इति तन् न सूर्क्ष्यं यूपस्यैवान्ते ऽग्निं मथित्वाथ होतव्यं तत् स्विद् उभयम् अकर् जुहोत्य् आह न दीक्षितस्याग्नौ जुहोत्य् अत्य् अन्यान् अगां नान्यान् उपागाम् इत्य् अती ह्य् अन्यान् एति नान्यान् उपैत्य् अर्वाक् त्वा परेभ्यः परो ऽवरेभ्यो ऽविदम् इत्य् अर्वाग् घ्य् एनं परेभ्यः परो ऽवरेभ्यो विन्दति तं त्वा जुषामहे देवयज्याया इत्य् एतं ह्य् एष जुषते जुष्टं विष्णवा इति यज्ञायैवैनं जुष्टं विष्णवे ऽकर् विष्णवे त्वेति पर्यनक्ति हविर्भूतम् एवैनं वृश्चत्य् अथो अभिघृतम् एव य इत्थं वेत्थं वा हुर्णो मेधात् सो ऽपावृत्तो य ऋजुर् ऊर्ध्वशल्कः स वाव मेधम् उपस्थितो य ऋजुर् उपरिष्टाद् उपावनतो यो ऽधिशाख्यो योनिः स यो वा अस्या अधिजायते स योनिमान् इयं हि वनस्पतीनां योनिः परुषि व्रश्च्यो यद् अपरुषि वृश्चेद् यथा परुष्य् अवकृत्तम् एवं स्याद् अनक्षमङ्गं स्थाणुर् उञ्शिष्यो यद् अक्षसङ्गं स्थाणुम् उञ्शिंषेद् वज्रो भूत्वा यजमानस्य पशून् प्रतिहन्यात् पञ्चारत्निः कार्यः पङ्क्त्या संमितः षडरत्निः कार्या ऋतुभिः संमितः सप्तारत्निः कार्यः सप्तपदया शक्वर्या संमितो ऽष्टारत्निः कार्यो गायत्र्या संमितो नवारत्निः कार्यस् तेजसा त्रिवृता संमितो दशारत्निः कार्यो विराजा संमित एकादशारत्निः कार्यः त्रिष्टुभा संमितो द्वादशारत्निः कार्यो जगत्या संमितस् त्रयोदशारत्निः कार्यस् त्रयोदशेन प्रजापतिना संमितः पञ्चदशारत्निः कार्यः पञ्चदशेन वज्रेण संमितः सप्तदशारत्निः कार्यः सप्तदशेन प्रजापतिना संमित एकविंशत्यरत्निः कार्य एकविंशेन संमितस् त्रयोविंशत्यरत्निः कार्यस् त्रयोविंशेन संमितः पञ्चविंशत्यरत्निः कार्यः पञ्चविंशेन संमितः सप्तविंशत्यरत्निः कार्यस् त्रिणवेन संमित एकत्रिंशदरत्निः कार्य एकत्रिंशेन संमितस् त्रयस्त्रिंशदरत्निः कार्यस् त्रयस्त्रिंशेन संमितो यावान् पुरुष ऊर्ध्वबाहुस् तावान् कार्यो यदि वा यावान् रथे तिष्ठन् यावान् वै पुरुष ऊर्ध्वबाहुः सैतस्यावमा मात्राथ ततो वर्षीयान्वर्षीयान् एव कार्यो यो बहुशाखो बहुपर्णः स कार्यो भूम्न एव भूमानं ह्य् एष एतस्य जग्राह भूमानम् अस्य गृह्णाति भूमानम् अस्य पशवो ऽनूपतिष्ठन्ते ॥
3.9.2.m: One intending to fetch the sacrificial post should not offer an oblation; / for they do not offer in the fire of a consecrated person. / Having recited a verse to Viṣṇu, it is to be approached; / for the sacrificial post belongs to Viṣṇu. / Regarding this they say: / "One should indeed offer; / he offers upon the joint [of the tree], [thinking:] 'in its proper place.'" / That is not to be heeded. / Having churned fire near the sacrificial post itself, then one should offer. / Thus indeed he has done both: / he offers, they say, / [and] he does not offer in the fire of the consecrated person. / "I have gone past others; I have not approached others," he says; / for he goes past others, he does not approach others. / "Hitherward from the further ones, further than the nearer ones, I have found you," he says; / for hitherward from the further ones, further than the nearer ones, he finds it. / "Thee we accept for the worship of the gods," he says; / for he accepts this one. / "Pleasing to Viṣṇu," he says; / he has made it pleasing to Viṣṇu for the sacrifice itself. / "For Viṣṇu, you," he says, and anoints [it] round about; / he cuts it having become an oblation; / moreover, it is indeed sprinkled with ghee. / That which is bent this way or that way has turned away from the sacrificial substance. / That which is straight, with bark turned upward, that indeed has approached the sacrificial substance. / That which is straight, slightly bent towards the top, / that which has branches, that is a womb. / What is born upon this [earth], that has a womb; / for this [earth] is the womb of trees. / It is to be cut at a joint. / If he were to cut it not at a joint, it would be just as if severed at a joint. / The stump is to be left so as not to break an axle. / If he were to leave a stump that catches an axle, it would become a thunderbolt and strike down the sacrificer's cattle. / It is to be made five cubits long; / it is commensurate with the paṅkti. / It is to be made six cubits long; / it is commensurate with the seasons. / It is to be made seven cubits long; / it is commensurate with the seven-footed śakvarī. / It is to be made eight cubits long; / it is commensurate with the gāyatrī. / It is to be made nine cubits long; / it is commensurate with the brilliance, the trivṛt. / It is to be made ten cubits long; / it is commensurate with the virāj. / It is to be made eleven cubits long; / it is commensurate with the triṣṭubh. / It is to be made twelve cubits long; / it is commensurate with the jagatī. / It is to be made thirteen cubits long; / it is commensurate with the thirteenfold Prajāpati. / It is to be made fifteen cubits long; / it is commensurate with the fifteenfold thunderbolt. / It is to be made seventeen cubits long; / it is commensurate with the seventeenfold Prajāpati. / It is to be made twenty-one cubits long; / it is commensurate with the twenty-onefold. / It is to be made twenty-three cubits long; / it is commensurate with the twenty-threefold. / It is to be made twenty-five cubits long; / it is commensurate with the twenty-fivefold. / It is to be made twenty-seven cubits long; / it is commensurate with the twenty-sevenfold. / It is to be made thirty-one cubits long; / it is commensurate with the thirty-onefold. / It is to be made thirty-three cubits long; / it is commensurate with the thirty-threefold. / As tall as a man with upstretched arms, so tall it is to be made, or as tall as [a man] standing in a chariot. / As tall as a man with upstretched arms—that is its lowest measure. / Then it is to be made longer and longer than that. / One that is rich in branches and rich in leaves is to be made, / for the sake of abundance indeed; / for he has grasped the abundance of this [earth]. / He grasps its abundance; / cattle attend upon his abundance.

3.9.3.s: oṣadhe trāyasvainam ity āha trātyā eva svadhite mainaṃ hiṃsīr iti vajro vai svadhitir vajrād vāvāsmā etad antardadhāty ahiṃsāyai yo vā etasyābhihatasyāgre śakalaḥ parāpatati tam asya tejo 'nvapakrāmati yat taṃ punar āharati satejastvāya prāñcaṃ prahāpayati medham evainam anuparyāvartayati vajro vai yūpas tasmād vā ime lokā nīryamāṇād bibhyatīśvaro hy eṣo 'śānto nīryamāṇa imāṃl lokān hiṃsitor yad āha divam agreṇa mā hiṃsīr antarikṣaṃ madhyena pṛthivyāḥ saṃbhava bhrājaṃ gacheti śamayaty eva śānta eva nīryata eṣāṃ lokānām ahiṃsāyai sarvasya vā eṣa mitraṃ yo dīkṣitaḥ sa etam ahiṃsīd īśvarā vanaspatayo 'pidhiṣṇyaṃ bhavitā yad āvraścane juhoti punar evainaṃ prajanayati tasmād āvraścanād bhūyāṃsaḥ prajāyante paśunā saṃmitaḥ kāryo daśa vai paśoḥ prāṇā ātmaikādaśo 'ṣṭāśrayo brahmaṇī daśame ātmaikādaśas tathā paśunā saṃmito 'ṣṭāśriḥ kāryo gāyatryā rūpaṃ gāyatro hi yūpo gāyatryā vai patantyā yatra parṇaṃ parāpatat tataḥ parṇo 'jāyata tasmāt parṇamaya etat khalu vai parṇasya sāraṃ yat khadiras tasmād khādira iha vā asā āditya āsīt tam ito 'dhy amuṃ lokam aharaṃs tad yato 'dhy amuṃ lokam aharaṃs tasmāj jyotiṣo bilvo 'jāyata tasmād bailvo brahmavarcasakāmena kāryo brahmavarcasasya samaṣṭyay atho jyotiṣaiva tamas taratīndro vai yatīnt sālāvṛkeyebhyaḥ prāyachat teṣāṃ vā eṣa brahmacārī camasādhvaryur āsīd yo 'yaṃ hariṇas tasya yaḥ somapītha āsīt sa svajo 'bhavat tasmād dhariṇaḥ svajaṃ svādati somapītho hy asyaiṣa sa yatra camasaṃ nyaubjat tato rohitako 'jāyata tasmād rauhītakas tasmād rohītakerohītake svajaḥ pṛthivyai tvāntarikṣāya tvā dive tveti prokṣaty eṣāṃ hy eṣa lokānāṃ vidhṛtyai mīyate triḥ prokṣati triṣatyā hi devā atho tripadayaivainaṃ gāyatryā praukṣīd vajro vai yūpo 'nnaṃ yavo yad yavamatībhiḥ prokṣati vajreṇa vā etad annaṃ jayati tejo vai yūpa eṣa khalu vā oṣadhīnāṃ tejo yad yavas tasmād etaṃ śiśirā oṣadhayo 'nuprāṇanti yad yavam avāsyati tejasi vā etat tejo dadhāti rkṣaṃ vā amedhyam āpo havir yad avasiñcati medhyam evainat karoty ṛkṣaṃ vā amedhyaṃ yad avastṛṇāti medhyam evainat karoti takṣito vā eṣa nagno yañ śakam avāsyaty anagnam evainam akaḥ sva evainaṃ sthāne dadhāty avṛkṇa evābhūd ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī āpṛṇeti tenaiva dyāvāpṛthivī āpūrayati yajamāno vā agniṣṭhās tejo ghṛtam āntam avichinnam anakti yajamānam eva tejasānakti devas tvā savitā madhvānaktv ity etad vai devānāṃ madhu yad ghṛtaṃ savitṛprasūta evainaṃ madhvānaktīndrasya caṣālam asīty aindraṃ hi caṣālaṃ supippalā oṣadhīs kṛdhīty oṣadhīr eva phalaṃ grāhayati tasmād oṣadhayaḥ śīrṣan phalaṃ gṛhṇanti divam agreṇottabhānāntarikṣaṃ madhyenāpṛṇa pṛthivīm upareṇa dṛṃhety eṣāṃ hy eṣa lokānāṃ vidhṛtyai mīyate tā te dhāmāny uśmasi gamadhyā ity avadadhāti vaiṣṇavyā vaiṣṇavo hi yūpaḥ svayaiva devatayā viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyateti saṃkalpayati saṃmitatvāya brahmavaniṃ tvā kṣatravaniṃ paryūhāmīty āśīr evaiṣā brahma dṛṃha kṣatraṃ dṛṃhety āśiṣa evaiṣa parigraho 'po 'nupariṣiñcati dhṛtyai ||
3.9.3.d: ओषधे त्रायस्वैनम् इत्य् आह त्रात्या एव स्वधिते मैनं हिंसीर् इति वज्रो वै स्वधितिर् वज्राद् वावास्मा एतद् अन्तर्दधात्य् अहिंसायै यो वा एतस्याभिहतस्याग्रे शकलः परापतति तम् अस्य तेजो ऽन्वपक्रामति यत् तं पुनर् आहरति सतेजस्त्वाय प्राञ्चं प्रहापयति मेधम् एवैनम् अनुपर्यावर्तयति वज्रो वै यूपस् तस्माद् वा इमे लोका नीर्यमाणाद् बिभ्यतीश्वरो ह्य् एषो ऽशान्तो नीर्यमाण इमांल् लोकान् हिंसितोर् यद् आह दिवम् अग्रेण मा हिंसीर् अन्तरिक्षं मध्येन पृथिव्याः संभव भ्राजं गछेति शमयत्य् एव शान्त एव नीर्यत एषां लोकानाम् अहिंसायै सर्वस्य वा एष मित्रं यो दीक्षितः स एतम् अहिंसीद् ईश्वरा वनस्पतयो ऽपिधिष्ण्यं भविता यद् आव्रश्चने जुहोति पुनर् एवैनं प्रजनयति तस्माद् आव्रश्चनाद् भूयांसः प्रजायन्ते पशुना संमितः कार्यो दश वै पशोः प्राणा आत्मैकादशो ऽष्टाश्रयो ब्रह्मणी दशमे आत्मैकादशस् तथा पशुना संमितो ऽष्टाश्रिः कार्यो गायत्र्या रूपं गायत्रो हि यूपो गायत्र्या वै पतन्त्या यत्र पर्णं परापतत् ततः पर्णो ऽजायत तस्मात् पर्णमय एतत् खलु वै पर्णस्य सारं यत् खदिरस् तस्माद् खादिर इह वा असा आदित्य आसीत् तम् इतो ऽध्य् अमुं लोकम् अहरंस् तद् यतो ऽध्य् अमुं लोकम् अहरंस् तस्माज् ज्योतिषो बिल्वो ऽजायत तस्माद् बैल्वो ब्रह्मवर्चसकामेन कार्यो ब्रह्मवर्चसस्य समष्ट्यय् अथो ज्योतिषैव तमस् तरतीन्द्रो वै यतीन्त् सालावृकेयेभ्यः प्रायछत् तेषां वा एष ब्रह्मचारी चमसाध्वर्युर् आसीद् यो ऽयं हरिणस् तस्य यः सोमपीथ आसीत् स स्वजो ऽभवत् तस्माद् धरिणः स्वजं स्वादति सोमपीथो ह्य् अस्यैष स यत्र चमसं न्यौब्जत् ततो रोहितको ऽजायत तस्माद् रौहीतकस् तस्माद् रोहीतकेरोहीतके स्वजः पृथिव्यै त्वान्तरिक्षाय त्वा दिवे त्वेति प्रोक्षत्य् एषां ह्य् एष लोकानां विधृत्यै मीयते त्रिः प्रोक्षति त्रिषत्या हि देवा अथो त्रिपदयैवैनं गायत्र्या प्रौक्षीद् वज्रो वै यूपो ऽन्नं यवो यद् यवमतीभिः प्रोक्षति वज्रेण वा एतद् अन्नं जयति तेजो वै यूप एष खलु वा ओषधीनां तेजो यद् यवस् तस्माद् एतं शिशिरा ओषधयो ऽनुप्राणन्ति यद् यवम् अवास्यति तेजसि वा एतत् तेजो दधाति र्क्षं वा अमेध्यम् आपो हविर् यद् अवसिञ्चति मेध्यम् एवैनत् करोत्य् ऋक्षं वा अमेध्यं यद् अवस्तृणाति मेध्यम् एवैनत् करोति तक्षितो वा एष नग्नो यञ् शकम् अवास्यत्य् अनग्नम् एवैनम् अकः स्व एवैनं स्थाने दधात्य् अवृक्ण एवाभूद् घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी आपृणेति तेनैव द्यावापृथिवी आपूरयति यजमानो वा अग्निष्ठास् तेजो घृतम् आन्तम् अविछिन्नम् अनक्ति यजमानम् एव तेजसानक्ति देवस् त्वा सविता मध्वानक्त्व् इत्य् एतद् वै देवानां मधु यद् घृतं सवितृप्रसूत एवैनं मध्वानक्तीन्द्रस्य चषालम् असीत्य् ऐन्द्रं हि चषालं सुपिप्पला ओषधीस् कृधीत्य् ओषधीर् एव फलं ग्राहयति तस्माद् ओषधयः शीर्षन् फलं गृह्णन्ति दिवम् अग्रेणोत्तभानान्तरिक्षं मध्येनापृण पृथिवीम् उपरेण दृंहेत्य् एषां ह्य् एष लोकानां विधृत्यै मीयते ता ते धामान्य् उश्मसि गमध्या इत्य् अवदधाति वैष्णव्या वैष्णवो हि यूपः स्वयैव देवतया विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यतेति संकल्पयति संमितत्वाय ब्रह्मवनिं त्वा क्षत्रवनिं पर्यूहामीत्य् आशीर् एवैषा ब्रह्म दृंह क्षत्रं दृंहेत्य् आशिष एवैष परिग्रहो ऽपो ऽनुपरिषिञ्चति धृत्यै ॥
3.9.3.m: "O plant, protect it," he says; / truly for protection. / "Axe, do not harm it," [he says]; / the axe is indeed a thunderbolt; / from the thunderbolt he thus shields it, / so as not to harm [it]. / When this [tree] is struck, whichever chip flies off first, its brilliance departs after that [chip]. / When he brings it back, / [it is] to keep its brilliance. / He causes it to fall towards the east. / Towards the sacrifice itself he causes it to turn. / The sacrificial post is indeed a thunderbolt; / therefore these worlds are afraid of it as it is being brought forward. / For if not appeased, as it is being brought forward, it is capable of harming these worlds. / When he says: / "Do not harm the sky with your top, nor the intermediate space with your middle; unite with the earth, go to brilliance!" / he appeases it indeed; / appeased indeed it is brought forward, / so as not to harm these worlds. / Truly he who is consecrated is the friend of all; / he has harmed this [tree]. / The trees would be capable of becoming obstructing [to him]. / When he offers an oblation in the stump, / he generates it anew. / Therefore from a stump more [shoots] are born. / It is to be made proportionate to the sacrificial animal. / Ten indeed are the vital breaths of an animal; / the body is the eleventh. / There are eight corners; / two holy powers are the ninth and tenth; / the body is the eleventh. / Thus it is proportionate to the sacrificial animal. / It is to be made eight-cornered. / It is the form of the Gāyatrī; / for the sacrificial post belongs to the Gāyatrī. / From where the feather fell while the Gāyatrī was flying, thence the parṇa tree was born. / Therefore [it may be] made of parṇa wood. / The core of the parṇa is indeed the khadira; / therefore [it may be] of khadira wood. / The sun was once here; / they took him from here to yonder world. / From the light where they took him to yonder world, / from that light the bilva was born. / Therefore [it may be] of bilva wood. / It is to be made [of it] by one who desires brahmic radiance, / to attain brahmic radiance; / also, through light he crosses over darkness. / Indra handed over the ascetics to the jackals. / Their student of sacred knowledge was the ladle-priest. / As to that antelope, the Soma-draught which he had became a snake. / Therefore the antelope tastes a snake; / for that is his Soma-draught. / Where he turned the ladle upside down, thence the rohitaka tree was born. / Therefore [it may be] of rohitaka wood. / Therefore on every rohitaka tree there is a snake. / "For the earth thee, for the intermediate space thee, for the sky thee!"—thus he sprinkles [it]; / for it is set up to support these worlds. / Three times he sprinkles [it]; / for threefold in truth are the gods. / Moreover, with the three-footed Gāyatrī he has sprinkled it. / The sacrificial post is indeed a thunderbolt; / barley is food. / When he sprinkles with [water] containing barley, / he conquers food by means of the thunderbolt. / The sacrificial post is indeed brilliance; / barley is the brilliance of plants. / Therefore after it do plants breathe in the cold season. / When he throws in barley, / he places brilliance in brilliance. / Bare is impure; / water is the sacrificial offering. / When he pours down [water], / he makes it pure. / Bare is impure; / when he strews [grass] beneath, / he makes it pure. / Hewn, it is naked. / When he throws in a chip, / he has made it not naked; / he places it in its own place; / it becomes uninjured. / "Fill heaven and earth with ghee," [he says]; / with that he fills heaven and earth. / The sacrificer is the agniṣṭhā post; brilliance is ghee. / He anoints [it] to the end, without interruption; / he anoints the sacrificer with brilliance. / "May the divine Savitṛ anoint thee with honey!" [he says]; / ghee is indeed the honey of the gods. / Impelled by Savitṛ, he anoints it with honey. / "Thou art Indra's headpiece," [he says]; / for the headpiece belongs to Indra. / "Make the plants rich in fruit," [he says]; / he causes the plants to bear fruit. / Therefore the plants bear fruit on their head. / "Prop up the sky with your top, / fill the intermediate space with your middle, / make firm the earth with your butt!" [he says]; / for it is set up to support these worlds. / "Those abodes of thine we desire to go to"—with [this verse] to Viṣṇu he sets it down; / for the sacrificial post belongs to Viṣṇu; / with its own deity indeed. / "Behold the deeds of Viṣṇu!"—[with this verse] he arranges [it], / to make it measured. / "I heap [earth] around thee, winner of priesthood, winner of nobility," [he says]; / this is a benediction. / "Strengthen the priesthood, strengthen the nobility," [he says]; / this is the grasping of the benediction. / He pours water around it, / for stability.

3.9.4.s: vajro vai yūpo yad antarvedi minuyān nirdahed yad bahirvedy anavaruddhaḥ syād ardham antarvedi minoty ardhaṃ bahirvedy avaruddho ha bhavati na nirdahati noparasyāviḥ kartavai yad uparasyāviḥ kuryād garteṣṭhāḥ syāt pramāyuko yajamāno nātisthūlaḥ kāryaḥ kṣudhaṃ prajā nīyur no atyaṇur ubhayam evāntarā yajñena vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokam āyaṃs te 'manyantānena vai no 'nye lokam anvārokṣyantīti taṃ yūpenāyopayaṃs tad yūpasya yūpatvaṃ yad yūpaḥ purastān mīyate svargasya lokasyānukśātyai tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam iti samunmārṣṭi svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai nābhidaghne parivyayaty ūrg vā oṣadhaya ūrjaṃ vā etan madhyata ātmano dhatte prajānāṃ ca yadi kāmayeta kṣudhaṃ prajā nīyur ity araśanān yūpān minuyāt kṣudhaṃ prajā niyanti yadi kāmayeta varṣet parjanya ūrjā yajamānaṃ samardhayeyam iti parivīyordhvām udūhed vṛṣṭyā evemāṃ nyūhaty ūrjā yajamānaṃ samardhayati yadi kāmayeta na vaṣet parjanya ūrjā yajamānaṃ vyardhayeyam iti parivīyāvācīm avohed vṛṣṭyaivemāṃ nyūhaty ūrjā yajamānaṃ vyardhayati sarvadevatyo vai yūpo yan nikhātaṃ tat pitṛṇāṃ yad ūrdhvaṃ tan manuṣyāṇāṃ yatra raśanā tad oṣadhīnāṃ yad ūrdhvaṃ raśanāyās tad viśveṣāṃ devānām indrasya caṣālaṃ ye vai devāḥ sādhyā yajñam atyamanyanta teṣāṃ vā etad yad upariṣṭāc caṣālasyāṅgulimātraṃ kāryam aṅgulimātraṃ hi tad agrā āsīd yat tato varṣīyaḥ kuryād vajro bhūtvā yajamānasya paśūn avatiṣṭhed indro vai vṛtrāya vajram udayachat so 'vlīyata tasya vā etad anunaddhyai yac caṣālaṃ pṛthumātraṃ kāryaṃ pṛthumātraṃ hi tad agrā āsīd yad aṇimato 'gṛhṇāt tasmād aṇimato yad indra udayachat tasmād aindraṃ yadi kāmayetānye 'sya lokam anvārohayeyur ity anyasya vṛkṣasya svaruṃ kuryād anye 'sya lokam anvārohanti yadi kāmayeta prajām anusaṃtanuyād iti yūpasya svaruṃ kuryāt prajām evānusaṃtanoti yajamāno vā agniṣṭhās tejo 'gnir yad itthaṃ vetthaṃ vā minuyād yajamānaṃ tejasā vyardhayed agninā sadṛśaṃ metavyā yajamānasya satejastvāyāvṛhya ha sma vai purā saṃsthite yajñe 'gnau yūpaṃ prāsyati saṃbhajya srucas te devā amanyanta yajñaveśasam idaṃ kuryā iti te 'bruvan paridhibhir eva naḥ srucaḥ svagākṛtāḥ santu svaruṇā yūpaḥ prastareṇa sadā iti teṣāṃ vā eṣa svagākāro na ha sma vai purā puruṣaṃ mahādevo hanti tata idaṃ rudro 'nvavātiṣṭhat te devā etāṃ rudrasyāveṣṭim apaśyaṃs triḥ parastād anakti trir avastāt tat ṣaṭ ṣaḍ vā ṛtava ṛtubhyo vā etad rudram avayajaty āhutibhājo vā ṛtavo 'stomabhājas ta evāsyaitenābhīṣṭāḥ prītā bhavanti yad yūpāj juhoti vanaspatibhyas tenāvayajati yad raśanāyā oṣadhībhyas tena yad ātmano manuṣyebhyas tena yad āha divaṃ te dhūmo gachatv iti havirdhānāt tenāntarikṣaṃ jyotir ity āgnīdhrāt tena pṛthivīṃ bhasma svāheti sadasas tena sarvato vā etad rudram avayajaty ā vā etaṃ vanaspatibhyaḥ pracyāvayanty upayajya manuṣyāḥ prayanti tat svāyā devatāyā antardhīyate yūpo vai yajñasya duriṣṭam āmuñcate yad yūpam upaspṛśed yajñasya duriṣṭam āmuñceta tasmād yūpo nopaspṛśyaḥ śug vā eṣa mīyate sa īśvaro 'śānta imāṃl lokāñ śucārpayitor yady ekaḥ syāt || eṣa te vāyo || iti brūyād yadi bahavaḥ || ete te vāyo || iti brūyād vāyūgopā vai vanaspatayaḥ svām evaibhyo devatām apisṛjaty eṣāṃ lokānām ahiṃsāyai yathā vai praugaṃ rajjubhir vyutam evam ime lokā yūpair vyutās ta enam ārtiṃ ninayanti yad āha || namaḥ svarubhyaḥ || iti tebhya eva namo 'kas te 'smai vijihate te 'smai lokaṃ vindanty ete vai devā nāmṛḍayan ta asmiṃs loke sannāḥ svaravo 'bhiroddhāro yān na paśyati te sannā atha yān paśyati te bṛhanta ūrjā yad āha || namaḥ svarubhyo bṛhadbhyo mārutebhyaḥ sannān māvagām || iti tān eva parivṛṇakty ete vā amuṣmiṃl loke 'nnasya pradātāras te 'smā annaṃ prayachanti || apaścāddaghvānnaṃ bhūyāsam || ity apaścāddaghvānnaṃ bhavati ||
3.9.4.d: वज्रो वै यूपो यद् अन्तर्वेदि मिनुयान् निर्दहेद् यद् बहिर्वेद्य् अनवरुद्धः स्याद् अर्धम् अन्तर्वेदि मिनोत्य् अर्धं बहिर्वेद्य् अवरुद्धो ह भवति न निर्दहति नोपरस्याविः कर्तवै यद् उपरस्याविः कुर्याद् गर्तेष्ठाः स्यात् प्रमायुको यजमानो नातिस्थूलः कार्यः क्षुधं प्रजा नीयुर् नो अत्यणुर् उभयम् एवान्तरा यज्ञेन वै देवाः स्वर्गं लोकम् आयंस् ते ऽमन्यन्तानेन वै नो ऽन्ये लोकम् अन्वारोक्ष्यन्तीति तं यूपेनायोपयंस् तद् यूपस्य यूपत्वं यद् यूपः पुरस्तान् मीयते स्वर्गस्य लोकस्यानुक्शात्यै तद् विष्णोः परमं पदम् इति समुन्मार्ष्टि स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै नाभिदघ्ने परिव्ययत्य् ऊर्ग् वा ओषधय ऊर्जं वा एतन् मध्यत आत्मनो धत्ते प्रजानां च यदि कामयेत क्षुधं प्रजा नीयुर् इत्य् अरशनान् यूपान् मिनुयात् क्षुधं प्रजा नियन्ति यदि कामयेत वर्षेत् पर्जन्य ऊर्जा यजमानं समर्धयेयम् इति परिवीयोर्ध्वाम् उदूहेद् वृष्ट्या एवेमां न्यूहत्य् ऊर्जा यजमानं समर्धयति यदि कामयेत न वषेत् पर्जन्य ऊर्जा यजमानं व्यर्धयेयम् इति परिवीयावाचीम् अवोहेद् वृष्ट्यैवेमां न्यूहत्य् ऊर्जा यजमानं व्यर्धयति सर्वदेवत्यो वै यूपो यन् निखातं तत् पितृणां यद् ऊर्ध्वं तन् मनुष्याणां यत्र रशना तद् ओषधीनां यद् ऊर्ध्वं रशनायास् तद् विश्वेषां देवानाम् इन्द्रस्य चषालं ये वै देवाः साध्या यज्ञम् अत्यमन्यन्त तेषां वा एतद् यद् उपरिष्टाच् चषालस्याङ्गुलिमात्रं कार्यम् अङ्गुलिमात्रं हि तद् अग्रा आसीद् यत् ततो वर्षीयः कुर्याद् वज्रो भूत्वा यजमानस्य पशून् अवतिष्ठेद् इन्द्रो वै वृत्राय वज्रम् उदयछत् सो ऽव्लीयत तस्य वा एतद् अनुनद्ध्यै यच् चषालं पृथुमात्रं कार्यं पृथुमात्रं हि तद् अग्रा आसीद् यद् अणिमतो ऽगृह्णात् तस्माद् अणिमतो यद् इन्द्र उदयछत् तस्माद् ऐन्द्रं यदि कामयेतान्ये ऽस्य लोकम् अन्वारोहयेयुर् इत्य् अन्यस्य वृक्षस्य स्वरुं कुर्याद् अन्ये ऽस्य लोकम् अन्वारोहन्ति यदि कामयेत प्रजाम् अनुसंतनुयाद् इति यूपस्य स्वरुं कुर्यात् प्रजाम् एवानुसंतनोति यजमानो वा अग्निष्ठास् तेजो ऽग्निर् यद् इत्थं वेत्थं वा मिनुयाद् यजमानं तेजसा व्यर्धयेद् अग्निना सदृशं मेतव्या यजमानस्य सतेजस्त्वायावृह्य ह स्म वै पुरा संस्थिते यज्ञे ऽग्नौ यूपं प्रास्यति संभज्य स्रुचस् ते देवा अमन्यन्त यज्ञवेशसम् इदं कुर्या इति ते ऽब्रुवन् परिधिभिर् एव नः स्रुचः स्वगाकृताः सन्तु स्वरुणा यूपः प्रस्तरेण सदा इति तेषां वा एष स्वगाकारो न ह स्म वै पुरा पुरुषं महादेवो हन्ति तत इदं रुद्रो ऽन्ववातिष्ठत् ते देवा एतां रुद्रस्यावेष्टिम् अपश्यंस् त्रिः परस्ताद् अनक्ति त्रिर् अवस्तात् तत् षट् षड् वा ऋतव ऋतुभ्यो वा एतद् रुद्रम् अवयजत्य् आहुतिभाजो वा ऋतवो ऽस्तोमभाजस् त एवास्यैतेनाभीष्टाः प्रीता भवन्ति यद् यूपाज् जुहोति वनस्पतिभ्यस् तेनावयजति यद् रशनाया ओषधीभ्यस् तेन यद् आत्मनो मनुष्येभ्यस् तेन यद् आह दिवं ते धूमो गछत्व् इति हविर्धानात् तेनान्तरिक्षं ज्योतिर् इत्य् आग्नीध्रात् तेन पृथिवीं भस्म स्वाहेति सदसस् तेन सर्वतो वा एतद् रुद्रम् अवयजत्य् आ वा एतं वनस्पतिभ्यः प्रच्यावयन्त्य् उपयज्य मनुष्याः प्रयन्ति तत् स्वाया देवताया अन्तर्धीयते यूपो वै यज्ञस्य दुरिष्टम् आमुञ्चते यद् यूपम् उपस्पृशेद् यज्ञस्य दुरिष्टम् आमुञ्चेत तस्माद् यूपो नोपस्पृश्यः शुग् वा एष मीयते स ईश्वरो ऽशान्त इमांल् लोकाञ् शुचार्पयितोर् यद्य् एकः स्यात् ॥ एष ते वायो ॥ इति ब्रूयाद् यदि बहवः ॥ एते ते वायो ॥ इति ब्रूयाद् वायूगोपा वै वनस्पतयः स्वाम् एवैभ्यो देवताम् अपिसृजत्य् एषां लोकानाम् अहिंसायै यथा वै प्रौगं रज्जुभिर् व्युतम् एवम् इमे लोका यूपैर् व्युतास् त एनम् आर्तिं निनयन्ति यद् आह ॥ नमः स्वरुभ्यः ॥ इति तेभ्य एव नमो ऽकस् ते ऽस्मै विजिहते ते ऽस्मै लोकं विन्दन्त्य् एते वै देवा नामृडयन् त अस्मिंस् लोके सन्नाः स्वरवो ऽभिरोद्धारो यान् न पश्यति ते सन्ना अथ यान् पश्यति ते बृहन्त ऊर्जा यद् आह ॥ नमः स्वरुभ्यो बृहद्भ्यो मारुतेभ्यः सन्नान् मावगाम् ॥ इति तान् एव परिवृणक्त्य् एते वा अमुष्मिंल् लोके ऽन्नस्य प्रदातारस् ते ऽस्मा अन्नं प्रयछन्ति ॥ अपश्चाद्दघ्वान्नं भूयासम् ॥ इत्य् अपश्चाद्दघ्वान्नं भवति ॥
3.9.4.m: The sacrificial post is indeed a thunderbolt. / If he should erect it inside the altar, he would burn [it] up. / If [he should erect it] outside the altar, it would not be contained. / Half inside the altar he erects it, half outside the altar. / Thus it is contained and does not burn [it] up. / It is not to be made visible to the butt. / If he were to make it visible to the butt, it would be standing in a hole; / the sacrificer would be prone to die. / It should not be made too thick; / the creatures would run into hunger. / Nor too thin; / [it should be] between both. / By sacrifice indeed the gods went to the heavenly world. / They thought: "By this [sacrifice] truly others will climb after us to the world." / They blocked it with the sacrificial post. / That is the post-nature of the sacrificial post. / That the sacrificial post is erected in front, / is for the looking upon the heavenly world. / "That highest step of Viṣṇu," thus he wipes it upward, / for the attainment of the heavenly world. / At navel-height he girds it around. / Food-sap indeed is the plants. / Food-sap he thus places in the middle of himself and of offspring. / If he should desire, "May creatures run into hunger," he should erect the sacrificial posts without girdles; / the creatures run into hunger. / If he should desire, "May Parjanya rain, may I make the sacrificer thrive with food-sap," having girded it around, he should tuck [the end] upward; / by rain indeed he tucks this [earth] down, he makes the sacrificer thrive with food-sap. / If he should desire, "May Parjanya not rain, may I deprive the sacrificer of food-sap," having girded it around, he should tuck [the end] downward; / by rainlessness indeed he tucks this down, he deprives the sacrificer of food-sap. / The sacrificial post belongs to all deities. / What is buried, that belongs to the fathers. / What is above, that belongs to men. / Where the girdle is, that belongs to the plants. / What is above the girdle, that belongs to the All-gods. / The caṣāla belongs to Indra. / Those gods, the Sādhyas, who thought themselves above the sacrifice, to them belongs this [part] which is above the caṣāla. / It should be made of the measure of a finger; / for it was a finger in measure at the top. / If he should make it bigger than that, having become a thunderbolt it would descend upon the cattle of the sacrificer. / Indra raised the thunderbolt against Vṛtra; / it was bent back. / For fastening it together, the caṣāla is to be made of a broad measure; / for it was of a broad measure at the top. / Because he grasped it from the thin end, therefore it is from the thin end. / Because Indra raised it, therefore it belongs to Indra. / If he should desire, "May others climb after his world," he should make the chip of another tree; / others climb after his world. / If he should desire, "May he continue his offspring," he should make the chip of the sacrificial post [itself]; / he continues his offspring. / The sacrificer is the agniṣṭhā post; Agni is brilliance. / If he should erect it this way or that, he would deprive the sacrificer of brilliance. / It is to be erected equal with Agni, / to preserve the brilliance of the sacrificer. / Formerly, indeed, when the sacrifice was completed, having torn out the sacrificial post and broken the ladles, he threw them into the fire. / The gods thought: / "He would make here a destruction of the sacrifice." / They said: / "Let our ladles be made acceptable by the enclosing-sticks, / the sacrificial post by the chip, / the sadas by the prastara." / That indeed is their making acceptable. / Formerly, indeed, Mahādeva did not slay man. / Then Rudra stood down over this [creation]. / The gods saw this appeasement of Rudra: / thrice he anoints above, thrice below; / that makes six. / Six indeed are the seasons. / From the seasons he thus appeases Rudra. / Sharing in the oblations are the seasons, not sharing in the chants; / they indeed are sought and pleased by him through this. / When he offers from the sacrificial post, / thereby he appeases [Rudra] away from the trees. / When from the girdle, / thereby from the plants. / When from oneself, / thereby from men. / When he says: / "May thy smoke go to heaven," / thereby [he appeases Rudra away] from the Havirdhāna. / "Light to the atmosphere," / thereby from the Āgnīdhra. / "Ashes to the earth, svāhā!" / thereby from the sadas. / From everywhere he thus appeases Rudra. / Truly men dislodge this [tree] from the trees, and having sacrificed [to it] they go forth. / Thus it is concealed from its own deity. / The sacrificial post indeed puts on the ill-offered part of the sacrifice. / If he should touch the sacrificial post, he would put on the ill-offered part of the sacrifice. / Therefore the sacrificial post is not to be touched. / As heat, indeed, this is erected; / if unappeased, it is capable of visiting these worlds with heat. / If it should be one, he should say, "This for thee, O Vāyu!"; / if many, he should say, "These for thee, O Vāyu!" / Trees are protected by Vāyu; / he unites them with their own deity, / so as not to harm these worlds. / Just as the fore-part of a shaft is woven with ropes, so these worlds are woven with sacrificial posts. / They bring him to ruin. / When he says, "Homage to the chips!" / he has thereby paid homage to them. / They step aside for him; / they find a world for him. / These gods did not have mercy; settled in this world, the chips are obstructors. / Those which he does not see are settled; / and those which he sees are mighty in food-sap. / When he says, "Homage to the mighty chips, belonging to the Maruts; may I not stumble into the settled ones," / he avoids them. / These in yonder world are the givers of food; / they bestow food upon him. / "May I become one who does not run short of food," [he says]; / he becomes one who does not run short of food.

3.9.5.s: sādhyā vai devā āsann atha vai tarhi nānyāhutir āsīt te devā agniṃ mathitvāgnā ajuhavus te vai tayaivāhutyā paśūnt sṛṣṭvātha paśum ālabhanta yad agniṃ mathitvāgnau juhoti tayā vā etad āhutyā paśūnt sṛṣṭvātha paśum ālabhante 'tho paśavo vā etad ālabdhā yad devatāṃ janayanty atho teja evāsmai janayanty agner janitram asīty āyatanam iva vā etat kriyate vṛṣaṇau sthā iti reta evaitad dadhāti na hi tasya reto dhīyate yasyaitau na bhavata urvaśy asīti vāg vā urvaśī purūravā asīti prāṇa eva tan mithunam āyur asīti samanakti tasminn eva mithune reto dadhāti gāyatram asi triṣṭub asi jagad asīti chandobhir evainaṃ prajanayati sāvitrīṃ prathamām anvāha prasūtyai savitṛprasūtā hi prajāḥ prajāyante 'tha dyāvāpṛthivīyām api hi dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ paśuṣu dyāvāpṛthivī hi paśavo 'nuprajāyante gāyatrīr anvāha gāyatro hy agnir gāyatraṃ chando 'parimitā anvāhāparimitā hy agnes tanvo 'gninā vā anīkenendro vṛtram ahaṃs tasya samāsṛptasya bhītasya yatra vyārdhyata tato dhūmno 'sṛjyata tasmād dhūmavatī nānūcyā vyṛddhā hi sā rakṣasām ananvavajayāya paridhayaḥ paridhīyante yat samayā paridhīn praharet tad anu rakṣāṃsi yajñam avajayeyur agreṇa paridhayaḥ prahṛtyā rakṣasām ananvavajayāya krūram iva vā etad yajñe kriyate yad agnā agniṃ juhvati yad āha bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau samokasau sacetasā arepasā iti śamayaty eva śānta eva prahriyate yajamānasyāhiṃsāyai sruveṇābhijuhoti saṃjagmānābhyām evābhyāṃ bhāgadheyam apidadhāti yaḥ kūṭo vākarṇo vā kāṇo vā śuṣko vāvartata tasya yātayāmā sa yo 'pannadan malaṃ tat paśūnām āgneyaḥ paśur agniṣṭoma ālabhya āgneyo hy agniṣṭoma aindrāgnaḥ paśur ukthya ālabhya aindrāgnāni hy ukthyāny aindro vṛṣṇiḥ ṣoḍaśiny ālabhya aindro vai vṛṣṇir aindraḥ ṣoḍaśī sārasvatī meṣy atirātra ālabhyā vāg vai sarasvatī vāg anuṣṭub ānuṣṭubhī rātrir yajñakratūnām evaiṣā vyāvṛttir yathā vai matsyo 'vicito janam avadhūnuta evaṃ vā ete prajāyamānā janam avadhūnvate yas tvā etān evaṃ veda tam etenāvabhūnvate kathaṃ savanāni paśumanti vecheti pṛched yad vapayā prātaḥsavane caranti tena prātaḥsavanaṃ paśumad yat puroḍāśair mādhyaṃdine savane tena mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ paśumad yad aṅgais tṛtīyasavane tena tṛtīyasavanaṃ paśumat kiyatā tat paśoś caranti yad vapayā caranti kiyatā tad yat puroḍāśaiḥ kiyatā tad yad avadānair rūpeṇa tat paśoś caranti yad vapayā caranty ātmanā tad yat puroḍāśaiḥ śarīreṇa tad yad avadānaiḥ kasmai paśuḥ pratyaṅ niyujyata udaṅ praṇīyate dakṣiṇata upasādyate prāṅ hūyata iti pṛched yat pratyaṅ niyujyata imāṃ tena diśam abhijayati yad dakṣiṇata upasādyata imāṃ tena yat prāṅ hūyata imāṃ tena yad udaṅ praṇīyate manuṣyalokaṃ tenābhijayati yad dakṣiṇata upasādyate pitṛlokaṃ tena yat prāṅ hūyate devalokaṃ tena yad āhutyā ūrdhvo dhūma udayate svargaṃ tena lokaṃ yad iḍopahūtaṃ pratyaṅ harantīmaṃ tena lokaṃ sarvā vā imā diśaḥ paśuyājy abhijayati sarvāṃl lokān sarvā evāsyemā diśo 'bhijitā bhavanti sarve lokāḥ ||
3.9.5.d: साध्या वै देवा आसन्न् अथ वै तर्हि नान्याहुतिर् आसीत् ते देवा अग्निं मथित्वाग्ना अजुहवुस् ते वै तयैवाहुत्या पशून्त् सृष्ट्वाथ पशुम् आलभन्त यद् अग्निं मथित्वाग्नौ जुहोति तया वा एतद् आहुत्या पशून्त् सृष्ट्वाथ पशुम् आलभन्ते ऽथो पशवो वा एतद् आलब्धा यद् देवतां जनयन्त्य् अथो तेज एवास्मै जनयन्त्य् अग्नेर् जनित्रम् असीत्य् आयतनम् इव वा एतत् क्रियते वृषणौ स्था इति रेत एवैतद् दधाति न हि तस्य रेतो धीयते यस्यैतौ न भवत उर्वश्य् असीति वाग् वा उर्वशी पुरूरवा असीति प्राण एव तन् मिथुनम् आयुर् असीति समनक्ति तस्मिन्न् एव मिथुने रेतो दधाति गायत्रम् असि त्रिष्टुब् असि जगद् असीति छन्दोभिर् एवैनं प्रजनयति सावित्रीं प्रथमाम् अन्वाह प्रसूत्यै सवितृप्रसूता हि प्रजाः प्रजायन्ते ऽथ द्यावापृथिवीयाम् अपि हि द्यावापृथिव्योः पशुषु द्यावापृथिवी हि पशवो ऽनुप्रजायन्ते गायत्रीर् अन्वाह गायत्रो ह्य् अग्निर् गायत्रं छन्दो ऽपरिमिता अन्वाहापरिमिता ह्य् अग्नेस् तन्वो ऽग्निना वा अनीकेनेन्द्रो वृत्रम् अहंस् तस्य समासृप्तस्य भीतस्य यत्र व्यार्ध्यत ततो धूम्नो ऽसृज्यत तस्माद् धूमवती नानूच्या व्यृद्धा हि सा रक्षसाम् अनन्ववजयाय परिधयः परिधीयन्ते यत् समया परिधीन् प्रहरेत् तद् अनु रक्षांसि यज्ञम् अवजयेयुर् अग्रेण परिधयः प्रहृत्या रक्षसाम् अनन्ववजयाय क्रूरम् इव वा एतद् यज्ञे क्रियते यद् अग्ना अग्निं जुह्वति यद् आह भवतं नः समनसौ समोकसौ सचेतसा अरेपसा इति शमयत्य् एव शान्त एव प्रह्रियते यजमानस्याहिंसायै स्रुवेणाभिजुहोति संजग्मानाभ्याम् एवाभ्यां भागधेयम् अपिदधाति यः कूटो वाकर्णो वा काणो वा शुष्को वावर्तत तस्य यातयामा स यो ऽपन्नदन् मलं तत् पशूनाम् आग्नेयः पशुर् अग्निष्टोम आलभ्य आग्नेयो ह्य् अग्निष्टोम ऐन्द्राग्नः पशुर् उक्थ्य आलभ्य ऐन्द्राग्नानि ह्य् उक्थ्यान्य् ऐन्द्रो वृष्णिः षोडशिन्य् आलभ्य ऐन्द्रो वै वृष्णिर् ऐन्द्रः षोडशी सारस्वती मेष्य् अतिरात्र आलभ्या वाग् वै सरस्वती वाग् अनुष्टुब् आनुष्टुभी रात्रिर् यज्ञक्रतूनाम् एवैषा व्यावृत्तिर् यथा वै मत्स्यो ऽविचितो जनम् अवधूनुत एवं वा एते प्रजायमाना जनम् अवधून्वते यस् त्वा एतान् एवं वेद तम् एतेनावभून्वते कथं सवनानि पशुमन्ति वेछेति पृछेद् यद् वपया प्रातःसवने चरन्ति तेन प्रातःसवनं पशुमद् यत् पुरोडाशैर् माध्यंदिने सवने तेन माध्यंदिनं सवनं पशुमद् यद् अङ्गैस् तृतीयसवने तेन तृतीयसवनं पशुमत् कियता तत् पशोश् चरन्ति यद् वपया चरन्ति कियता तद् यत् पुरोडाशैः कियता तद् यद् अवदानैर् रूपेण तत् पशोश् चरन्ति यद् वपया चरन्त्य् आत्मना तद् यत् पुरोडाशैः शरीरेण तद् यद् अवदानैः कस्मै पशुः प्रत्यङ् नियुज्यत उदङ् प्रणीयते दक्षिणत उपसाद्यते प्राङ् हूयत इति पृछेद् यत् प्रत्यङ् नियुज्यत इमां तेन दिशम् अभिजयति यद् दक्षिणत उपसाद्यत इमां तेन यत् प्राङ् हूयत इमां तेन यद् उदङ् प्रणीयते मनुष्यलोकं तेनाभिजयति यद् दक्षिणत उपसाद्यते पितृलोकं तेन यत् प्राङ् हूयते देवलोकं तेन यद् आहुत्या ऊर्ध्वो धूम उदयते स्वर्गं तेन लोकं यद् इडोपहूतं प्रत्यङ् हरन्तीमं तेन लोकं सर्वा वा इमा दिशः पशुयाज्य् अभिजयति सर्वांल् लोकान् सर्वा एवास्येमा दिशो ऽभिजिता भवन्ति सर्वे लोकाः ॥
3.9.5.m:
The Sādhyas were indeed the gods.
At that time, indeed, there was no other offering.
Those gods, having churned fire, offered into the fire.
Having created cattle by that very offering, they then seized the victim.
When he offers into the fire having churned fire,
having created cattle by that very offering, they then seize the victim.
Moreover, the victims are indeed seized when they bring forth the deity.
Moreover, they generate brilliance for him.
"You are the birthplace of Agni," [he says];
this is made, as it were, a proper seat.
"You two are the two testicles," [he says];
he thus places semen.
For no semen is placed for him who does not have these two.
"You are Urvaśī," [he says];
Urvaśī is speech.
"You are Purūravas," [he says];
breath indeed is that pair.
"You are life," [he says, and] anoints.
In that very pair he places semen.
"You are the Gāyatrī,
you are the Triṣṭubh,
you are the Jagatī," [he says];
by the meters he brings him forth.
He recites a verse to Savitṛ first,
for impulsion;
for impelled by Savitṛ creatures are brought forth.
Then [he recites a verse] to Heaven and Earth;
for Heaven and Earth are in the cattle;
for after Heaven and Earth cattle are brought forth.
He recites Gāyatrī verses;
for Agni belongs to the Gāyatrī, and the meter is Gāyatrī.
He recites an unlimited number [of verses];
for unlimited are the bodies of Agni.
With Agni as his point [of vanguard], Indra slew Vṛtra.
From him (Vṛtra), creeping away frightened, where he was injured, from there smoke was released.
Therefore a [verse] containing smoke should not be recited;
for it is deficient,
so that the Rakṣases may not conquer [the sacrifice].
The enclosing sticks are laid around.
If he were to cast the enclosing sticks straight through, the Rakṣases would conquer the sacrifice after that.
The enclosing sticks are to be cast at the tip,
so that the Rakṣases may not conquer [the sacrifice].
Something cruel, as it were, is done in the sacrifice when they offer fire into fire.
When he says:
"Be harmonious with us, dwelling together, like-minded, without blemish,"
he appeases it.
Appeased indeed it is cast forward,
for the non-injury of the sacrificer.
He offers over it with the dipping spoon;
he covers the portion for these two as they come together.
That which was hornless, or earless, or one-eyed, or dried up, is stale for him.
That which has not lost its teeth is the impurity of cattle.
A victim to Agni is to be seized at the Agniṣṭoma;
for the Agniṣṭoma belongs to Agni.
A victim to Indra and Agni is to be seized at the Ukthya;
for the Ukthyas belong to Indra and Agni.
A ram to Indra is to be seized at the Ṣoḍaśin;
for the ram belongs to Indra;
the Ṣoḍaśin belongs to Indra.
A ewe to Sarasvatī is to be seized at the Atirātra;
for Sarasvatī is speech;
speech is Anuṣṭubh;
the night belongs to the Anuṣṭubh.
This is the distinction of the sacrificial rites.
Just as a fish, unchecked, shakes off people, so these, being brought forth, shake off people.
Whoever knows them thus, him they do not shake off with this.
One might ask: "How does he make the pressings endowed with cattle?"
When they perform with the omentum at the morning pressing,
thereby the morning pressing is endowed with cattle.
When [they perform] with cake-offerings at the midday pressing,
thereby the midday pressing is endowed with cattle.
When [they perform] with the limbs at the third pressing,
thereby the third pressing is endowed with cattle.
With what [part] of the victim do they perform when they perform with the omentum?
With what when with the cakes?
With what when with the portions cut off?
They perform with the form of the victim when they perform with the omentum.
With the self [they perform] when with the cakes.
With the body [they perform] when with the portions cut off.
"Why is the victim bound facing west,
led forward north,
placed south,
[and] offered east?"
— so one might ask.
When it is bound facing west,
he thereby conquers this direction.
When [it is] south,
[when] it is placed, thereby [he conquers] this [direction].
When it is offered facing east,
thereby [he conquers] this [direction].
When it is led forward north,
he thereby conquers the world of men.
When it is placed south,
thereby [he conquers] the world of the fathers.
When it is offered facing east,
thereby [he conquers] the world of the gods.
When the upward smoke rises from the oblation,
thereby [he conquers] the heavenly world.
When they carry west that which was invoked with the Iḍā,
thereby [he conquers] this world.
The sacrificer with an animal victim conquers all these quarters, all the worlds.
All these quarters, all the worlds, become conquered for him.

3.9.6.s: athaitā āpriyaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā riricāno 'manyata sa etā āprīr apaśyat tābhir ātmānam āprīṇīta yajño vai prajāpatir yad etā āpriyo bhavanti yajñam evaitābhir yajamānā āprīṇīte vapayā vai paśor devāḥ prātaḥsavane svargaṃ lokam āyan yad vapayā prātaḥsavane caranti vapayā vā etat paśor yajamānaḥ prātaḥsavane svargaṃ lokam eti te vai svaryanto 'sthāni śarīrāṇy adhūnvata yad aṅgais tṛtīyasavane caranty asnāṃ śīrīṇāṃ niṣkrītyai paśuṃ snapayanti yad evāsyābhinniṣaṇṇaṃ śamalam amedhyaṃ tañ śundhanti paśum upākṛtyāgniṃ manthanti paśūnām avaruddhyai dvau vai vajrau ghoro 'nyaḥ śivo 'nyo yaḥ śuṣkaḥ sa ghoro ya ārdraḥ sa śivo vajreṇa khalu vai vīryaṃ kriyate varjaṃ vā etad ādatte vīryāyeṣe tvetīṣa evainam upāvir asīty upa hy eṣo 'vaty upo devān daivīr viśaḥ prāgur ity etā vai daivīr viśo yat paśavo vahnaya uśijā ity ete vai vahnaya uśijo yad ṛtvijaś ca dhiṣṇyāś ca bṛhaspate dhārayā vasūnīti brahma vai bṛhaspatir brahmaṇaivaināṃ yachati havyā te svadann iti svaditam evainam ālabhate deva tvaṣṭar vasu raṇā iti tvaṣṭā hi rūpāṇi vikaroti revatīr amedhyam iti paśavo vai revatīr yachaty evaināṃ devasya tvā savituḥ prasava iti savitṛprasūta evainām ādatte 'śvinor bāhubhyām ity aśvinau vai devānām adhvaryuḥ pūṣṇo hastābhyām iti devatābhir eva dvau vai pāśau ghoro 'nyaḥ śivo 'nyo yo yajñiyaḥ sa ghoro yo 'yajñiyaḥ sa śiva ṛtasya tvā devahaviḥ pāśeneti ya eva yajñiyaḥ pāśas tenainam ālabhate pratimuñcāmīty abhi hi manuṣyā dadhaty amuṣmai tvā juṣṭam iti yasyā eva devatāyai paśur ālabhyate tasyā enaṃ juṣṭam akar dharṣā mānuṣā iti manuṣyā hi dhārayanti śuṣko vā eṣo 'medhyo yat paśuṃ niyunakty ubhā evainau medhyau karoti pratyañcaṃ niyunakti pratyañco hi paśavo medham upatiṣṭhante prāṇeṣu vā etasya devatā upasthitā yat paśuṃ niyunakti pratīcīr evāsmai devatā niyunakty adbhyas tvauṣadhībhyā ity adbhyo hy eṣa oṣadhībhyo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmīti yasyā eva devatāyai paśur ālabhyate tasyā enaṃ juṣṭam akar anu tvā mātā manyatām anu pitety anumata evainaṃ mātrā pitrā bhrātrā sakhyālabhate 'numānāvaha devān devāyate yajamānāyeti devatābhya evainaṃ nirdiśaty apāṃ perur asīty apāṃ hy eṣa peruḥ svāttaṃ sad dhavir āpo devīḥ svadantv iti svaditam evainam ālabhate 'tha yad upa gṛhṇāty upa ca siñcati sarvata evainaṃ medhena samardhayati saṃ te vāyur vātena gachatām iti vātam evāsya prāṇam anvavārchati saṃ yajatrair aṅgānīti yajñiyam evainam akaḥ saṃ yajñapatir āśiṣeti yajamānam eva yajñasyāśiṣā samardhayati śiro vā āghāra ātmā havir yad āghāram āghāryaṃ paśunā samanakty ātman vā etañ śiro yajñasya pratidadhāti vajro vai svarur vajraḥ svadhitir yat svadhitinānakti vajreṇaivainaṃ stṛṇute yāktā tayā śṛtasyāvadyati havirbhūtā vā eṣā haviṣaiva haviṣo 'vadyati ||
3.9.6.d: अथैता आप्रियः प्रजापतिः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा रिरिचानो ऽमन्यत स एता आप्रीर् अपश्यत् ताभिर् आत्मानम् आप्रीणीत यज्ञो वै प्रजापतिर् यद् एता आप्रियो भवन्ति यज्ञम् एवैताभिर् यजमाना आप्रीणीते वपया वै पशोर् देवाः प्रातःसवने स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन् यद् वपया प्रातःसवने चरन्ति वपया वा एतत् पशोर् यजमानः प्रातःसवने स्वर्गं लोकम् एति ते वै स्वर्यन्तो ऽस्थानि शरीराण्य् अधून्वत यद् अङ्गैस् तृतीयसवने चरन्त्य् अस्नां शीरीणां निष्क्रीत्यै पशुं स्नपयन्ति यद् एवास्याभिन्निषण्णं शमलम् अमेध्यं तञ् शुन्धन्ति पशुम् उपाकृत्याग्निं मन्थन्ति पशूनाम् अवरुद्ध्यै द्वौ वै वज्रौ घोरो ऽन्यः शिवो ऽन्यो यः शुष्कः स घोरो य आर्द्रः स शिवो वज्रेण खलु वै वीर्यं क्रियते वर्जं वा एतद् आदत्ते वीर्यायेषे त्वेतीष एवैनम् उपाविर् असीत्य् उप ह्य् एषो ऽवत्य् उपो देवान् दैवीर् विशः प्रागुर् इत्य् एता वै दैवीर् विशो यत् पशवो वह्नय उशिजा इत्य् एते वै वह्नय उशिजो यद् ऋत्विजश् च धिष्ण्याश् च बृहस्पते धारया वसूनीति ब्रह्म वै बृहस्पतिर् ब्रह्मणैवैनां यछति हव्या ते स्वदन्न् इति स्वदितम् एवैनम् आलभते देव त्वष्टर् वसु रणा इति त्वष्टा हि रूपाणि विकरोति रेवतीर् अमेध्यम् इति पशवो वै रेवतीर् यछत्य् एवैनां देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इति सवितृप्रसूत एवैनाम् आदत्ते ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्याम् इत्य् अश्विनौ वै देवानाम् अध्वर्युः पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् इति देवताभिर् एव द्वौ वै पाशौ घोरो ऽन्यः शिवो ऽन्यो यो यज्ञियः स घोरो यो ऽयज्ञियः स शिव ऋतस्य त्वा देवहविः पाशेनेति य एव यज्ञियः पाशस् तेनैनम् आलभते प्रतिमुञ्चामीत्य् अभि हि मनुष्या दधत्य् अमुष्मै त्वा जुष्टम् इति यस्या एव देवतायै पशुर् आलभ्यते तस्या एनं जुष्टम् अकर् धर्षा मानुषा इति मनुष्या हि धारयन्ति शुष्को वा एषो ऽमेध्यो यत् पशुं नियुनक्त्य् उभा एवैनौ मेध्यौ करोति प्रत्यञ्चं नियुनक्ति प्रत्यञ्चो हि पशवो मेधम् उपतिष्ठन्ते प्राणेषु वा एतस्य देवता उपस्थिता यत् पशुं नियुनक्ति प्रतीचीर् एवास्मै देवता नियुनक्त्य् अद्भ्यस् त्वौषधीभ्या इत्य् अद्भ्यो ह्य् एष ओषधीभ्यो जुष्टं प्रोक्षामीति यस्या एव देवतायै पशुर् आलभ्यते तस्या एनं जुष्टम् अकर् अनु त्वा माता मन्यताम् अनु पितेत्य् अनुमत एवैनं मात्रा पित्रा भ्रात्रा सख्यालभते ऽनुमानावह देवान् देवायते यजमानायेति देवताभ्य एवैनं निर्दिशत्य् अपां पेरुर् असीत्य् अपां ह्य् एष पेरुः स्वात्तं सद् धविर् आपो देवीः स्वदन्त्व् इति स्वदितम् एवैनम् आलभते ऽथ यद् उप गृह्णात्य् उप च सिञ्चति सर्वत एवैनं मेधेन समर्धयति सं ते वायुर् वातेन गछताम् इति वातम् एवास्य प्राणम् अन्ववार्छति सं यजत्रैर् अङ्गानीति यज्ञियम् एवैनम् अकः सं यज्ञपतिर् आशिषेति यजमानम् एव यज्ञस्याशिषा समर्धयति शिरो वा आघार आत्मा हविर् यद् आघारम् आघार्यं पशुना समनक्त्य् आत्मन् वा एतञ् शिरो यज्ञस्य प्रतिदधाति वज्रो वै स्वरुर् वज्रः स्वधितिर् यत् स्वधितिनानक्ति वज्रेणैवैनं स्तृणुते याक्ता तया शृतस्यावद्यति हविर्भूता वा एषा हविषैव हविषो ऽवद्यति ॥

3.9.7.s: agninā vai mukhena devā imāṃl lokān abhyajayan yat paryagniṃ karoty agninā vā etan mukhena yajamāna imāṃl lokān abhijayati rakṣāṃsi vā etaṃ jighāṃsanti yat paryagniṃ karoti rakṣasām apahatyai triḥ paryagniṃ karoti trayo vā ime lokā ebhyo vā etal lokebhyo yajñād rakṣāṃsy apahanti cātvālam api paryety eṣā vā agnīnāṃ yoniḥ skandati vā etad dhavir yad viścotati yad vilipyate 'gnir vai sarvā devatā atra vai sāpi devatā yasyā ālabhyate yat paryagniṃ karoti tām evainad gamayati kiyad vāhaitat paśoḥ kiyad vā yat prayājā etarhi khalu vai sarvo yarhy āprītas tasmād āśrāvyopapreṣyati devatābhyo vai pūrvam āśuśravad atha vā atra paśor āśrāvayati tasmād āśrāvyopapreṣyaty ubhaye vā etaṃ badhyamānam anubadhyante ye grāmyāḥ paśavo ye cāraṇyā ye badhyamānam anu badhyamānā anvaikṣanta manaseti yaj juhoti teṣāṃ vā eṣonmokṣā yan na juhuyād anunmuktāḥ syur urv antarikṣaṃ vīhīty antarikṣadevatyo vā eṣa etarhi rakṣāṃsi vā etaṃ jighāṃsanti pracyutam ito 'prāptam amutrāgniṃ purastād dharanti rakṣasāṃ parāṇuttyai rakṣasām apahatyay atho havyāya vā etat praṇīyamānāya devatāḥ purastād dharanty agniṃ purastān nidadhāty askannatvāya paśor vai māraṇāyānīyamānasyāhavanīyaṃ medhyo 'bhyupakrāmati yo vai tarhi paśum anvārabhate taṃ yajñasyāśīr gachati yad āha revati predhā yajñapatim āviśeti yatra vā etat kvaca yajamānaṃ santaṃ yajñasyāśīr gachati vapāśrapaṇībhyām anvārabhate tat svid ubhayam akar uro antarikṣa sajūr devena vātenety antarikṣaṃ vai paśavo vātaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇān asmin dadhāti tmanāsya haviṣo yajeti devatā eva prīṇāti sam asya tanvā bhaveti punar evainaṃ saṃbhāvayati varṣīyo varṣīyasā iti tena yajamāno vasīyān bhavati yad yajñaṃ paśum āhur yat tam abhimanyante kva tarhi yajño bhavatīti yad āha yajñaṃ yajñapatau dhā iti yajñapatau vā etad yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyātha paśum ālabhante skandati vā etad dhavir yad viścotati yad vilipyate yat tṛṇam upāsyaty askannatvāya pratyañcaṃ saṃjñapayanti pratyañco hi paśavo medham upatiṣṭhanta udīcīnapādaṃ vyāvṛttyai ||
3.9.7.d: अग्निना वै मुखेन देवा इमांल् लोकान् अभ्यजयन् यत् पर्यग्निं करोत्य् अग्निना वा एतन् मुखेन यजमान इमांल् लोकान् अभिजयति रक्षांसि वा एतं जिघांसन्ति यत् पर्यग्निं करोति रक्षसाम् अपहत्यै त्रिः पर्यग्निं करोति त्रयो वा इमे लोका एभ्यो वा एतल् लोकेभ्यो यज्ञाद् रक्षांस्य् अपहन्ति चात्वालम् अपि पर्येत्य् एषा वा अग्नीनां योनिः स्कन्दति वा एतद् धविर् यद् विश्चोतति यद् विलिप्यते ऽग्निर् वै सर्वा देवता अत्र वै सापि देवता यस्या आलभ्यते यत् पर्यग्निं करोति ताम् एवैनद् गमयति कियद् वाहैतत् पशोः कियद् वा यत् प्रयाजा एतर्हि खलु वै सर्वो यर्ह्य् आप्रीतस् तस्माद् आश्राव्योपप्रेष्यति देवताभ्यो वै पूर्वम् आशुश्रवद् अथ वा अत्र पशोर् आश्रावयति तस्माद् आश्राव्योपप्रेष्यत्य् उभये वा एतं बध्यमानम् अनुबध्यन्ते ये ग्राम्याः पशवो ये चारण्या ये बध्यमानम् अनु बध्यमाना अन्वैक्षन्त मनसेति यज् जुहोति तेषां वा एषोन्मोक्षा यन् न जुहुयाद् अनुन्मुक्ताः स्युर् उर्व् अन्तरिक्षं वीहीत्य् अन्तरिक्षदेवत्यो वा एष एतर्हि रक्षांसि वा एतं जिघांसन्ति प्रच्युतम् इतो ऽप्राप्तम् अमुत्राग्निं पुरस्ताद् धरन्ति रक्षसां पराणुत्त्यै रक्षसाम् अपहत्यय् अथो हव्याय वा एतत् प्रणीयमानाय देवताः पुरस्ताद् धरन्त्य् अग्निं पुरस्तान् निदधात्य् अस्कन्नत्वाय पशोर् वै मारणायानीयमानस्याहवनीयं मेध्यो ऽभ्युपक्रामति यो वै तर्हि पशुम् अन्वारभते तं यज्ञस्याशीर् गछति यद् आह रेवति प्रेधा यज्ञपतिम् आविशेति यत्र वा एतत् क्वच यजमानं सन्तं यज्ञस्याशीर् गछति वपाश्रपणीभ्याम् अन्वारभते तत् स्विद् उभयम् अकर् उरो अन्तरिक्ष सजूर् देवेन वातेनेत्य् अन्तरिक्षं वै पशवो वातः प्राणः प्राणान् अस्मिन् दधाति त्मनास्य हविषो यजेति देवता एव प्रीणाति सम् अस्य तन्वा भवेति पुनर् एवैनं संभावयति वर्षीयो वर्षीयसा इति तेन यजमानो वसीयान् भवति यद् यज्ञं पशुम् आहुर् यत् तम् अभिमन्यन्ते क्व तर्हि यज्ञो भवतीति यद् आह यज्ञं यज्ञपतौ धा इति यज्ञपतौ वा एतद् यज्ञं प्रतिष्ठाप्याथ पशुम् आलभन्ते स्कन्दति वा एतद् धविर् यद् विश्चोतति यद् विलिप्यते यत् तृणम् उपास्यत्य् अस्कन्नत्वाय प्रत्यञ्चं संज्ञपयन्ति प्रत्यञ्चो हि पशवो मेधम् उपतिष्ठन्त उदीचीनपादं व्यावृत्त्यै ॥
3.9.7.m:
With Agni as the face, the gods conquered these worlds.
When he carries fire around [the victim],
with Agni as the face the sacrificer conquers these worlds.
The rakṣases desire to slay him.
When he carries fire around,
[it is] for the warding off of the rakṣases.
Three times he carries fire around;
three indeed are these worlds.
From these worlds, from the sacrifice, he wards off the rakṣases.
He also goes around the pit;
this is indeed the womb of the fires.
That oblation is spilled which trickles, which is smeared.
Agni is all the deities;
here indeed is also that deity for whom [the animal] is seized.
When he carries fire around,
he causes it to reach that very [deity].
How much is this of the animal?
How much when there are the preliminary offerings?
Now indeed it is whole when it is appeased by the Āprī verses.
Therefore, having caused [the Āgnīdhra] to call, he prompts.
To the deities he previously responded;
now indeed he causes a call for the animal here.
Therefore, having caused [him] to call, he prompts.
Both of them are bound after him being bound: whatever domestic animals there are and whatever wild.
When he offers: "They who being bound looked after the bound one with their mind,"
this is their release.
If he should not offer, they would not be released.
"Go to the wide atmosphere!" [he says].
Having the atmosphere as deity is he now.
The rakṣases desire to slay him, displaced from here, not arrived there.
They carry fire in front
for driving away the rakṣases, for warding off the rakṣases.
Moreover, they carry the deities in front for him being brought as an oblation.
He deposits fire in front
for non-spilling.
When the victim is being led for killing, the fit for sacrifice approaches the Āhavanīya fire.
Whoever then holds on to the victim, to him goes the blessing of the sacrifice.
When he says:
"Rich one, move forward! Enter the lord of the sacrifice!"
wherever the sacrificer is, there the blessing of the sacrifice reaches him.
He holds on with the two omentum-spits;
he has thus performed both.
"O wide atmosphere, united with divine wind," [he says];
the atmosphere indeed is cattle;
wind is breath;
he places breaths in him.
"Sacrifice by yourself this oblation!" [he says];
he pleases the deities themselves.
"Be united with his body!" [he says];
he brings him into being again.
"Higher with the higher," [he says];
thereby the sacrificer becomes better.
When they say the sacrifice is an animal, when they harm it, where then is the sacrifice?
When he says:
"Place the sacrifice in the lord of the sacrifice!"
having established the sacrifice in the lord of the sacrifice, they then seize the victim.
That oblation is spilled which trickles, which is smeared.
When he throws down a blade of grass,
[it is] for non-spilling.
They quiet [the animal] facing west;
for facing west cattle approach the sacrificial victim.
With its feet to the north,
for separation.

3.9.8.s: ṛtvijo vṛṇīte chandāṃsi vā ṛtvijaś chandāṃsi vā etad vṛṇīte yad dhotāraṃ vṛṇīte jagatīṃ tad vṛṇīte yad adhvaryuṃ paṅktiṃ tad yad agnīdham atichandasaṃ tad yan maitrāvaruṇaṃ gāyatrīṃ tad yad brāhmaṇāñśaṃsinaṃ triṣṭubhaṃ tad yat potāram uṣṇihaṃ tad yan neṣṭāraṃ kakubhaṃ tad yad āha || agnir daivīnāṃ viśāṃ puraetā || iti yajamānaṃ vā etad vṛṇīte sa vṛto vaṣaṭkaroti nāchāvākaṃ vṛṇīte paścājeva vā eṣā hotrāḥ svargyā yad achāvākyā dvidevatyāḥ śaṃsati dvipād yajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityay atha yad agnīdhaṃ madhyato vṛṇīte tasmād ayam agnir madhyata oṣadhīnāṃ yad uttamaḥ saṃyajatāṃ saṃyajati tasmād upariṣṭān mathyamānaḥ prajāyata etad vā asya chandāṃsi vṛtāni yuktāny abhūvan yad avṛtā vaṣaṭkuryur bhrātṛvyaṃ yajñasyāśīr gached atha yad vṛtā vaṣaṭkurvanty ekadhā vā etad yajamāne yajñasyāśīḥ pratitiṣṭhati tasmād ekaḥ paśor vaṣaṭkaroty ekaṃ hi vṛṇute daśa vai paśor devatā daśāsmin prāṇā yad daśa prayājā yā evāsmin devatās tā etad yajaty atha ya eṣa ekādaśo yasyā eva devatāyai paśur ālabhyate tām evaitad yajaty atha yad ekādaśānuyājā yā evaitad devatā ayākṣīt tā etair anuprīṇāti hato vā eṣa mṛto 'mutra bhūto daśa vai paśor devatā daśāsmin prāṇāḥ prāṇāḥ khalu vai paśor devatā yad daśa prayājāḥ prāṇān evāsya prayajaty ātmā vai prāṇānām ekādaśa ātmā vapā paśor yad eṣa ekādaśaḥ pariśaya ātmā vā etad ātmānaṃ pariśaye 'tha yad ekādaśānuyājāḥ prāṇān asmin dadhāti || iti tṛtīyakāḍṇe navamaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ ||
3.9.8.d: ऋत्विजो वृणीते छन्दांसि वा ऋत्विजश् छन्दांसि वा एतद् वृणीते यद् धोतारं वृणीते जगतीं तद् वृणीते यद् अध्वर्युं पङ्क्तिं तद् यद् अग्नीधम् अतिछन्दसं तद् यन् मैत्रावरुणं गायत्रीं तद् यद् ब्राह्मणाञ्शंसिनं त्रिष्टुभं तद् यत् पोतारम् उष्णिहं तद् यन् नेष्टारं ककुभं तद् यद् आह ॥ अग्निर् दैवीनां विशां पुरएता ॥ इति यजमानं वा एतद् वृणीते स वृतो वषट्करोति नाछावाकं वृणीते पश्चाजेव वा एषा होत्राः स्वर्ग्या यद् अछावाक्या द्विदेवत्याः शंसति द्विपाद् यजमानः प्रतिष्ठित्यय् अथ यद् अग्नीधं मध्यतो वृणीते तस्माद् अयम् अग्निर् मध्यत ओषधीनां यद् उत्तमः संयजतां संयजति तस्माद् उपरिष्टान् मथ्यमानः प्रजायत एतद् वा अस्य छन्दांसि वृतानि युक्तान्य् अभूवन् यद् अवृता वषट्कुर्युर् भ्रातृव्यं यज्ञस्याशीर् गछेद् अथ यद् वृता वषट्कुर्वन्त्य् एकधा वा एतद् यजमाने यज्ञस्याशीः प्रतितिष्ठति तस्माद् एकः पशोर् वषट्करोत्य् एकं हि वृणुते दश वै पशोर् देवता दशास्मिन् प्राणा यद् दश प्रयाजा या एवास्मिन् देवतास् ता एतद् यजत्य् अथ य एष एकादशो यस्या एव देवतायै पशुर् आलभ्यते ताम् एवैतद् यजत्य् अथ यद् एकादशानुयाजा या एवैतद् देवता अयाक्षीत् ता एतैर् अनुप्रीणाति हतो वा एष मृतो ऽमुत्र भूतो दश वै पशोर् देवता दशास्मिन् प्राणाः प्राणाः खलु वै पशोर् देवता यद् दश प्रयाजाः प्राणान् एवास्य प्रयजत्य् आत्मा वै प्राणानाम् एकादश आत्मा वपा पशोर् यद् एष एकादशः परिशय आत्मा वा एतद् आत्मानं परिशये ऽथ यद् एकादशानुयाजाः प्राणान् अस्मिन् दधाति ॥ इति तृतीयकाड्णे नवमः प्रपाठकः ॥
3.9.8.m:
He chooses the priests.
The metres are indeed the priests;
he chooses the metres.
When he chooses the Hotṛ, he chooses the jagatī;
when the Adhvaryu, the paṅkti;
when the Āgnīdhra, the atichandas;
when the Maitrāvaruṇa, the gāyatrī;
when the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, the triṣṭubh;
when the Potṛ, the uṣṇih;
when the Neṣṭṛ, the kakubh.
When he says:
"Agni, leader of the divine clans,"
he chooses the sacrificer.
He, chosen, utters the vaṣaṭ.
He does not choose the Acchāvāka;
she is as it were born after.
The Hotṛ-offices are heavenly.
When the Acchāvāka recites [verses] addressed to two deities,
[it is] for the firm support of the two-footed sacrificer.
Now, in that he chooses the Āgnīdhra from the middle,
therefore this Agni is in the middle of plants.
In that as the last of those who sacrifice together he sacrifices together,
therefore being churned from above he is born.
These metres of his became chosen, harnessed.
If unchosen they were to utter the vaṣaṭ, the blessing of the sacrifice would go to the rival.
Now, in that being chosen they utter the vaṣaṭ,
singly the blessing of the sacrifice stands firm in the sacrificer.
Therefore one utters the vaṣaṭ for the animal;
for he chooses one.
Ten indeed are the deities of the animal;
ten are the breaths in him.
In that there are ten preliminary offerings,
whatever deities are in him, those he sacrifices to.
Now, this eleventh one:
to whatever deity the animal is seized, to that one he sacrifices.
Now, in that there are eleven after-offerings,
whatever deities he sacrificed to, those he pleases afterwards with these.
Slain indeed is he, dead, having gone to that world.
Ten indeed are the deities of the animal;
ten are the breaths in him.
The breaths are indeed the deities of the animal.
In that there are ten preliminary offerings,
he offers before to his breaths.
The self is indeed the eleventh of the breaths;
the omentum is the self of the animal.
In that this eleventh one lies around,
the self indeed lies around the self.
Now, in that there are eleven after-offerings,
he places the breaths in him.
