śatadhārā utso duhe na kumbhī svadhāṃ pitṛbhyaḥ || mukhaṃ sadasya śirā it satena jihvā pavitram aśvināsant sarasvatī | capyaṃ na pāyur bhiṣag asya vālo vastir na śepo harasā tarasvī || aśvibhyāṃ cakṣur amṛtaṃ grahābhyāṃ chāgena tejo haviṣā ghṛtena | pakṣmāṇi godhṛmaiḥ kuvalair utāni peśo na śukram asitaṃ vasāte || avir na meṣo nasi vīryāya prāṇasya panthā amṛtaṃ grahābhyām | sarasvaty upavākair vyānaṃ nasyāni barhir badarair jajāna || indrasya rūpam ṛṣabho balāya karṇābhyāṃ śrotram amṛtaṃ grahābhyām | yavair na barhir bhruvi kesarāṇi karkandhu jajñe madhu sāraghaṃ mukhe || ātmann upasthe na vṛkasya loma mukhe śmaśrūṇi na vyāghraloma | keśā na śīrṣan yaśase śriyai śikhā siṃhasya loma tviṣir indriyāṇi || aṅgair ātmānaṃ bhiṣajā tad aśvinātmānam aṅgaiḥ samadhāt sarasvatī | indrasya rūpaṃ śatamānam āyuḥ śukraṃ na jyotir amṛtaṃ dadhānā || sarasvatī yonyāṃ garbham antar aśvibhyāṃ patnī sukṛtaṃ bibharti | apāṃ rasena varuṇo na sāmnendraṃ śriyai janayann apsu rājā || tejaḥ paśūnāṃ havir indriyāvat parisrutā payasā sāraghaṃ madhu | aśvibhyāṃ dugdhaṃ bhiṣajā sarasvatī sutāsutābhyām amṛtaḥ somā induḥ ||
3.11.9.d: सीसेन तन्त्रं मनसा मनीषिण ऊर्णासूत्रेण कवयो वयन्ति । अश्विना यज्ञं सविता सरस्वतीन्द्रस्य रूपं वरुणो भिषज्यन् ॥ तद् अस्य रूपम् अमृतं शचीभिस् तिस्रो दधुर् देवताः संरराणाः । लोमानि शष्पैर् बहुधा न तोक्मभिस् त्वग् अस्य मांसम् अभवन् न लाजाः ॥ तद् अश्विना भिषजा रुद्रवर्तनी सरस्वती वयति पेशो अन्तरम् । अस्थि मज्जानं मासरं कारोतरेण दधतो गवां त्वचि ॥ सरस्वती मनसा पेशलं वसु नासत्याभ्यां वयति दर्शतं वपुः । रसं परिस्रुतो न रोहितं नग्नहुर् धीरस् तसरं न वेम ॥ पयसः शुक्रम् अमृतं जनित्रं सुराया मूत्राज् जनयन्त रेतः । अपामतिं दुर्मतिं बाधमाना ऊवध्यं वातात् सब्वं तद् आरात् ॥ इन्द्रः सुत्रामा हृदयेन सत्यं पुरोडाशेन सविता जजान । यकृत् क्लोमानं वरुणो भिषज्यन् मतस्ने वायव्यैर् न मिनाति पित्तम् ॥ आन्त्राणि स्थालीर् मधु पिन्वमाना गुदाः पात्राणि सुदुघा न धेनुः । श्येनस्य पत्त्रं न प्लीहा शचीभिर् आसन्दी नाभिर् उदरं न माता ॥ कुम्भो वनिष्ठुर् जनिता शचीभिर् यस्मिन्न् अग्रे योन्यां गर्भो अन्तः । प्लाशिर् व्यक्तः शतधारा उत्सो दुहे न कुम्भी स्वधां पितृभ्यः ॥ मुखं सदस्य शिरा इत् सतेन जिह्वा पवित्रम् अश्विनासन्त् सरस्वती । चप्यं न पायुर् भिषग् अस्य वालो वस्तिर् न शेपो हरसा तरस्वी ॥ अश्विभ्यां चक्षुर् अमृतं ग्रहाभ्यां छागेन तेजो हविषा घृतेन । पक्ष्माणि गोधृमैः कुवलैर् उतानि पेशो न शुक्रम् असितं वसाते ॥ अविर् न मेषो नसि वीर्याय प्राणस्य पन्था अमृतं ग्रहाभ्याम् । सरस्वत्य् उपवाकैर् व्यानं नस्यानि बर्हिर् बदरैर् जजान ॥ इन्द्रस्य रूपम् ऋषभो बलाय कर्णाभ्यां श्रोत्रम् अमृतं ग्रहाभ्याम् । यवैर् न बर्हिर् भ्रुवि केसराणि कर्कन्धु जज्ञे मधु सारघं मुखे ॥ आत्मन्न् उपस्थे न वृकस्य लोम मुखे श्मश्रूणि न व्याघ्रलोम । केशा न शीर्षन् यशसे श्रियै शिखा सिंहस्य लोम त्विषिर् इन्द्रियाणि ॥ अङ्गैर् आत्मानं भिषजा तद् अश्विनात्मानम् अङ्गैः समधात् सरस्वती । इन्द्रस्य रूपं शतमानम् आयुः शुक्रं न ज्योतिर् अमृतं दधाना ॥ सरस्वती योन्यां गर्भम् अन्तर् अश्विभ्यां पत्नी सुकृतं बिभर्ति । अपां रसेन वरुणो न साम्नेन्द्रं श्रियै जनयन्न् अप्सु राजा ॥ तेजः पशूनां हविर् इन्द्रियावत् परिस्रुता पयसा सारघं मधु । अश्विभ्यां दुग्धं भिषजा सरस्वती सुतासुताभ्याम् अमृतः सोमा इन्दुः ॥
3.11.9.m: With lead the wise weave the warp with the mind, the poets with woolen thread; / the two Aśvins the sacrifice, Savitar, Sarasvatī, Varuṇa healing the form of Indra. / That immortal form of his the three goddesses bestowed, being gracious through their arts; / his hairs [became] like tender shoots, multiplied like malt-sprouts; his skin, his flesh became like fried rice. / Then the two Aśvins, the physicians of Rudra-paths, and Sarasvatī weave the internal form, / placing bone, marrow, māsara-liquor in the hide of cows through the wine-strainer. / Sarasvatī with the mind weaves the beautiful treasure, the wonderful body for the two Nāsatyas, / like the red sap of flowing [liquor], [as] the wise [weaver] with ferment [weaves] the shuttle, the loom. / From milk the bright, immortal birthplace; from the urine of liquor they produced semen, / warding off ill-will, hostile thought, [casting] the chyme far away from the body from the wind. / Indra, the good protector, with his heart [produced] truth, Savitar produced [it] with the puroḍāśa; / Varuṇa healing the liver, the lungs, does not injure the bile with the kidneys, as with the Vāyu-cups. / The intestines are cooking pots swelling with honey; the guts are vessels, like an easy-milking cow; / like the feather of a hawk is the spleen through [their] arts; the throne is the navel, the belly like a mother. / The vessel is the rectum, the generator through [their] arts, in which at first the embryo is within the womb; / the bladder is distinguished, a fountain of a hundred streams, as a pot yields the Svadhā to the fathers. / The face is of the assembly-hall, the head with the dish; the tongue is the strainer; the Aśvins are the mouth, Sarasvatī [the voice]; / like a ladle is the anus, his healer the hair; like a bladder is the penis, swift with heat. / With the two Aśvins immortal sight [arose] through the two cups, brilliance through the goat, through the oblation, through the ghee; / the eyelashes are woven with wheat, with jujube-berries; as an ornament they put on the white and black [of the eye]. / Like a sheep, a ram in the nostril for virility, the immortal path of breath through the two cups; / Sarasvatī with upavāka-grains produced the out-breath, with badara-berries the nasal hairs, the barhis. / The bull is the form of Indra for strength; immortal hearing in the ears through the two cups; / like barley the barhis on the eyebrow, the bristles; wild-honey formed in the mouth like karkandhu-fruit. / On the trunk, on the lap [the hair is] like the wolf's hair; on the face the beard like the tiger's hair; / the hair on the head [is] for glory, for splendor; the crest, the hair of the lion, is brilliance, faculties. / With the limbs the two Aśvins, the physicians, then [healed] the self; Sarasvatī joined the self with the limbs, / bestowing the form of Indra, a lifetime of a hundred measures, like bright, immortal light. / Sarasvatī, the wife, bears within the womb the well-formed embryo for the two Aśvins; / as Varuṇa with the sap of the waters, with the chant, the king generating Indra in the waters for splendor. / The brilliance of animals, an oblation rich in faculty, with flowing liquor, with milk the wild-honey, / milked by the two Aśvins, the physicians, and Sarasvatī, through the pressed and unpressed [drinks] is Soma the immortal drop.

3.11.10.s: punantu mā pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ punantu mā pitāmahāḥ | pavitreṇa śatāyuṣā viśvam āyur vyaśnavai || punantu mā pitāmahāḥ punantu prapitāmahāḥ | pavitreṇa śatāyuṣā sarvam āyur vyaśnavai || agnā āyūṃṣi pavase || pavamānaḥ svar janaḥ pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ | yaḥ potā sa punātu mā || punantu mā devajanāḥ punantu manavo dhiyā | punantu viśvā bhūtā mā jātavedaḥ punāhi mā || pavamānaḥ punātu mā kratve dakṣāya jīvase | jyok ca sūryaṃ dṛśe || ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ pavitreṇa savena ca | māṃ punāhi viśvataḥ || pavitreṇa punāhi mā śukreṇa deva dīdyat | agne kratvā kratūṃr anu || yat te pavitram arciṣy agne vitatam antarā | brahma tena punīmahe || vaiśvadevī punatī devy āgād yasyā bahvyas tanvo vītapṛṣṭhāḥ | tayā madantaḥ sadhamādyeṣu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām || vaiśvānaro raśmibhir mā punātu vātaḥ prāṇeneṣiro mayobhūḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī payasā payobhir ṛtāvarī yajñiye mā punītām || bṛhadbhiḥ savitas tribhir varṣiṣṭhair deva manmabhiḥ | agne dakṣaiḥ punīmahe || ye samānāḥ samanasaḥ pitaro yamarājye | teṣāṃ lokaḥ svadhā namo yajño deveṣu kalpatām || ye samānāḥ samanaso jīvā jīveṣu māmakāḥ | teṣāṃ śrīr mayi kalpatām asmiṃl loke śataṃ samāḥ || dve srutī || idaṃ haviḥ prajananaṃ me astu daśavīraṃ sarvagaṇaṃ svastaye | ātmasani prajāsani kṣetrasani paśusani lokasany abhayasani || agniḥ prajāṃ bahulāṃ me kṛṇotv annaṃ payo reto asmāsu dhehi || yad devā devaheḍanaṃ devāsaś cakṛmā vayam | agnir mā tasmād enaso viśvān muñcatv aṃhasaḥ || yadi svapan yadi jāgrad enāṃsi cakṛmā vayam | vāyur mā tasmād enaso viśvān muñcatv aṃhasaḥ || yadi divā yadi naktam enāṃsi cakṛmā vayam | sūryo mā tasmād enaso viśvān muñcatv aṃhasaḥ || dhāmnodhāmno || yad grāme || pavitram asi yajñasya pavitraṃ yajamānasya | tan mā punātu sarvato viśvasmād devakilbiṣāt sarvasmād devakilbiṣāt || drupadād iven mumucānaḥ svinnaḥ snātvī malād iva | pūtaṃ pavitreṇevājyaṃ viśve muñcantu mainasaḥ || samāvṛtat pṛthivī sam uṣāḥ sam u sūryaḥ | vaiśvānarajyotir bhūyāsaṃ vibhuṃ kāmaṃ vyaśīya bhūḥ svāhā ||
3.11.10.d: पुनन्तु मा पितरः सोम्यासः पुनन्तु मा पितामहाः । पवित्रेण शतायुषा विश्वम् आयुर् व्यश्नवै ॥ पुनन्तु मा पितामहाः पुनन्तु प्रपितामहाः । पवित्रेण शतायुषा सर्वम् आयुर् व्यश्नवै ॥ अग्ना आयूंषि पवसे ॥ पवमानः स्वर् जनः पवित्रेण विचर्षणिः । यः पोता स पुनातु मा ॥ पुनन्तु मा देवजनाः पुनन्तु मनवो धिया । पुनन्तु विश्वा भूता मा जातवेदः पुनाहि मा ॥ पवमानः पुनातु मा क्रत्वे दक्षाय जीवसे । ज्योक् च सूर्यं दृशे ॥ उभाभ्यां देव सवितः पवित्रेण सवेन च । मां पुनाहि विश्वतः ॥ पवित्रेण पुनाहि मा शुक्रेण देव दीद्यत् । अग्ने क्रत्वा क्रतूंर् अनु ॥ यत् ते पवित्रम् अर्चिष्य् अग्ने विततम् अन्तरा । ब्रह्म तेन पुनीमहे ॥ वैश्वदेवी पुनती देव्य् आगाद् यस्या बह्व्यस् तन्वो वीतपृष्ठाः । तया मदन्तः सधमाद्येषु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥ वैश्वानरो रश्मिभिर् मा पुनातु वातः प्राणेनेषिरो मयोभूः । द्यावापृथिवी पयसा पयोभिर् ऋतावरी यज्ञिये मा पुनीताम् ॥ बृहद्भिः सवितस् त्रिभिर् वर्षिष्ठैर् देव मन्मभिः । अग्ने दक्षैः पुनीमहे ॥ ये समानाः समनसः पितरो यमराज्ये । तेषां लोकः स्वधा नमो यज्ञो देवेषु कल्पताम् ॥ ये समानाः समनसो जीवा जीवेषु मामकाः । तेषां श्रीर् मयि कल्पताम् अस्मिंल् लोके शतं समाः ॥ द्वे स्रुती ॥ इदं हविः प्रजननं मे अस्तु दशवीरं सर्वगणं स्वस्तये । आत्मसनि प्रजासनि क्षेत्रसनि पशुसनि लोकसन्य् अभयसनि ॥ अग्निः प्रजां बहुलां मे कृणोत्व् अन्नं पयो रेतो अस्मासु धेहि ॥ यद् देवा देवहेडनं देवासश् चकृमा वयम् । अग्निर् मा तस्माद् एनसो विश्वान् मुञ्चत्व् अंहसः ॥ यदि स्वपन् यदि जाग्रद् एनांसि चकृमा वयम् । वायुर् मा तस्माद् एनसो विश्वान् मुञ्चत्व् अंहसः ॥ यदि दिवा यदि नक्तम् एनांसि चकृमा वयम् । सूर्यो मा तस्माद् एनसो विश्वान् मुञ्चत्व् अंहसः ॥ धाम्नोधाम्नो ॥ यद् ग्रामे ॥ पवित्रम् असि यज्ञस्य पवित्रं यजमानस्य । तन् मा पुनातु सर्वतो विश्वस्माद् देवकिल्बिषात् सर्वस्माद् देवकिल्बिषात् ॥ द्रुपदाद् इवेन् मुमुचानः स्विन्नः स्नात्वी मलाद् इव । पूतं पवित्रेणेवाज्यं विश्वे मुञ्चन्तु मैनसः ॥ समावृतत् पृथिवी सम् उषाः सम् उ सूर्यः । वैश्वानरज्योतिर् भूयासं विभुं कामं व्यशीय भूः स्वाहा ॥
3.11.10.m: May the Soma-loving fathers purify me; may the grandfathers purify me! / With a strainer of a hundredfold lifetime may I attain the full lifetime! / May the grandfathers purify me; may the great-grandfathers purify me! / With a strainer of a hundredfold lifetime may I attain all lifetime! / O Agni, you clarify lifetimes. / The purifying one, heavenly folk, far-looking with the strainer, / who is the purifier, let him purify me! / May the divine folk purify me; may the Manus purify [me] through thought! / May all beings purify me; O Jātavedas, purify me! / Let the purifying one purify me for resolve, for skill, to live, / and long to see the sun! / With both, O god Savitar, with the strainer and with your impulse, / purify me from all sides! / With the strainer purify me, with the bright [light], O god shining, / O Agni, through resolve according to resolves! / What strainer is stretched within your flame, O Agni, / with that sacred word we purify ourselves. / The purifying goddess belonging to all the gods has come, whose many bodies are smoothed-backed; / rejoicing with her in the common feasts, may we be masters of wealth! / May Vaiśvānara purify me with his rays, the wind with breath, energetic, causing delight; / may Heaven and Earth, righteous, worthy of sacrifice, purify me with milk, with milks! / With the three great, highest thoughts, O god Savitar, / O Agni, with skills we purify ourselves. / Those fathers who are equals, like-minded, in the realm of Yama— / let their world, the Svadhā, homage, the sacrifice be prepared among the gods! / Those of mine who are equals, like-minded, living among the living— / let their fortune be prepared in me for a hundred years in this world! / Two paths […]. / Let this oblation be productive of offspring for me, having ten heroes, an entire host, for well-being: / winning the self, winning offspring, winning fields, winning cattle, winning the world, winning safety! / Let Agni make my offspring abundant; place food, milk, semen in us! / If we have committed an offense against the gods, O gods, / let Agni free me from that sin, from every distress! / If sleeping, if awake, we have committed sins, / let Vāyu free me from that sin, from every distress! / If by day, if by night, we have committed sins, / let Sūrya free me from that sin, from every distress! / From abode to abode […]. / What in the village […]. / You are the strainer of the sacrifice, the strainer of the sacrificer; / let that purify me completely from every sin against the gods, / from all sin against the gods! / As if freed from a wooden post, as one who has sweated [is freed] from dirt after bathing, / purified like ghee through a strainer, let the All-Gods free me from sin! / Earth has turned; dawn [has turned]; sun [has turned]. / May I become one whose light is Vaiśvānara; may I attain pervasive desire! / Bhūḥ, svāhā!

3.11.11.s: samiddho agniḥ samidhā susamiddho vareṇyaḥ | gāyatrī chanda indriyaṃ triyavir gaur vayo dadhuḥ || tanūnapāñ śucivratas tanūpāś ca sarasvatī uṣṇik chanda indriyaṃ dityavāḍ gaur vayo dadhuḥ || iḍābhir agnir īḍyaḥ somo devo amartyaḥ | anuṣṭup chanda indriyaṃ pañcāvir gaur vayo dadhuḥ || subarhir agniḥ pūṣaṇvānt stīrṇabarhir amartyaḥ | bṛhatī chanda indriyaṃ trivatso gaur vayo dadhuḥ || duro devīr diśo mahīr brahmā devo bṛhaspatiḥ | paṅktiś chanda indriyaṃ turyavāḍ gaur vayo dadhuḥ || uṣe yahvī supeśasā viśve devā amartyāḥ | triṣṭup chanda indriyaṃ pṛṣṭhavāḍ gaur vayo dadhuḥ || daivyā hotārā bhiṣajendreṇa sayujā yujā | jagatī chanda indriyam anaḍvān gaur vayo dadhuḥ || tisro devīr iḍā mahī bhāratī maruto viśaḥ | virāṭ chanda indriyaṃ dhenur gaur na vayo dadhuḥ || tvaṣṭā turīpo adbhuta indrāgnī puṣṭivardhanā | dvipadā chanda indriyam ukṣā gaur na vayo dadhuḥ || śamitā no vanaspatiḥ savitā prasuvan bhagam | kakup chanda ihendriyam ṛṣabho gaur vayo dadhuḥ || svāhā yajñaṃ varuṇaḥ sukṣatro bheṣajaṃ karat | atichandā indriyaṃ bṛhad vaśā vehad vayo dadhuḥ ||
3.11.11.d: समिद्धो अग्निः समिधा सुसमिद्धो वरेण्यः । गायत्री छन्द इन्द्रियं त्रियविर् गौर् वयो दधुः ॥ तनूनपाञ् शुचिव्रतस् तनूपाश् च सरस्वती उष्णिक् छन्द इन्द्रियं दित्यवाड् गौर् वयो दधुः ॥ इडाभिर् अग्निर् ईड्यः सोमो देवो अमर्त्यः । अनुष्टुप् छन्द इन्द्रियं पञ्चाविर् गौर् वयो दधुः ॥ सुबर्हिर् अग्निः पूषण्वान्त् स्तीर्णबर्हिर् अमर्त्यः । बृहती छन्द इन्द्रियं त्रिवत्सो गौर् वयो दधुः ॥ दुरो देवीर् दिशो महीर् ब्रह्मा देवो बृहस्पतिः । पङ्क्तिश् छन्द इन्द्रियं तुर्यवाड् गौर् वयो दधुः ॥ उषे यह्वी सुपेशसा विश्वे देवा अमर्त्याः । त्रिष्टुप् छन्द इन्द्रियं पृष्ठवाड् गौर् वयो दधुः ॥ दैव्या होतारा भिषजेन्द्रेण सयुजा युजा । जगती छन्द इन्द्रियम् अनड्वान् गौर् वयो दधुः ॥ तिस्रो देवीर् इडा मही भारती मरुतो विशः । विराट् छन्द इन्द्रियं धेनुर् गौर् न वयो दधुः ॥ त्वष्टा तुरीपो अद्भुत इन्द्राग्नी पुष्टिवर्धना । द्विपदा छन्द इन्द्रियम् उक्षा गौर् न वयो दधुः ॥ शमिता नो वनस्पतिः सविता प्रसुवन् भगम् । ककुप् छन्द इहेन्द्रियम् ऋषभो गौर् वयो दधुः ॥ स्वाहा यज्ञं वरुणः सुक्षत्रो भेषजं करत् । अतिछन्दा इन्द्रियं बृहद् वशा वेहद् वयो दधुः ॥
3.11.11.m: Kindled with firewood, well kindled, choice is Agni; / the gāyatrī metre, faculty, a three-year-old steer, they placed [as his] vigor. / Tanūnapāt of pure vows, and Tanūpā, and Sarasvatī; / the uṣṇih metre, faculty, a two-and-a-half-year-old steer, they placed [as his] vigor. / With refreshments Agni is to be praised, god Soma, immortal; / the anuṣṭubh metre, faculty, a five-year-old steer, they placed [as his] vigor. / Having fair barhis is Agni, accompanied by Pūṣan, strewed with barhis, immortal; / the bṛhatī metre, faculty, a three-year-old steer, they placed [as his] vigor. / The divine doors, the great quarters, Bṛhaspati the divine priest; / the paṅkti metre, faculty, a four-year-old steer, they placed [as his] vigor. / Dawn and Night, youthful, well-adorned, the All-gods, immortal; / the triṣṭubh metre, faculty, a draft-ox, they placed [as his] vigor. / The two divine Hotars, the physicians, with Indra as companion, the pair; / the jagatī metre, faculty, a draft-bull, they placed [as his] vigor. / The three goddesses, Iḍā the great, Bhāratī, the Maruts the clans; / the virāj metre, faculty, like a milch-cow, they placed [as his] vigor. / Tvaṣṭar, vigorous, wondrous, Indra-Agni, increasers of nourishment; / the dvipadā metre, faculty, like a bull, they placed [as his] vigor. / May the Tree be our slaughterer, Savitar bringing forth fortune; / the kakubh metre, here faculty, a bull, they placed [as his] vigor. / Svāhā! May Varuṇa of good dominion make the sacrifice a medicine; / the atichandas metre, great faculty, a barren cow, an aborted cow, they placed [as his] vigor.

3.11.12.s: vasantena ṛtunā devā vasavas trivṛtā stutam | rathantareṇa tejasā havir indre vayo dadhuḥ || grīṣmeṇa ṛtunā devā rudrāḥ pañcadaśe stutam | bṛhatā yaśasā balaṃ havir indre vayo dadhuḥ || varṣābhir ṛtunādityāḥ stome saptadaśe stutam | vairūpeṇa viśaujasā havir indre vayo dadhuḥ || śāradena ṛtunā devā ekaviṃśa ṛbhavaḥ stutam | vairājena śriyā śriyaṃ havir indre vayo dadhuḥ || hemantena ṛtunā devās triṇave marutaḥ stutam | balena śakvarīḥ saho havir indre vayo dadhuḥ || śaiśireṇa ṛtunā devās trayastriṃśe 'mṛtaṃ stutam | satyena revatīḥ kṣatraṃ havir indre vayo dadhuḥ || iti tṛtīyakāṇḍe sautrāmaṇīyo nāma ekādaśaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ ||
3.11.12.d: वसन्तेन ऋतुना देवा वसवस् त्रिवृता स्तुतम् । रथन्तरेण तेजसा हविर् इन्द्रे वयो दधुः ॥ ग्रीष्मेण ऋतुना देवा रुद्राः पञ्चदशे स्तुतम् । बृहता यशसा बलं हविर् इन्द्रे वयो दधुः ॥ वर्षाभिर् ऋतुनादित्याः स्तोमे सप्तदशे स्तुतम् । वैरूपेण विशौजसा हविर् इन्द्रे वयो दधुः ॥ शारदेन ऋतुना देवा एकविंश ऋभवः स्तुतम् । वैराजेन श्रिया श्रियं हविर् इन्द्रे वयो दधुः ॥ हेमन्तेन ऋतुना देवास् त्रिणवे मरुतः स्तुतम् । बलेन शक्वरीः सहो हविर् इन्द्रे वयो दधुः ॥ शैशिरेण ऋतुना देवास् त्रयस्त्रिंशे ऽमृतं स्तुतम् । सत्येन रेवतीः क्षत्रं हविर् इन्द्रे वयो दधुः ॥ इति तृतीयकाण्डे सौत्रामणीयो नाम एकादशः प्रपाठकः ॥
3.11.12.m:
With the spring season the gods, the Vasus, praised with the trivṛt [stoma]; / with the Rathantara, with fiery brilliance, they placed the oblation, vigor, in Indra. / With the summer season the gods, the Rudras, praised in the fifteenfold [stoma]; / with the Bṛhat, with renown, power, they placed the oblation, vigor, in Indra. / With the rains as season the Ādityas, praised in the seventeenfold stoma; / with the Vairūpa, with clan-might, they placed the oblation, vigor, in Indra. / With the autumn season the gods, the Ṛbhus, praised in the twenty-onefold [stoma]; / with the Vairāja, with splendor, they placed splendor, the oblation, vigor, in Indra. / With the winter season the gods, the Maruts, praised in the thrice-ninefold [stoma]; / with might the śakvarī [verses], endurance, they placed the oblation, vigor, in Indra. / With the dewy season the gods, in the thirty-threefold [stoma], praised the immortal; / with truth the Revatī [verses], dominion, they placed the oblation, vigor, in Indra.
Thus ends the eleventh prapāṭhaka, named Sautrāmaṇī, in the third kāṇḍa.

3.12.1.s: imām agṛbhṇan raśanām ṛtasya pūrvā āyuni vidatheṣu kavyā | sā no asmint suta ābabhūva ṛtasya sāmant saram ārapantī || abhidhā asi bhuvanam asi yantāsi dhartā sa tvam agniṃ vaiśvānaraṃ saprathasaṃ gacha svāhākṛtaḥ svagā tvā devebhyaḥ prajāpataye brahmann aśvaṃ bhantsyāmi devebhyaḥ prajāpataye tena rādhyāsaṃ taṃ badhāna devebhyaḥ prajāpataye tena rādhnuhi prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi vāyave tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmīndrāgnibhyāṃ tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi viśvebhyas tvā devebhyo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi sarvebhyas tvā devebhyo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi || yo arvantaṃ jighāṃsati tam abhyamīti varuṇaḥ | paro martaḥ paraḥ śvā ||
3.12.1.d: इमाम् अगृभ्णन् रशनाम् ऋतस्य पूर्वा आयुनि विदथेषु कव्या । सा नो अस्मिन्त् सुत आबभूव ऋतस्य सामन्त् सरम् आरपन्ती ॥ अभिधा असि भुवनम् असि यन्तासि धर्ता स त्वम् अग्निं वैश्वानरं सप्रथसं गछ स्वाहाकृतः स्वगा त्वा देवेभ्यः प्रजापतये ब्रह्मन्न् अश्वं भन्त्स्यामि देवेभ्यः प्रजापतये तेन राध्यासं तं बधान देवेभ्यः प्रजापतये तेन राध्नुहि प्रजापतये त्वा जुष्टं प्रोक्षामि वायवे त्वा जुष्टं प्रोक्षामीन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा जुष्टं प्रोक्षामि विश्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यो जुष्टं प्रोक्षामि सर्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यो जुष्टं प्रोक्षामि ॥ यो अर्वन्तं जिघांसति तम् अभ्यमीति वरुणः । परो मर्तः परः श्वा ॥
3.12.1.m: They seized this halter of truth, ancient in lifetime at the gatherings, poet-inspired; / may it be present for us at this pressed [soma], proclaiming the flow at the edge of truth. / A binder you are. / A being you are. / A restrainer you are, a sustainer. / As such, made svāhā, go to Agni Vaiśvānara, far-extended! / Acceptable to the gods, to Prajāpati [are you]! / O Brahman, I shall bind the horse for the gods, for Prajāpati; / with it may I succeed! / Bind it for the gods, for Prajāpati; / with it do succeed! / I sprinkle you, welcome to Prajāpati! / I sprinkle you, welcome to Vāyu! / I sprinkle you, welcome to Indra and Agni! / I sprinkle you, welcome to the All-gods! / I sprinkle you, welcome to all the gods! / Whosoever seeks to harm the courser, him does Varuṇa afflict; / far away is the mortal, far away the dog!

3.12.2.s: agnaye svāhā somāya svāhāpāṃ modāya svāhā vāyave svāhā savitre svāhā tvaṣṭre svāhā bṛhaspataye svāhendrāya svāhā mitrāya svāhā varuṇāya svāhā ||
3.12.2.d: अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहापां मोदाय स्वाहा वायवे स्वाहा सवित्रे स्वाहा त्वष्ट्रे स्वाहा बृहस्पतये स्वाहेन्द्राय स्वाहा मित्राय स्वाहा वरुणाय स्वाहा ॥
3.12.2.m: To Agni, svāhā! / To Soma, svāhā! / To the joy of waters, svāhā! / To Vāyu, svāhā! / To Savitar, svāhā! / To Tvaṣṭar, svāhā! / To Bṛhaspati, svāhā! / To Indra, svāhā! / To Mitra, svāhā! / To Varuṇa, svāhā!

3.12.3.s: hiṃkārāya svāhā hiṃkṛtāya svāhā krandate svāhā avakrandāya svāhā prothate svāhā praprothāya svāhā gandhāya svāhā ghrātāya svāhā niviṣṭāya svāhopaviṣṭāya svāhā saṃditāya svāhā valgate svāhāsīnāya svāhā śayānāya svāhā svapate svāhā jāgrate svāhā kūjate svāhā prabuddhāya svāhā vicṛttāya svāhā vijṛmbhamāṇāya svāhā javāya svāhā balāya svāhāyanāya svāhā prāyaṇāya svāhā yate svāhā dhāvate svāhoddrāvāya svāhoddrutāya svāhā śūkārāya svāhā śūkṛtāya svāhopasthitāya svāhā saṃhānāya svāhā niṣaṇṇāya svāhotthitāya svāhā viṣṭhitāya svāha vivartamānāya svāhā vivṛttāya svāhā vidhūnvānāya svāhā vidhūtāya svāhā śṛṅvate svāhā śuśrūṣamāṇāya svāhekṣitāya svāhā vīkṣitāya svāhā vīkṣamāṇāya svāhā nimeṣāya svāhā yad atti tasmai svāhā yat pibati tasmai svāhā yan mehati tasmai svāhā kurvate svāhā kṛtāya svāhā ||
3.12.3.d: हिंकाराय स्वाहा हिंकृताय स्वाहा क्रन्दते स्वाहा अवक्रन्दाय स्वाहा प्रोथते स्वाहा प्रप्रोथाय स्वाहा गन्धाय स्वाहा घ्राताय स्वाहा निविष्टाय स्वाहोपविष्टाय स्वाहा संदिताय स्वाहा वल्गते स्वाहासीनाय स्वाहा शयानाय स्वाहा स्वपते स्वाहा जाग्रते स्वाहा कूजते स्वाहा प्रबुद्धाय स्वाहा विचृत्ताय स्वाहा विजृम्भमाणाय स्वाहा जवाय स्वाहा बलाय स्वाहायनाय स्वाहा प्रायणाय स्वाहा यते स्वाहा धावते स्वाहोद्द्रावाय स्वाहोद्द्रुताय स्वाहा शूकाराय स्वाहा शूकृताय स्वाहोपस्थिताय स्वाहा संहानाय स्वाहा निषण्णाय स्वाहोत्थिताय स्वाहा विष्ठिताय स्वाह विवर्तमानाय स्वाहा विवृत्ताय स्वाहा विधून्वानाय स्वाहा विधूताय स्वाहा शृङ्वते स्वाहा शुश्रूषमाणाय स्वाहेक्षिताय स्वाहा वीक्षिताय स्वाहा वीक्षमाणाय स्वाहा निमेषाय स्वाहा यद् अत्ति तस्मै स्वाहा यत् पिबति तस्मै स्वाहा यन् मेहति तस्मै स्वाहा कुर्वते स्वाहा कृताय स्वाहा ॥
3.12.3.m: To the sound hiṃ, svāhā! / To what has made the sound hiṃ, svāhā! / To the neighing one, svāhā! / To the neigh, svāhā! / To the snorting one, svāhā! / To the snort, svāhā! / To the scent, svāhā! / To what is smelled, svāhā! / To what has settled down, svāhā! / To what is seated, svāhā! / To what is bound, svāhā! / To what bounds, svāhā! / To what is sitting, svāhā! / To what is lying down, svāhā! / To what is sleeping, svāhā! / To what is waking, svāhā! / To what whickers, svāhā! / To what has awakened, svāhā! / To what is untied, svāhā! / To what is stretching itself, svāhā! / To speed, svāhā! / To strength, svāhā! / To approaching, svāhā! / To departing, svāhā! / To what moves, svāhā! / To what runs, svāhā! / To running up, svāhā! / To what has run up, svāhā! / To the sound śū, svāhā! / To what has made the sound śū, svāhā! / To what has come near, svāhā! / To gathering together, svāhā! / To what has sat down, svāhā! / To what has risen up, svāhā! / To what stands apart, svāhā! / To what rolls about, svāhā! / To what has rolled about, svāhā! / To what shakes itself, svāhā! / To what has shaken itself, svāhā! / To what listens, svāhā! / To what is attentive, svāhā! / To what is looked at, svāhā! / To what looks about, svāhā! / To what is gazing, svāhā! / To the blinking, svāhā! / To what he eats, to that svāhā! / To what he drinks, to that svāhā! / To what he urinates, to that svāhā! / To him doing, svāhā! / To what is done, svāhā!

3.12.4.s: vibhūr mātrā prabhūḥ pitrāśvo 'si hayo 'sy atyo 'si mayo 'si naro 'sy arvāsi saptir asi vājy asi vṛṣāsi nṛmaṇā asi yayur nāmāsy ādityānāṃ patvānvihi devā āśāpālā etaṃ devebhyo aśvaṃ medhāya prokṣitaṃ rakṣateha dhṛtir iha svadhṛtir iha rama iha ramantām ||
3.12.4.d: विभूर् मात्रा प्रभूः पित्राश्वो ऽसि हयो ऽस्य् अत्यो ऽसि मयो ऽसि नरो ऽस्य् अर्वासि सप्तिर् असि वाज्य् असि वृषासि नृमणा असि ययुर् नामास्य् आदित्यानां पत्वान्विहि देवा आशापाला एतं देवेभ्यो अश्वं मेधाय प्रोक्षितं रक्षतेह धृतिर् इह स्वधृतिर् इह रम इह रमन्ताम् ॥
3.12.4.m: Extensive through [your] mother, prevailing through [your] father, / a horse you are, / a steed you are, / a racer you are, / a joy you are, / a hero you are, / a courser you are, / a runner you are, / a prize-winner you are, / a bull you are, / of human mind you are, / Yayur by name you are. / Follow the flight of the Ādityas! / O gods, guardians of the quarters, protect this horse sprinkled for the sacrifice for the gods! / Here is steadfastness; / here is self-steadfastness; / here is delight; / here let them take delight!

3.12.5.s: kāya svāhā kasmai svāhā katamasmai svāhā savitre svāhā savitre prasavitre svāhā savitra āsavitre svāhādityai svāhādityai mahyai svāhādityai sumṛḍīkāyai svāhā sarasvatyai svāhā sarasvatyai bṛhatyai svāhā sarasvatyai pāvakāyai svāhā pūṣṇe svāhā pūṣṇe prapathyāya svāhā pūṣṇe naraṃdhiṣāya svāhā tvaṣṭre svāhā tvaṣṭre turīpāya svāhā tvaṣṭre parurūpāya svāhā viṣṇave svāhā viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya svāha viṣṇave nibhūyapāya svāhā ||
3.12.5.d: काय स्वाहा कस्मै स्वाहा कतमस्मै स्वाहा सवित्रे स्वाहा सवित्रे प्रसवित्रे स्वाहा सवित्र आसवित्रे स्वाहादित्यै स्वाहादित्यै मह्यै स्वाहादित्यै सुमृडीकायै स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै बृहत्यै स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै पावकायै स्वाहा पूष्णे स्वाहा पूष्णे प्रपथ्याय स्वाहा पूष्णे नरंधिषाय स्वाहा त्वष्ट्रे स्वाहा त्वष्ट्रे तुरीपाय स्वाहा त्वष्ट्रे परुरूपाय स्वाहा विष्णवे स्वाहा विष्णवे शिपिविष्टाय स्वाह विष्णवे निभूयपाय स्वाहा ॥
3.12.5.m: To Ka, svāhā! / To Whom, svāhā! / To Which, svāhā! / To Savitar, svāhā! / To Savitar the impeller, svāhā! / To Savitar the stimulator, svāhā! / To Aditi, svāhā! / To Aditi the great, svāhā! / To Aditi the most gracious, svāhā! / To Sarasvatī, svāhā! / To Sarasvatī the great, svāhā! / To Sarasvatī the purifying one, svāhā! / To Pūṣan, svāhā! / To Pūṣan of the distant path, svāhā! / To Pūṣan the protector of men, svāhā! / To Tvaṣṭar, svāhā! / To Tvaṣṭar the vigorous, svāhā! / To Tvaṣṭar of various forms, svāhā! / To Viṣṇu, svāhā! / To Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa, svāhā! / To Viṣṇu the protector of abundance, svāhā!

3.12.6.s: ā brahman brāhmaṇas tejasvī brahmavarcasī jāyatām ā rāṣṭre rājanyaḥ śūra iṣavyo mahāratho jāyatāṃ dogdhrī dhenur voḍhānaḍvān āśuḥ saptiḥ sabheyo yuvā puraṃdhir yoṣā jiṣṇū ratheṣṭhā āsya yajamānasya vīro jāyatāṃ nikāmenikāme naḥ parjanyo varṣatu phalavatīr nā oṣadhayaḥ pacyantāṃ yogakṣemo naḥ kalpatām ||
3.12.6.d: आ ब्रह्मन् ब्राह्मणस् तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी जायताम् आ राष्ट्रे राजन्यः शूर इषव्यो महारथो जायतां दोग्ध्री धेनुर् वोढानड्वान् आशुः सप्तिः सभेयो युवा पुरंधिर् योषा जिष्णू रथेष्ठा आस्य यजमानस्य वीरो जायतां निकामेनिकामे नः पर्जन्यो वर्षतु फलवतीर् ना ओषधयः पच्यन्तां योगक्षेमो नः कल्पताम् ॥
3.12.6.m:
In the priesthood may a Brahmin be born, radiant, rich in Brahman-splendor!
In the realm may a noble be born, a hero, a skilled archer, a great charioteer!
A milch-giving cow,
a draft-bull capable of pulling,
a swift runner,
a youth fit for the assembly,
a prolific young woman,
a victorious chariot-fighter!
May a hero be born to this sacrificer!
May Parjanya rain for us according to our desire!
May our plants ripen rich in fruit!
May our acquisition and possession succeed!

3.12.7.s: agnaye svāhā somāya svāhendrāya svāhā pṛthivyai svāhāntarikṣāya svāhā dive svāhā digbhyaḥ svāhāśābhyaḥ svāhorvyai diśe svāhā prācyai diśe svāhā nakṣatrebhyaḥ svāhā nakṣatriyebhyaḥ svāhāhorātrebhyaḥ svāhārdhamāsebhyaḥ svāhā māsebhyaḥ svāhā ṛtubhyaḥ svāhārtavebhyaḥ svāhā saṃvatsarāya svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ svāhā candramase svāhā sūryāya svāhā raśmibhyaḥ svāhā vasubhyaḥ svāhā rudrebhyaḥ svāhādityebhyaḥ svāhā marudbhyaḥ svāhā viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā mūlebhyaḥ svāhā śākhābhyaḥ svāhā vanaspatibhyaḥ svāhā puṣpebhyaḥ svāhā phalebhyaḥ svāhauṣadhībhyaḥ svāhā ||
3.12.7.d: अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहेन्द्राय स्वाहा पृथिव्यै स्वाहान्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा दिवे स्वाहा दिग्भ्यः स्वाहाशाभ्यः स्वाहोर्व्यै दिशे स्वाहा प्राच्यै दिशे स्वाहा नक्षत्रेभ्यः स्वाहा नक्षत्रियेभ्यः स्वाहाहोरात्रेभ्यः स्वाहार्धमासेभ्यः स्वाहा मासेभ्यः स्वाहा ऋतुभ्यः स्वाहार्तवेभ्यः स्वाहा संवत्सराय स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां स्वाहा चन्द्रमसे स्वाहा सूर्याय स्वाहा रश्मिभ्यः स्वाहा वसुभ्यः स्वाहा रुद्रेभ्यः स्वाहादित्येभ्यः स्वाहा मरुद्भ्यः स्वाहा विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः स्वाहा मूलेभ्यः स्वाहा शाखाभ्यः स्वाहा वनस्पतिभ्यः स्वाहा पुष्पेभ्यः स्वाहा फलेभ्यः स्वाहौषधीभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
3.12.7.m:
To Agni, svāhā!
To Soma, svāhā!
To Indra, svāhā!
To the earth, svāhā!
To the intermediate space, svāhā!
To heaven, svāhā!
To the quarters, svāhā!
To the intermediate directions, svāhā!
To the broad quarter, svāhā!
To the eastern quarter, svāhā!
To the asterisms, svāhā!
To those belonging to the asterisms, svāhā!
To day and night, svāhā!
To the half-months, svāhā!
To the months, svāhā!
To the seasons, svāhā!
To those belonging to the seasons, svāhā!
To the year, svāhā!
To heaven and earth, svāhā!
To the moon, svāhā!
To the sun, svāhā!
To the rays, svāhā!
To the Vasus, svāhā!
To the Rudras, svāhā!
To the Ādityas, svāhā!
To the Maruts, svāhā!
To the All-gods, svāhā!
To the roots, svāhā!
To the branches, svāhā!
To the lordly trees, svāhā!
To the flowers, svāhā!
To the fruits, svāhā!
To the plants, svāhā!

3.12.8.s: prācyai diśe svāhārvācyai diśe svāhā dakṣiṇāyai diśe svāhārvācyai diśe svāhā pratīcyai diśe svāhārvācyai diśe svāhodīcyai diśe svāhārvācyai diśe svāhordhvāyai diśe svāhārvācyai diśe svāhā ||
3.12.8.d: प्राच्यै दिशे स्वाहार्वाच्यै दिशे स्वाहा दक्षिणायै दिशे स्वाहार्वाच्यै दिशे स्वाहा प्रतीच्यै दिशे स्वाहार्वाच्यै दिशे स्वाहोदीच्यै दिशे स्वाहार्वाच्यै दिशे स्वाहोर्ध्वायै दिशे स्वाहार्वाच्यै दिशे स्वाहा ॥
3.12.8.m:
To the eastern quarter, svāhā!
To the facing quarter, svāhā!
To the southern quarter, svāhā!
To the facing quarter, svāhā!
To the western quarter, svāhā!
To the facing quarter, svāhā!
To the northern quarter, svāhā!
To the facing quarter, svāhā!
To the upward quarter, svāhā!
To the facing quarter, svāhā!

3.12.9.s: āyuṣe svāhā prāṇāya svāhāpānāya svāhā vyānāya svāhā samānāya svāhodānāya svāhā cakṣuṣe svāhā śrotrāya svāhā manase svāhā vāce svāhā ||
3.12.9.d: आयुषे स्वाहा प्राणाय स्वाहापानाय स्वाहा व्यानाय स्वाहा समानाय स्वाहोदानाय स्वाहा चक्षुषे स्वाहा श्रोत्राय स्वाहा मनसे स्वाहा वाचे स्वाहा ॥
3.12.9.m:
To life, svāhā!
To out-breath, svāhā!
To in-breath, svāhā!
To through-breath, svāhā!
To equalized breath, svāhā!
To up-breath, svāhā!
To the eye, svāhā!
To the ear, svāhā!
To the mind, svāhā!
To speech, svāhā!

3.12.10.s: pṛthivyai svāhāntarikṣāya svāhā dive svāhā sūryāya svāhā candramase svāhā nakṣatrebhyaḥ svāhādbhyaḥ svāhauṣadhībhyaḥ svāhā vanaspatibhyaḥ svāhā pariplavebhyaḥ svāhā sarīsṛpebhyaḥ svāhā carācarebhyaḥ svāhā ||
3.12.10.d: पृथिव्यै स्वाहान्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा दिवे स्वाहा सूर्याय स्वाहा चन्द्रमसे स्वाहा नक्षत्रेभ्यः स्वाहाद्भ्यः स्वाहौषधीभ्यः स्वाहा वनस्पतिभ्यः स्वाहा परिप्लवेभ्यः स्वाहा सरीसृपेभ्यः स्वाहा चराचरेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
3.12.10.m:
To the earth, svāhā!
To the intermediate space, svāhā!
To heaven, svāhā!
To the sun, svāhā!
To the moon, svāhā!
To the asterisms, svāhā!
To the waters, svāhā!
To the plants, svāhā!
To the lordly trees, svāhā!
To the swimming creatures, svāhā!
To the crawling creatures, svāhā!
To the moving and stationary creatures, svāhā!

3.12.11.s: asave svāhā vasave svāhā vibhve svāhā vivasvate svāhā gaṇaśriye svāhā gaṇapataye svāhābhiṣāhe svāhābhibhve svāhādhipataye svāhā śūṣāya svāhā saṃsarpāya svāhā candrāya svāhā jyotiṣe svāhā malimlucāya svāhā ||
3.12.11.d: असवे स्वाहा वसवे स्वाहा विभ्वे स्वाहा विवस्वते स्वाहा गणश्रिये स्वाहा गणपतये स्वाहाभिषाहे स्वाहाभिभ्वे स्वाहाधिपतये स्वाहा शूषाय स्वाहा संसर्पाय स्वाहा चन्द्राय स्वाहा ज्योतिषे स्वाहा मलिम्लुचाय स्वाहा ॥
3.12.11.m:
To life-energy, svāhā!
To the Vasu, svāhā!
To the far-reaching, svāhā!
To Vivasvat, svāhā!
To the one who brings splendor to the troop, svāhā!
To the lord of the troop, svāhā!
To the overcomer, svāhā!
To the superior, svāhā!
To the overlord, svāhā!
To vigor, svāhā!
To gliding [time], svāhā!
To the shining [moon], svāhā!
To light, svāhā!
To the intercalary month, svāhā!

3.12.12.s: dharṇasāya svāhā draviṇāya svāhā prasavāya svāhopayāmāya svāhā sindhave svāhā samudrāya svāhā kāṭāya svāhārṇavāya svāhā sarasvatyai svāhā viśvavyacase svāhā subhūtāya svāhāntarikṣāya svāhā ||
3.12.12.d: धर्णसाय स्वाहा द्रविणाय स्वाहा प्रसवाय स्वाहोपयामाय स्वाहा सिन्धवे स्वाहा समुद्राय स्वाहा काटाय स्वाहार्णवाय स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा विश्वव्यचसे स्वाहा सुभूताय स्वाहान्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा ॥
3.12.12.m:
To the supporter, svāhā!
To wealth, svāhā!
To procreation, svāhā!
To the Upayāma [vessel], svāhā!
To the river, svāhā!
To the sea, svāhā!
To the deep pit, svāhā!
To the surging flood, svāhā!
To Sarasvatī, svāhā!
To the all-encompassing, svāhā!
To prosperity, svāhā!
To the intermediate space, svāhā!

3.12.13.s: madhave svāhā mādhavāya svāhā śukrāya svāhā śucaye svāhā nabhase svāhā nabhasyāya svāheṣāya svāhorjāya svāhā sahase svāhā sahasyāya svāhā tapase svāhā tapasyāya svāhā saṃsarpo 'sy aṃhaspatyāya svāhā ||
3.12.13.d: मधवे स्वाहा माधवाय स्वाहा शुक्राय स्वाहा शुचये स्वाहा नभसे स्वाहा नभस्याय स्वाहेषाय स्वाहोर्जाय स्वाहा सहसे स्वाहा सहस्याय स्वाहा तपसे स्वाहा तपस्याय स्वाहा संसर्पो ऽस्य् अंहस्पत्याय स्वाहा ॥
3.12.13.m:
To Madhu, svāhā!
To Mādhava, svāhā!
To Śukra, svāhā!
To Śuci, svāhā!
To Nabhas, svāhā!
To Nabhasya, svāhā!
To Iṣa, svāhā!
To Ūrja, svāhā!
To Sahas, svāhā!
To Sahasya, svāhā!
To Tapas, svāhā!
To Tapasya, svāhā!
You are the gliding [month]!
To the lord of distress, svāhā!

3.12.14.s: savayase svāhābhivayase svāhordhvavayase svāhā bṛhadvayase svāhā sahīyase svāhā sahamānāya svāhā sāsahaye svāhā sahasvate svāhābhīṣāhe svāhābhibhve svāhābhimātiṣāhe svāhābhimātighne svāhā ||
3.12.14.d: सवयसे स्वाहाभिवयसे स्वाहोर्ध्ववयसे स्वाहा बृहद्वयसे स्वाहा सहीयसे स्वाहा सहमानाय स्वाहा सासहये स्वाहा सहस्वते स्वाहाभीषाहे स्वाहाभिभ्वे स्वाहाभिमातिषाहे स्वाहाभिमातिघ्ने स्वाहा ॥
3.12.14.m:
To the companion of like age, svāhā!
To superior strength, svāhā!
To lofty vigor, svāhā!
To great vigor, svāhā!
To the more powerful, svāhā!
To the enduring one, svāhā!
To the prevailing one, svāhā!
To the mighty one, svāhā!
To the conqueror, svāhā!
To the superior one, svāhā!
To the conqueror of foes, svāhā!
To the slayer of foes, svāhā!

3.12.15.s: ekasmai svāhā dvābhyāṃ svāhaikānnaśatāya svāhā śatāya svāhaikaśatāya svāhā vyuṣṭyai svāhā svargāya svāhā ||
3.12.15.d: एकस्मै स्वाहा द्वाभ्यां स्वाहैकान्नशताय स्वाहा शताय स्वाहैकशताय स्वाहा व्युष्ट्यै स्वाहा स्वर्गाय स्वाहा ॥
3.12.15.m:
To one, svāhā!
To two, svāhā!
To ninety-nine, svāhā!
To a hundred, svāhā!
To a hundred and one, svāhā!
To the dawn, svāhā!
To the heavenly world, svāhā!

3.12.16.s: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patir eka āsīt | sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyām utemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema || upayāmagṛhīto 'si prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmy eṣa te yoniḥ sūryas te mahimā ||
3.12.16.d: हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिर् एक आसीत् । स दाधार पृथिवीं द्याम् उतेमां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजापतये त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णाम्य् एष ते योनिः सूर्यस् ते महिमा ॥
3.12.16.m:
The Golden Germ arose in the beginning; born, he was the sole lord of what has come to be.
He upheld this earth and heaven. To what god should we offer worship with oblation?
You are taken with the Upayāma.
I take you dear to Prajāpati.
This is your womb.
The sun is your greatness.

3.12.17.s: yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣataś ca rājā patir viśvasya jagato babhūva | īśe yo asya dvipadaś catuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema || upayāmagṛhīto 'si prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmy eṣa te yoniś candramās te mahimā ||
3.12.17.d: यः प्राणतो निमिषतश् च राजा पतिर् विश्वस्य जगतो बभूव । ईशे यो अस्य द्विपदश् चतुष्पदः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजापतये त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णाम्य् एष ते योनिश् चन्द्रमास् ते महिमा ॥
3.12.17.m:
Who became king of what breathes and blinks, the lord of the whole world;
who rules over this two-footed and four-footed [world]—to what god should we offer worship with oblation?
You are taken with the Upayāma.
I take you dear to Prajāpati.
This is your womb.
The moon is your greatness.

3.12.18.s: yuñjanti bradhnam aruṣaṃ carantaṃ pari tasthuṣaḥ | rocante rocanā divi || yad vāto 'po aganīgan priyām indrasya tanvam | etaṃ stotar anena pathā punar aśvam āvartayāsi naḥ ||
3.12.18.d: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नम् अरुषं चरन्तं परि तस्थुषः । रोचन्ते रोचना दिवि ॥ यद् वातो ऽपो अगनीगन् प्रियाम् इन्द्रस्य तन्वम् । एतं स्तोतर् अनेन पथा पुनर् अश्वम् आवर्तयासि नः ॥
3.12.18.m:
They harness the ruddy, red-brown courser as he moves around those standing still;
the lights shine in the sky.
When the wind has made the waters surge, dear body of Indra,
by this path, o praiser, turn back this horse to us!

3.12.19.s: vasavas tvāñjantu gāyatreṇa chandasā rudrās tvāñjantu traiṣṭubhena chandasādityās tvāñjantu jāgatena chandasā bhūr bhuvaḥ svar lājī3 śācī3 yavye gavya etad annam atta devā etad annam addhi prajāpate || kaḥ svid ekākī carati ka u svij jāyate punaḥ | kiṃ svid dhimasya bheṣajaṃ kim avāvapanaṃ mahat || sūrya ekākī carati candramā jāyate punaḥ | agnir himasya bheṣajaṃ bhūmir āvapanaṃ mahat || kā svid āsīt pūrvacittiḥ kiṃ svid āsīd bṛhad vayaḥ | kā svid āsīt pilippilā kā svid āsīt piśaṅgilā || dyaur āsīt pūrvacittir aśva āsīd bṛhad vayaḥ | avir āsīt pilippilā rātrir āsīt piśaṅgilā ||
3.12.19.d: वसवस् त्वाञ्जन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसा रुद्रास् त्वाञ्जन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसादित्यास् त्वाञ्जन्तु जागतेन छन्दसा भूर् भुवः स्वर् लाजी3 शाची3 यव्ये गव्य एतद् अन्नम् अत्त देवा एतद् अन्नम् अद्धि प्रजापते ॥ कः स्विद् एकाकी चरति क उ स्विज् जायते पुनः । किं स्विद् धिमस्य भेषजं किम् अवावपनं महत् ॥ सूर्य एकाकी चरति चन्द्रमा जायते पुनः । अग्निर् हिमस्य भेषजं भूमिर् आवपनं महत् ॥ का स्विद् आसीत् पूर्वचित्तिः किं स्विद् आसीद् बृहद् वयः । का स्विद् आसीत् पिलिप्पिला का स्विद् आसीत् पिशङ्गिला ॥ द्यौर् आसीत् पूर्वचित्तिर् अश्व आसीद् बृहद् वयः । अविर् आसीत् पिलिप्पिला रात्रिर् आसीत् पिशङ्गिला ॥
3.12.19.m:
May the Vasus anoint you with the Gāyatrī meter!
May the Rudras anoint you with the Traiṣṭubha meter!
May the Ādityas anoint you with the Jāgata meter!
Bhūr, bhuvas, svar!
Fried grain! Strength! Barley-food, milk-food!
Eat this food, o gods!
Eat this food, o Prajāpati!
Who indeed roams alone? And who indeed is born again?
What indeed is the remedy for cold? What is the great receptacle?
The sun roams alone, and the moon is born again.
Agni is the remedy for cold; the earth is the great receptacle.
What indeed was the first conception? What indeed was the great bird?
Who indeed was slippery? Who indeed was tawny?
Heaven was the first conception; the horse was the great bird.
The sheep was slippery; the night was tawny.

3.12.20.s: prāṇāya svāhāpānāya svāhā vyānāya svāhā || amby ambike ambālike na mā nayati kaś cana | sasasty aśvakaḥ subhadrikāṃ kāmapīlavāsinīm || gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe priyāṇāṃ tvā priyapatiṃ havāmahe nidhīnāṃ tvā nidhipatiṃ havāmahe vaso mamāham ajāni garbhadham ā tvam ajāsi garbhadham || tau saha caturaḥ padaḥ saṃprasārayāvaḥ svarge loke prorṇuvātāṃ vṛṣā vām aśvo retodhā reto dadhātu ||
3.12.20.d: प्राणाय स्वाहापानाय स्वाहा व्यानाय स्वाहा ॥ अम्ब्य् अम्बिके अम्बालिके न मा नयति कश् चन । ससस्त्य् अश्वकः सुभद्रिकां कामपीलवासिनीम् ॥ गणानां त्वा गणपतिं हवामहे प्रियाणां त्वा प्रियपतिं हवामहे निधीनां त्वा निधिपतिं हवामहे वसो ममाहम् अजानि गर्भधम् आ त्वम् अजासि गर्भधम् ॥ तौ सह चतुरः पदः संप्रसारयावः स्वर्गे लोके प्रोर्णुवातां वृषा वाम् अश्वो रेतोधा रेतो दधातु ॥
3.12.20.m:
To out-breath, svāhā!
To in-breath, svāhā!
To through-breath, svāhā!
O mother, o little mother, o dear little mother, no one leads me!
The wretched little horse sleeps beside Subhadrikā living in Kāmapīla!
We call upon you, the troop-lord of troops!
We call upon you, the beloved lord of beloved ones!
We call upon you, the treasure-lord of treasures, o my treasure!
May I draw out the seed-bearer!
May you draw out the seed-bearer!
Let us two stretch out our four feet together; may they cover themselves in the heavenly world!
May the stallion, the placer of seed, place seed in you two!

3.12.21.s: gāyatrī triṣṭub jagaty anuṣṭup paṅktyā saha | bṛhaty uṣṇihā kakub devānāṃ patnayo viśaḥ sūcībhiḥ śamayantu tvā || dvipadā yā catuṣpadā tripadā yā ca ṣaṭpadā | vichandā yā ca sachandāḥ sūcībhiḥ śamayantu tvā || rajatāḥ sīsā hariṇīr yujo yuñjantu karmabhiḥ | aśvasya vājinas tvaci syūmāḥ kṛṇvantu śāmyantīḥ || mahānāmnī revatayo daivyā āśāḥ prasūvarīḥ | meghyā vidyuto vācaḥ sūcībhiḥ śamayantu tvā || yoṣās te patnayo loma vicinvantu yathāyatham | supatnīḥ patnayo vājin prajayā bhukṣīmahi || kuvid aṅga || iti tṛtīyakāṇḍe dvādaśaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ ||
3.12.21.d: गायत्री त्रिष्टुब् जगत्य् अनुष्टुप् पङ्क्त्या सह । बृहत्य् उष्णिहा ककुब् देवानां पत्नयो विशः सूचीभिः शमयन्तु त्वा ॥ द्विपदा या चतुष्पदा त्रिपदा या च षट्पदा । विछन्दा या च सछन्दाः सूचीभिः शमयन्तु त्वा ॥ रजताः सीसा हरिणीर् युजो युञ्जन्तु कर्मभिः । अश्वस्य वाजिनस् त्वचि स्यूमाः कृण्वन्तु शाम्यन्तीः ॥ महानाम्नी रेवतयो दैव्या आशाः प्रसूवरीः । मेघ्या विद्युतो वाचः सूचीभिः शमयन्तु त्वा ॥ योषास् ते पत्नयो लोम विचिन्वन्तु यथायथम् । सुपत्नीः पत्नयो वाजिन् प्रजया भुक्षीमहि ॥ कुविद् अङ्ग ॥ इति तृतीयकाण्डे द्वादशः प्रपाठकः ॥
3.12.21.m: Gāyatrī, Triṣṭubh, Jagatī, Anuṣṭubh together with Paṅkti, / Bṛhatī, Uṣṇih, Kakubh: let the wives of the gods, the clans, quiet you with needles! / Those with two feet, those with four feet, those with three feet, and those with six feet, / those without meter and those with meter: let them quiet you with needles! / Silver, lead, golden, yoked: let them yoke [them] with works! / On the skin of the vigorous horse let the quieting ones make seams! / The Mahānāmnīs, the Revatīs, the divine quarters, the fruitful ones, / the cloud-borne lightning-voices: let them quiet you with needles! / Let your wives, the women, separate the hair each in its place! / O vigorous courser, having good husbands, may we wives enjoy offspring! / Truly indeed! // Thus ends the twelfth prapāṭhaka in the third kāṇḍa.

3.13.1.s: ūrdhvām enām uñśrāpaya girau bhāraṃ harann iva | athāsyā madhyam edhatāṃ śīte vāte punann iva || yāsakau śakuntikāhalag iti vañcati | āhataṃ paso nicalcalīti || mātā ca te pitā ca te 'graṃ vṛkṣasya rohataḥ | pratilāmīti te pitā || yad dhariṇo yavam atti na puṣṭaṃ paśu manyate | śūdrā yad aryajārā na poṣāya dhanāyati || dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam ||
3.13.1.d: ऊर्ध्वाम् एनाम् उञ्श्रापय गिरौ भारं हरन्न् इव । अथास्या मध्यम् एधतां शीते वाते पुनन्न् इव ॥ यासकौ शकुन्तिकाहलग् इति वञ्चति । आहतं पसो निचल्चलीति ॥ माता च ते पिता च ते ऽग्रं वृक्षस्य रोहतः । प्रतिलामीति ते पिता ॥ यद् धरिणो यवम् अत्ति न पुष्टं पशु मन्यते । शूद्रा यद् अर्यजारा न पोषाय धनायति ॥ दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषम् ॥
3.13.1.m: Raise her up high, as one carrying a load on a mountain; / then let her middle thrive, as if winnowing in a cool wind! / Which little bird darting about, cries 'halak'? / Struck into [her], the penis vibrates back and forth! / Both your mother and your father climb to the top of the tree; / 'I thrust it in,' says your father. / When the deer eats barley, he does not regard the fattened beast; / when the Śūdra woman has an Ārya lover, he does not strive to prosper. / I have praised Dadhikrāvan...

3.13.2.s: aśvas tūparo gomṛgas te prājāpatyāḥ kṛṣṇagrīva āgneyo lalāṭe purastāt sārasvatī meṣy adhastād dhanvoḥ śyāmaḥ pauṣṇo nābhyām āśvinā adhorāmau bāhvos tvāṣṭrau lomaśasakthau sakthyoḥ sauryayāmau śvetaś ca kṛṣṇaś ca pārśvayor vāyavyaḥ śvetaḥ pucha indrāya svapasyāya vehad vaiṣṇavo vāmanaḥ ||
3.13.2.d: अश्वस् तूपरो गोमृगस् ते प्राजापत्याः कृष्णग्रीव आग्नेयो ललाटे पुरस्तात् सारस्वती मेष्य् अधस्ताद् धन्वोः श्यामः पौष्णो नाभ्याम् आश्विना अधोरामौ बाह्वोस् त्वाष्ट्रौ लोमशसक्थौ सक्थ्योः सौर्ययामौ श्वेतश् च कृष्णश् च पार्श्वयोर् वायव्यः श्वेतः पुछ इन्द्राय स्वपस्याय वेहद् वैष्णवो वामनः ॥
3.13.2.m: A horse, a hornless [goat], a bos gaurus: these belong to Prajāpati; / a black-necked [goat] to Agni at the forehead in front; / an ewe to Sarasvatī beneath the jaws; / a dark-brown [goat] to Pūṣan at the navel; / two with black lower fore-parts to the Aśvins on the two fore-legs; / two with hairy thighs to Tvaṣṭṛ on the thighs; / a white and a black [goat] to Sūrya and Yama on the two flanks; / a white [goat] to Vāyu at the tail; / a barren cow that miscarries to Indra skilled in work; / a dwarf to Viṣṇu.

3.13.3.s: babhrur aruṇababhruḥ śukababhrus te vāruṇā rohito dhūmrarohitaḥ karkandhurohitas te saumyāḥ śitibāhur anyataḥśitibāhuḥ samantaśitibāhus te bārhaspatyāḥ śitirandhro 'nyataḥśitirandhraḥ samantaśitirandhras te sāvitrāḥ pṛṣatī kṣudrapṛṣatī sthūlapṛṣatī tā maitrāvaruṇyaḥ ||
3.13.3.d: बभ्रुर् अरुणबभ्रुः शुकबभ्रुस् ते वारुणा रोहितो धूम्ररोहितः कर्कन्धुरोहितस् ते सौम्याः शितिबाहुर् अन्यतःशितिबाहुः समन्तशितिबाहुस् ते बार्हस्पत्याः शितिरन्ध्रो ऽन्यतःशितिरन्ध्रः समन्तशितिरन्ध्रस् ते सावित्राः पृषती क्षुद्रपृषती स्थूलपृषती ता मैत्रावरुण्यः ॥
3.13.3.m: A brown, a reddish-brown, a parrot-brown: these belong to Varuṇa; / a red, a smoky-red, a jujube-red: these belong to Soma; / one with white fore-legs, one with one white fore-leg, one with all white fore-legs: these belong to Bṛhaspati; / one with a white testicle-cleft, one with one white testicle-cleft, one with all white testicle-clefts: these belong to Savitṛ; / a spotted [cow], a fine-spotted [cow], a coarse-spotted [cow]: these belong to Mitra and Varuṇa.

3.13.4.s: śuddhavālaḥ sarvaśuddhāvālo maṇivālas ta āśvināḥ śyetaḥ śyetākṣo 'ruṇas te rudrāya paśupataye karṇā yāmā avaliptā raudrā nabhorūpāḥ pārjanyāḥ ||
3.13.4.d: शुद्धवालः सर्वशुद्धावालो मणिवालस् त आश्विनाः श्येतः श्येताक्षो ऽरुणस् ते रुद्राय पशुपतये कर्णा यामा अवलिप्ता रौद्रा नभोरूपाः पार्जन्याः ॥
3.13.4.m: One with a pure tail, one with an entirely pure tail, one with a tail like a jewel: these belong to the Aśvins; / a white, a white-eyed, a reddish: these belong to Rudra, lord of beasts; / earless ones to Yama; / smeared ones to Rudra; / cloud-colored ones to Parjanya.

3.13.5.s: pṛśnis tiraścīnapṛśnir ūrdhvapṛśnis te mārutāḥ phalgūr lohitorṇī balakṣī tāḥ sārasvatyaḥ plīhākarṇaḥ śuṇṭhākarṇo 'dhirūḍhākarṇas te tvāṣṭrāḥ kṛṣṇagrīvaḥ śitikakṣo 'ñjiṣakthas ta aindrāgnāḥ kṛṣṇāñjir alpāñjir mahāñjis ta uṣasyāḥ ||
3.13.5.d: पृश्निस् तिरश्चीनपृश्निर् ऊर्ध्वपृश्निस् ते मारुताः फल्गूर् लोहितोर्णी बलक्षी ताः सारस्वत्यः प्लीहाकर्णः शुण्ठाकर्णो ऽधिरूढाकर्णस् ते त्वाष्ट्राः कृष्णग्रीवः शितिकक्षो ऽञ्जिषक्थस् त ऐन्द्राग्नाः कृष्णाञ्जिर् अल्पाञ्जिर् महाञ्जिस् त उषस्याः ॥
3.13.5.m: A dappled, a transversely dappled, an upward-dappled: these belong to the Maruts; / reddish, red-wooled, white: these belong to Sarasvatī; / one with spleen-ears, one with cropped ears, one with deformed ears: these belong to Tvaṣṭṛ; / a black-necked, a white-flanked, an ointment-thighed: these belong to Indra and Agni; / a black-striped, a slightly striped, a greatly striped: these belong to Uṣas.

3.13.6.s: śilpā vaiśvadevī rohiṇīs tryavayo vāce 'vijñātā adityai sarūpā dhātre vatsataryo devānāṃ patnībhyaḥ ||
3.13.6.d: शिल्पा वैश्वदेवी रोहिणीस् त्र्यवयो वाचे ऽविज्ञाता अदित्यै सरूपा धात्रे वत्सतर्यो देवानां पत्नीभ्यः ॥
3.13.6.m: Variegated ones to the All-gods; / red three-year-olds to Vāc; / unrecognizable ones to Aditi; / uniform ones to Dhātṛ; / heifers to the wives of the gods.

3.13.7.s: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyāḥ śitibhruvo vasūnāṃ rohitā rudrāṇāṃ śvetā avarokiṇa ādityānāṃ nabhorūpāḥ pārjanyāḥ ||
3.13.7.d: कृष्णग्रीवा आग्नेयाः शितिभ्रुवो वसूनां रोहिता रुद्राणां श्वेता अवरोकिण आदित्यानां नभोरूपाः पार्जन्याः ॥
3.13.7.m: Black-necked ones to Agni; / white-browed ones to the Vasus; / red ones to the Rudras; / white bright-shining ones to the Ādityas; / cloud-colored ones to Parjanya.

3.13.8.s: unnataḥ śitibāhuḥ śitipṛṣṭhas ta aindrābārhaspatyā unnata ṛṣabho vāmanas ta aindrāvaiṣṇavāḥ śukarūpā vājināḥ kalmāṣā āgnimārutāḥ śyāmāḥ pauṣṇāḥ ||
3.13.8.d: उन्नतः शितिबाहुः शितिपृष्ठस् त ऐन्द्राबार्हस्पत्या उन्नत ऋषभो वामनस् त ऐन्द्रावैष्णवाः शुकरूपा वाजिनाः कल्माषा आग्निमारुताः श्यामाः पौष्णाः ॥
3.13.8.m: An elevated one, one with white fore-legs, one with a white back: these belong to Indra and Bṛhaspati; / an elevated one, a bull, a dwarf: these belong to Indra and Viṣṇu; / parrot-colored, vigorous, speckled ones to Agni and the Maruts; / dark-brown ones to Pūṣan.

3.13.9.s: etā aindrāgnā dvirūpā agnīṣomīyā vāmanā anaḍvāha āgnāvaiṣṇavā anyataenīr maitrīr vaśā maitrāvaruṇyaḥ ||
3.13.9.d: एता ऐन्द्राग्ना द्विरूपा अग्नीषोमीया वामना अनड्वाह आग्नावैष्णवा अन्यतएनीर् मैत्रीर् वशा मैत्रावरुण्यः ॥
3.13.9.m: Dappled ones to Indra and Agni; / two-colored ones to Agni and Soma; / dwarf draft-bulls to Agni and Viṣṇu; / those speckled on one side to Mitra; / barren cows to Mitra and Varuṇa.

3.13.10.s: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyā babhravaḥ saumyāḥ śvetā vāyavyā avijñātā adityai sarūpā dhātre vatsataryo devānāṃ patnībhyaḥ ||
3.13.10.d: कृष्णग्रीवा आग्नेया बभ्रवः सौम्याः श्वेता वायव्या अविज्ञाता अदित्यै सरूपा धात्रे वत्सतर्यो देवानां पत्नीभ्यः ॥
3.13.10.m: Black-necked ones to Agni; / brown ones to Soma; / white ones to Vāyu; / unrecognizable ones to Aditi; / uniform ones to Dhātṛ; / heifers to the wives of the gods.

3.13.11.s: kṛṣṇā bhaumā dhūmrā āntarikṣā bṛhanto daivāḥ śabalā vaidyutāḥ sidhmās tārakāḥ ||
3.13.11.d: कृष्णा भौमा धूम्रा आन्तरिक्षा बृहन्तो दैवाः शबला वैद्युताः सिध्मास् तारकाः ॥
3.13.11.m: Black ones to Bhūmi; / smoky ones to the intermediate region; / large ones to the gods; / spotted ones to lightning; / leprous-spotted ones to the stars.

3.13.12.s: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyā babhravaḥ saumyā upadhvastāḥ sāvitrā vatsataryaḥ sārasvatyaḥ śyāmāḥ pauṣṇāḥ pṛśnayo mārutāḥ piśaṅgā vaiśvadevā vaśā dyāvāpṛthivīyāḥ ||
3.13.12.d: कृष्णग्रीवा आग्नेया बभ्रवः सौम्या उपध्वस्ताः सावित्रा वत्सतर्यः सारस्वत्यः श्यामाः पौष्णाः पृश्नयो मारुताः पिशङ्गा वैश्वदेवा वशा द्यावापृथिवीयाः ॥
3.13.12.m: Black-necked ones to Agni; / brown ones to Soma; / speckle-dusted ones to Savitṛ; / heifers to Sarasvatī; / dark-brown ones to Pūṣan; / dappled ones to the Maruts; / tawny ones to the All-gods; / barren cows to Heaven and Earth.

3.13.13.s: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyā babhravaḥ saumyā upadhvastāḥ sāvitrā vatsataryaḥ sārasvatyaḥ śyāmāḥ pauṣṇā etā aindrāgnāḥ pṛśnayo mārutāḥ kṛṣṇā vāruṇāḥ kāyās tūparāḥ ||
3.13.13.d: कृष्णग्रीवा आग्नेया बभ्रवः सौम्या उपध्वस्ताः सावित्रा वत्सतर्यः सारस्वत्यः श्यामाः पौष्णा एता ऐन्द्राग्नाः पृश्नयो मारुताः कृष्णा वारुणाः कायास् तूपराः ॥
3.13.13.m: Black-necked ones to Agni; / brown ones to Soma; / speckle-dusted ones to Savitṛ; / heifers to Sarasvatī; / dark-brown ones to Pūṣan; / dappled ones to Indra and Agni; / dappled ones to the Maruts; / black ones to Varuṇa; / hornless ones to Ka.

3.13.14.s: agnaye 'nīkavate prathamajān ālabhate marudbhyaḥ sāṃtapanebhyaḥ savātyān marudbhyo gṛhamedhebhyo vaṣkihān marudbhyaḥ krīḍibhyaḥ saṃsṛṣṭān marudbhyaḥ svatavadbhyo 'nusṛṣṭān ||
3.13.14.d: अग्नये ऽनीकवते प्रथमजान् आलभते मरुद्भ्यः सांतपनेभ्यः सवात्यान् मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधेभ्यो वष्किहान् मरुद्भ्यः क्रीडिभ्यः संसृष्टान् मरुद्भ्यः स्वतवद्भ्यो ऽनुसृष्टान् ॥
3.13.14.m: For Agni who has a vanguard, he seizes first-borns; / for the scorching Maruts, those born in the rainy season; / for the house-holding Maruts, full-grown ones; / for the sporting Maruts, mingled ones; / for the self-strong Maruts, following ones.

3.13.15.s: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyā babhravaḥ saumyā upadhvastāḥ sāvitrā vatsataryaḥ sārasvatyaḥ śyāmāḥ pauṣṇā etā aindrāgnāḥ prāśṛṅgā aindrā bahurūpā vaiśvakarmaṇāḥ ||
3.13.15.d: कृष्णग्रीवा आग्नेया बभ्रवः सौम्या उपध्वस्ताः सावित्रा वत्सतर्यः सारस्वत्यः श्यामाः पौष्णा एता ऐन्द्राग्नाः प्राशृङ्गा ऐन्द्रा बहुरूपा वैश्वकर्मणाः ॥
3.13.15.m: Black-necked ones to Agni; / brown ones to Soma; / speckle-dusted ones to Savitṛ; / heifers to Sarasvatī; / dark-brown ones to Pūṣan; / dappled ones to Indra and Agni; / straight-horned ones to Indra; / multiform ones to Viśvakarman.

3.13.16.s: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyā babhravaḥ saumyā upadhvastāḥ sāvitrā vatsataryaḥ sārasvatyaḥ śyāmāḥ pauṣṇāḥ śvetā vāyavyāḥ prāśṛṅgā aindrāḥ sauryāḥ śvetāḥ ||
3.13.16.d: कृष्णग्रीवा आग्नेया बभ्रवः सौम्या उपध्वस्ताः सावित्रा वत्सतर्यः सारस्वत्यः श्यामाः पौष्णाः श्वेता वायव्याः प्राशृङ्गा ऐन्द्राः सौर्याः श्वेताः ॥
3.13.16.m: Black-necked ones to Agni; / brown ones to Soma; / speckle-dusted ones to Savitṛ; / heifers to Sarasvatī; / dark-brown ones to Pūṣan; / white ones to Vāyu; / straight-horned ones to Indra; / white ones to Sūrya.

3.13.17.s: tryavayo gāyatryai pañcāvayas triṣṭubhe dityavāho jagatyai trivatsā anuṣṭubhe turyavāha uṣṇihe ||
3.13.17.d: त्र्यवयो गायत्र्यै पञ्चावयस् त्रिष्टुभे दित्यवाहो जगत्यै त्रिवत्सा अनुष्टुभे तुर्यवाह उष्णिहे ॥
3.13.17.m: Three-year-olds to the Gāyatrī; / five-year-olds to the Triṣṭubh; / two-year-old draft-oxen to the Jagatī; / three-year-olds to the Anuṣṭubh; / four-year-old draft-oxen to the Uṣṇih.

3.13.18.s: paṣṭhavāho virāja ukṣāṇo bṛhatyay ṛṣabhāḥ kakubhe dhenavo jagatyay anaḍvāhaḥ paṅktyai ||
3.13.18.d: पष्ठवाहो विराज उक्षाणो बृहत्यय् ऋषभाः ककुभे धेनवो जगत्यय् अनड्वाहः पङ्क्त्यै ॥
3.13.18.m: Four-year-old oxen to the Virāj; / oxen to the Bṛhatī; / bulls to the Kakubh; / milch-cows to the Jagatī; / draft-bulls to the Paṅkti.

3.13.19.s: dhūmrā vasantāya śvetā grīṣmāya kṛṣṇā varṣābhyaḥ ||
3.13.19.d: धूम्रा वसन्ताय श्वेता ग्रीष्माय कृष्णा वर्षाभ्यः ॥
3.13.19.m: Smoky ones to spring; / white ones to summer; / black ones to the rainy season.

3.13.20.s: aruṇāḥ śarade pṛṣanto hemantāya piśaṅgāḥ śiśirāya || iti tṛtīyakāṇḍe trayodaśamaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ ||
3.13.20.d: अरुणाः शरदे पृषन्तो हेमन्ताय पिशङ्गाः शिशिराय ॥ इति तृतीयकाण्डे त्रयोदशमः प्रपाठकः ॥
3.13.20.m: Reddish ones to autumn; / spotted ones to winter; / tawny ones to the cool season. // Thus ends the thirteenth prapāṭhaka in the third kāṇḍa.

3.14.1.s: vasantāya kapiñjalān ālabhate grīṣmāya kalaviṅkān varṣābhyas tittirāñ charade vartikā hemantāya kakarān ||
3.14.1.d: वसन्ताय कपिञ्जलान् आलभते ग्रीष्माय कलविङ्कान् वर्षाभ्यस् तित्तिराञ् छरदे वर्तिका हेमन्ताय ककरान् ॥
3.14.1.m: For spring he seizes partridges; / for summer, sparrows; / for the rainy season, francolins; / for autumn, quails; / for winter, kakaras.

3.14.2.s: samudrāya śiśumārān ālabhate parjanyāya maṇḍūkān adbhyo matsyān mitrāya pulīkayān varuṇāya nākrān ||
3.14.2.d: समुद्राय शिशुमारान् आलभते पर्जन्याय मण्डूकान् अद्भ्यो मत्स्यान् मित्राय पुलीकयान् वरुणाय नाक्रान् ॥
3.14.2.m: For the ocean he seizes dolphins; / for Parjanya, frogs; / for the waters, fish; / for Mitra, pulīkayas; / for Varuṇa, crocodiles.

3.14.3.s: somāya haṃsān ālabhate vāyave balākā indrāgnibhyāṃ kruñcān mitrāya madgūn varuṇāya cakravākān ||
3.14.3.d: सोमाय हंसान् आलभते वायवे बलाका इन्द्राग्निभ्यां क्रुञ्चान् मित्राय मद्गून् वरुणाय चक्रवाकान् ॥
3.14.3.m: For Soma he seizes wild geese; / for Vāyu, egrets; / for Indra and Agni, curlews; / for Mitra, cormorants; / for Varuṇa, shelducks.

3.14.4.s: agnaye kuṭarūn ālabhate vanaspatayā ulūkān agnīṣomābhyaṃ cāṣān aśvibhyāṃ mayūrān mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ kapotān ||
3.14.4.d: अग्नये कुटरून् आलभते वनस्पतया उलूकान् अग्नीषोमाभ्यं चाषान् अश्विभ्यां मयूरान् मित्रावरुणाभ्यां कपोतान् ॥
3.14.4.m: For Agni he seizes jungle-fowls; / for the tree, owls; / for Agni and Soma, blue jays; / for the Aśvins, peacocks; / for Mitra and Varuṇa, doves.

3.14.5.s: somāya labān ālabhate tvaṣṭre kaulīkān goṣādīr devānāṃ patnībhyaḥ pulīkā agnaye gṛhapataye pāruṣṇān ||
3.14.5.d: सोमाय लबान् आलभते त्वष्ट्रे कौलीकान् गोषादीर् देवानां पत्नीभ्यः पुलीका अग्नये गृहपतये पारुष्णान् ॥
3.14.5.m: For Soma he seizes quail-like lavas; / for Tvaṣṭṛ, kaulīkas that perch on cattle; / for the wives of the gods, pulīkas; / for Agni the householder, pāruṣṇas.

3.14.6.s: ahne pārāvatān ālabhate rātryai sīcāpūr ahnaḥ saṃdhibhyāṃ jatūḥ saṃvatsarāya mahataḥ suparṇān māsebhyo dātyauhān ||
3.14.6.d: अह्ने पारावतान् आलभते रात्र्यै सीचापूर् अह्नः संधिभ्यां जतूः संवत्सराय महतः सुपर्णान् मासेभ्यो दात्यौहान् ॥
3.14.6.m: For the day he seizes pigeons; / for the night, owls; / for the junctions of the day, bats; / for the year, great eagles; / for the months, water-fowls.

3.14.7.s: bhūmyā ākhūn ālabhate 'ntarikṣāya pāṅktrān dive kaśān digbhyo nakulān babhrukān avāntaradiśābhyaḥ ||
3.14.7.d: भूम्या आखून् आलभते ऽन्तरिक्षाय पाङ्क्त्रान् दिवे कशान् दिग्भ्यो नकुलान् बभ्रुकान् अवान्तरदिशाभ्यः ॥
3.14.7.m: For the earth he seizes moles; / for the intermediate space, pāṅktra-birds; / for the sky, weasels; / for the quarters, mongooses; / for the intermediate quarters, brown mongooses.

3.14.8.s: prajāpataye puruṣān hastinā ālabhate vāce pluṣīṃś cakṣuṣe maśakāñ chrotrāya bhṛṅgāḥ ||
3.14.8.d: प्रजापतये पुरुषान् हस्तिना आलभते वाचे प्लुषींश् चक्षुषे मशकाञ् छ्रोत्राय भृङ्गाः ॥
3.14.8.m: For Prajāpati he seizes men and elephants; / for speech, ticks; / for sight, mosquitoes; / for hearing, bees.

3.14.9.s: vasubhyo ṛṣyān ālabhate rudrebhyo rurūn ādityebhyo nyaṅkūn viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ pṛṣatān sādhyebhyaḥ kulaṅgān ||
3.14.9.d: वसुभ्यो ऋष्यान् आलभते रुद्रेभ्यो रुरून् आदित्येभ्यो न्यङ्कून् विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः पृषतान् साध्येभ्यः कुलङ्गान् ॥
3.14.9.m: For the Vasus he seizes bluebucks; / for the Rudras, ruru-deer; / for the Ādityas, antelopes; / for the All-gods, spotted deer; / for the Sādhyas, kulaṅga-antelopes.

3.14.10.s: īśānāya parasvatā ālabhate mitrāya gaurān varuṇāya mahiṣān bṛhaspataye gavayāṃs tvaṣṭrā uṣṭrān ||
3.14.10.d: ईशानाय परस्वता आलभते मित्राय गौरान् वरुणाय महिषान् बृहस्पतये गवयांस् त्वष्ट्रा उष्ट्रान् ॥
3.14.10.m: For Īśāna he seizes wild asses; / for Mitra, wild oxen; / for Varuṇa, buffaloes; / for Bṛhaspati, gayals; / for Tvaṣṭṛ, camels.

3.14.11.s: prajāpataye ca vāyave ca gomṛgo varuṇāyāraṇyo meṣo yamāya kṛṣṇo manurājāya markaṭaḥ śārdūlāya rohid vṛṣabhāya gavayī kṣipraśyenāya vartikā nīlaṅgave kṛmiḥ samudrāya śiśumāro himavate hastī ||
3.14.11.d: प्रजापतये च वायवे च गोमृगो वरुणायारण्यो मेषो यमाय कृष्णो मनुराजाय मर्कटः शार्दूलाय रोहिद् वृषभाय गवयी क्षिप्रश्येनाय वर्तिका नीलङ्गवे कृमिः समुद्राय शिशुमारो हिमवते हस्ती ॥
3.14.11.m: For Prajāpati and Vāyu, the nilgai; / for Varuṇa, the wild ram; / for Yama, the black antelope; / for King Manu, the monkey; / for the tiger, the red doe; / for the bull, the female gayal; / for the swift falcon, the quail; / for the blue antelope, the worm; / for the ocean, the dolphin; / for the Himavat, the elephant.

3.14.12.s: mayuḥ prājāpatya ulo halikṣṇo vṛṣadaṃśas te dhātre diśāṃ kaṅko dhuṅkṣāgneyī kalaviṅkaḥ puṣkarasādo lohitāhis te tvāṣṭrā vāce krauñcaḥ ||
3.14.12.d: मयुः प्राजापत्य उलो हलिक्ष्णो वृषदंशस् ते धात्रे दिशां कङ्को धुङ्क्षाग्नेयी कलविङ्कः पुष्करसादो लोहिताहिस् ते त्वाष्ट्रा वाचे क्रौञ्चः ॥
3.14.12.m: The mayu-beast belongs to Prajāpati; / the ula, the halikṣṇa, the wildcat: those belong to Dhātṛ; / for the quarters, the heron; / the dhuṅkṣā-bird belongs to Agni; / the sparrow, the reed-percher, the red snake: those belong to Tvaṣṭṛ; / for speech, the curlew.

3.14.13.s: somāya kulaṅga āraṇyo 'jo nakulaḥ śakā te pauṣṇāḥ kroṣṭā māyor indrasya gauramṛgaḥ pidvo nyaṅkuḥ kakuṭhas te 'numatyai pratiśrutkāyai cakravākaḥ ||
3.14.13.d: सोमाय कुलङ्ग आरण्यो ऽजो नकुलः शका ते पौष्णाः क्रोष्टा मायोर् इन्द्रस्य गौरमृगः पिद्वो न्यङ्कुः ककुठस् ते ऽनुमत्यै प्रतिश्रुत्कायै चक्रवाकः ॥
3.14.13.m: For Soma, the kulaṅga-antelope; / the wild goat, the mongoose, the śakā: those belong to Pūṣan; / the jackal belongs to Māyu; / for Indra, the wild ox; / the pidva, the antelope, the humpbacked ox: those belong to Anumati; / for the echo, the shelduck.

3.14.14.s: saurī balākā śārgaḥ sṛjayaḥ śayāṇḍakas te maitrāḥ śvāvid bhaumī sarasvatyai śāriḥ puruṣavāk śārdūlo vṛkaḥ pṛdākus te manyave sarasvate śukaḥ puruṣavāk ||
3.14.14.d: सौरी बलाका शार्गः सृजयः शयाण्डकस् ते मैत्राः श्वाविद् भौमी सरस्वत्यै शारिः पुरुषवाक् शार्दूलो वृकः पृदाकुस् ते मन्यवे सरस्वते शुकः पुरुषवाक् ॥
3.14.14.m: The egret belongs to Sūrya; / the śārga, the sṛjaya, the śayāṇḍaka: those belong to Mitra; / the porcupine belongs to the earth; / for Sarasvatī, the starling that speaks human speech; / the tiger, the wolf, the viper: those belong to Manyu; / for Sarasvat, the parrot that speaks human speech.

3.14.15.s: suparṇaḥ pārjanya ātir vāhaso darvidā te vāyave kṛkavākuḥ sāvitro haṃso vātasya plavo madgur matsyas te nadīpataye dyāvāpṛthivīyaḥ kūrmaḥ ||
3.14.15.d: सुपर्णः पार्जन्य आतिर् वाहसो दर्विदा ते वायवे कृकवाकुः सावित्रो हंसो वातस्य प्लवो मद्गुर् मत्स्यस् ते नदीपतये द्यावापृथिवीयः कूर्मः ॥
3.14.15.m: The eagle belongs to Parjanya; / the waterfowl, the vāhasa, the woodpecker: those belong to Vāyu; / the cock belongs to Savitṛ; / the wild goose belongs to the wind; / the plava-bird, the cormorant, the fish: those belong to the lord of streams; / the tortoise belongs to Heaven and Earth.

3.14.16.s: puruṣamṛgaś candramaso godhā kālakā dārvāghāṭas te vanaspatīnāṃ bṛhaspataye vācaspataye paiṅgarājo 'laja āntarikṣo nākro makaraḥ pulīkayas te 'kūpārasya hriyai śalyakaḥ ||
3.14.16.d: पुरुषमृगश् चन्द्रमसो गोधा कालका दार्वाघाटस् ते वनस्पतीनां बृहस्पतये वाचस्पतये पैङ्गराजो ऽलज आन्तरिक्षो नाक्रो मकरः पुलीकयस् ते ऽकूपारस्य ह्रियै शल्यकः ॥
3.14.16.m: The ape belongs to the moon; / the iguana, the kālakā, the wood-pecker: those belong to the trees; / for Bṛhaspati, lord of speech, the paiṅgarāja; / the alaja-bird belongs to the intermediate space; / the crocodile, the sea-monster, the pulīkaya: those belong to Akūpāra; / for Modesty, the porcupine.

3.14.17.s: eṇy ahno maṇḍūko mūṣikā tittiras te sarpāṇāṃ lopāśa āśvinaḥ kṛṣṇo rātryay ṛkṣo jatūḥ śuśulūkā ta itarajanānāṃ jahakā vaiṣṇavī ||
3.14.17.d: एण्य् अह्नो मण्डूको मूषिका तित्तिरस् ते सर्पाणां लोपाश आश्विनः कृष्णो रात्र्यय् ऋक्षो जतूः शुशुलूका त इतरजनानां जहका वैष्णवी ॥
3.14.17.m: The black doe belongs to the day; / the frog, the mouse, the partridge: those belong to the serpents; / the fox belongs to the Aśvins; / the black antelope belongs to the night; / the bear, the bat, the owlet: those belong to the other-folk; / the polecat belongs to Viṣṇu.

3.14.18.s: anyavāpo 'rdhamāsānām ṛśyo mayūraḥ suparṇas te gandharvāṇām apām udraḥ kaśyapo māsāṃ rohit kuṇḍṛṇācī golattikā tā apsarasāṃ mṛtyave 'sitaḥ ||
3.14.18.d: अन्यवापो ऽर्धमासानाम् ऋश्यो मयूरः सुपर्णस् ते गन्धर्वाणाम् अपाम् उद्रः कश्यपो मासां रोहित् कुण्डृणाची गोलत्तिका ता अप्सरसां मृत्यवे ऽसितः ॥
3.14.18.m: The cuckoo belongs to the half-months; / the bluebuck, the peacock, the eagle: those belong to the Gandharvas; / the otter belongs to the waters; / the tortoise belongs to the months; / the red doe, the kuṇḍṛṇācī, the golattikā: those belong to the Apsarases; / for Death, the black serpent.

3.14.19.s: varṣāhūr ṛtūnām ākhuḥ kaśo mānthālavas te pitṝṇāṃ vasubhyaḥ kapiñjalo balāyājagaraḥ kapotā ulūkaḥ śaśas te nirṛtyai rātryai kṛṣṇaḥ ||
3.14.19.d: वर्षाहूर् ऋतूनाम् आखुः कशो मान्थालवस् ते पितॄणां वसुभ्यः कपिञ्जलो बलायाजगरः कपोता उलूकः शशस् ते निरृत्यै रात्र्यै कृष्णः ॥
3.14.19.m: The frog belongs to the seasons; / the mole, the weasel, the mānthālava: those belong to the Fathers; / for the Vasus, the francolin; / for Strength, the python; / the dove, the owl, the hare: those belong to Nirṛti; / for the night, the black [beast].

3.14.20.s: citra ādityānām uṣṭro ghṛṇāvān vārdhrānasas te matyā āraṇāya sṛmaro rurū raudraḥ kuvayaḥ kuṭarur dātyauhas te vājināṃ kāmāya pikaḥ ||
3.14.20.d: चित्र आदित्यानाम् उष्ट्रो घृणावान् वार्ध्रानसस् ते मत्या आरणाय सृमरो रुरू रौद्रः कुवयः कुटरुर् दात्यौहस् ते वाजिनां कामाय पिकः ॥
3.14.20.m: The spotted deer belongs to the Ādityas; / the camel, the wrathful [rhinoceros], the rhinoceros: those belong to Mati; / for the forest, the sṛmara; / the ruru-deer belongs to Rudra; / the kuvaya, the jungle-fowl, the water-fowl: those belong to the coursers; / for Desire, the cuckoo.

3.14.21.s: khaḍgo vaiśvadevas tarakṣuḥ śvā kṛṣṇaḥ karṇo gardabhas te rakṣasām indrāya sūkaraḥ siṃho mārutaḥ kṛkalāsaḥ pippakā śakunis te śaravyāyai viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ pṛṣataḥ || iti tṛtīyakāṇḍe caturdaśamaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ ||
3.14.21.d: खड्गो वैश्वदेवस् तरक्षुः श्वा कृष्णः कर्णो गर्दभस् ते रक्षसाम् इन्द्राय सूकरः सिंहो मारुतः कृकलासः पिप्पका शकुनिस् ते शरव्यायै विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः पृषतः ॥ इति तृतीयकाण्डे चतुर्दशमः प्रपाठकः ॥
3.14.21.m:
The rhinoceros belongs to the All-gods; / the hyena, the black dog, the ass with long ears: those belong to the Rakṣases; / for Indra, the boar; / the lion belongs to the Maruts; / the chameleon, the pippakā-bird, the śakuni-bird: those belong to the missile; / for the All-gods, the spotted deer.
Thus ends the fourteenth prapāṭhaka in the third kāṇḍa.

3.15.1.s: śādaṃ dadbhir avakān dantamūlair mṛdaṃ barsvai stegān daṃṣṭrābhyām avakrandena tālu vājaṃ hanubhyāṃ sarasvatyā agrajihvaṃ jihvāyā utsādam apa āsyena vṛṣaṇā āṇḍābhyām ādityāñ śmaśrubhiḥ panthāṃ bhrūbhyāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī vartobhyāṃ vidyutaṃ kanīnikābhyāṃ karṇābhyāṃ śrotre śrotrābhyāṃ karṇav avāryāṇi pakṣmāṇi pāryā ikṣavaḥ pāryāṇi pakṣmāṇy avāryā ikṣavaḥ ||
3.15.1.d: शादं दद्भिर् अवकान् दन्तमूलैर् मृदं बर्स्वै स्तेगान् दंष्ट्राभ्याम् अवक्रन्देन तालु वाजं हनुभ्यां सरस्वत्या अग्रजिह्वं जिह्वाया उत्सादम् अप आस्येन वृषणा आण्डाभ्याम् आदित्याञ् श्मश्रुभिः पन्थां भ्रूभ्यां द्यावापृथिवी वर्तोभ्यां विद्युतं कनीनिकाभ्यां कर्णाभ्यां श्रोत्रे श्रोत्राभ्यां कर्णव् अवार्याणि पक्ष्माणि पार्या इक्षवः पार्याणि पक्ष्माण्य् अवार्या इक्षवः ॥
3.15.1.m: Grass with the teeth; / reed-plants with the roots of the teeth; / earth with the gums; / flies with the tusks; / the palate with roaring; / strength with the jaws; / the tip of the tongue for Sarasvatī; / the root of the tongue with destruction; / waters with the mouth; / testicles with the scrotal sacs; / the Ādityas with the whiskers; / the path with the eyebrows; / Heaven and Earth with the eye-sockets; / lightning with the pupils; / with the ears, the senses of hearing; / with the senses of hearing, the ears; / the near eyelashes are reeds of this side; / the far eyelashes are reeds of the other side.

3.15.2.s: vātaṃ prāṇenāpānena nāsikām upayāmam adhareṇauṣṭhena sad uttareṇa śuklāya svāhā kṛṣṇāya svāhā stanayitnuṃ nirbādhena mūrdhānaṃ niveṣyeṇāśaniṃ mastiṣkeṇa vidyutaṃ kanīnikābhyāṃ prakāśenāntaram anukāśena bāhyaṃ tedanīm adharakaṇṭhenāpaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhena cittaṃ manyābhir aditiṃ śīrṣṇā nirṛtiṃ nirjalpena śīrṣṇā prāṇānt saṃkroṣair reṣmāṇaṃ stūpena ||
3.15.2.d: वातं प्राणेनापानेन नासिकाम् उपयामम् अधरेणौष्ठेन सद् उत्तरेण शुक्लाय स्वाहा कृष्णाय स्वाहा स्तनयित्नुं निर्बाधेन मूर्धानं निवेष्येणाशनिं मस्तिष्केण विद्युतं कनीनिकाभ्यां प्रकाशेनान्तरम् अनुकाशेन बाह्यं तेदनीम् अधरकण्ठेनापः शुष्ककण्ठेन चित्तं मन्याभिर् अदितिं शीर्ष्णा निरृतिं निर्जल्पेन शीर्ष्णा प्राणान्त् संक्रोषैर् रेष्माणं स्तूपेन ॥
3.15.2.m: The wind with the out-breath; / the nose with the in-breath; / the receptacle with the lower lip; / the seat with the upper; / svāhā to the white; / svāhā to the black; / thunder with the rib-cage; / the crown of the head with the niveṣya; / the thunderbolt with the brain; / lightning with the pupils; / the interior with radiance; / the exterior with after-glow; / the tedanī with the lower neck; / waters with the dry neck; / thought with the neck-tendons; / Aditi with the head; / Nirṛti with the chattering head; / the vital breaths with screams; / the storm with the crest.

3.15.3.s: maśakān keśair indraṃ svapasā vahena bṛhaspatiṃ śakunisādena kūrmāñ śaphair ākramaṇaṃ sthūrābhyāṃ balaṃ kuṣṭābhyāṃ javaṃ jaṅghābhir adhvānaṃ bāhubhyāṃ jāmbilenāraṇyam agnim atīrugbhyāṃ rudraṃ rorābhyāṃ pūṣaṇaṃ dorbhyām aśvinā aṃsābhyām ||
3.15.3.d: मशकान् केशैर् इन्द्रं स्वपसा वहेन बृहस्पतिं शकुनिसादेन कूर्माञ् शफैर् आक्रमणं स्थूराभ्यां बलं कुष्टाभ्यां जवं जङ्घाभिर् अध्वानं बाहुभ्यां जाम्बिलेनारण्यम् अग्निम् अतीरुग्भ्यां रुद्रं रोराभ्यां पूषणं दोर्भ्याम् अश्विना अंसाभ्याम् ॥
3.15.3.m: Mosquitoes with the hairs; / Indra with the shoulder having good work; / Bṛhaspati with the bird-perch; / tortoises with the hooves; / stepping forward with the thick bones; / power with the legs; / speed with the shanks; / the way with the arms; / the wilderness with the mouth; / Agni with the two piercing pains; / Rudra with the two roars; / Pūṣan with the forelegs; / the Aśvins with the shoulders.

3.15.4.s: agneḥ pakṣatir vāyor nipakṣatiḥ somasya tṛtīyāpāṃ caturthy adityāḥ pañcamy agnīṣomayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī marutāṃ saptamī bṛhaspater aṣṭamī pūṣṇo navamī tvaṣṭur daśamīndrasyaikādaśī varuṇasya dvādaśī yamasya trayodaśī ||
3.15.4.d: अग्नेः पक्षतिर् वायोर् निपक्षतिः सोमस्य तृतीयापां चतुर्थ्य् अदित्याः पञ्चम्य् अग्नीषोमयोः षष्ठी मरुतां सप्तमी बृहस्पतेर् अष्टमी पूष्णो नवमी त्वष्टुर् दशमीन्द्रस्यैकादशी वरुणस्य द्वादशी यमस्य त्रयोदशी ॥
3.15.4.m: The first rib belongs to Agni; / the second rib belongs to Vāyu; / the third belongs to Soma; / the fourth belongs to the Waters; / the fifth belongs to Aditi; / the sixth belongs to Agni and Soma; / the seventh belongs to the Maruts; / the eighth belongs to Bṛhaspati; / the ninth belongs to Pūṣan; / the tenth belongs to Tvaṣṭṛ; / the eleventh belongs to Indra; / the twelfth belongs to Varuṇa; / the thirteenth belongs to Yama.

3.15.5.s: indrāgnyoḥ pakṣatiḥ sarasvatyā nipakṣatir indrasya tṛtīyā bṛhaspateś caturthī nirṛtyāḥ pañcamīndrāṇyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī sarpāṇāṃ saptamī viṣṇor aṣṭamy aryamṇo navamī dhātur daśamīndrasyaikādaśī varuṇasya dvādaśī yamyās trayodaśī dyāvāpṛthivyor dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvaṃ viśveṣāṃ devānām uttaram ||
3.15.5.d: इन्द्राग्न्योः पक्षतिः सरस्वत्या निपक्षतिर् इन्द्रस्य तृतीया बृहस्पतेश् चतुर्थी निरृत्याः पञ्चमीन्द्राण्याः षष्ठी सर्पाणां सप्तमी विष्णोर् अष्टम्य् अर्यम्णो नवमी धातुर् दशमीन्द्रस्यैकादशी वरुणस्य द्वादशी यम्यास् त्रयोदशी द्यावापृथिव्योर् दक्षिणं पार्श्वं विश्वेषां देवानाम् उत्तरम् ॥
3.15.5.m: The first rib belongs to Indra and Agni; / the second rib belongs to Sarasvatī; / the third belongs to Indra; / the fourth belongs to Bṛhaspati; / the fifth belongs to Nirṛti; / the sixth belongs to Indrāṇī; / the seventh belongs to the serpents; / the eighth belongs to Viṣṇu; / the ninth belongs to Aryaman; / the tenth belongs to Dhātṛ; / the eleventh belongs to Indra; / the twelfth belongs to Varuṇa; / the thirteenth belongs to Yamī; / the right flank belongs to Heaven and Earth; / the left to the All-gods.

3.15.6.s: marutāṃ skandhā viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ mprathamā kīkasā rudrāṇāṃ dvitīyādityānāṃ tṛtīyā vāyoḥ pucham agnīṣomayor bhāsadau kruñcau śroṇibhyāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ūrubhyām indrāvaruṇā algābhyām ākramaṇaṃ kuṣṭhābhyām atsarābhiḥ kapiñjalān ||
3.15.6.d: मरुतां स्कन्धा विश्वेषां देवानां म्प्रथमा कीकसा रुद्राणां द्वितीयादित्यानां तृतीया वायोः पुछम् अग्नीषोमयोर् भासदौ क्रुञ्चौ श्रोणिभ्यां मित्रावरुणा ऊरुभ्याम् इन्द्रावरुणा अल्गाभ्याम् आक्रमणं कुष्ठाभ्याम् अत्सराभिः कपिञ्जलान् ॥
3.15.6.m: The shoulder-parts belong to the Maruts; / the first spinal rib belongs to the All-gods; / the second to the Rudras; / the third to the Ādityas; / the tail belongs to Vāyu; / the two buttocks belong to Agni and Soma; / curlews with the hips; / Mitra and Varuṇa with the thighs; / Indra and Varuṇa with the lower parts; / stepping forward with the legs; / francolins with the gliding movements.

3.15.7.s: indrasya kroḍo 'dityāḥ pājasyaṃ diśāṃ jatravo 'dityā bhasad jīmūtān hṛdayaupaśābhyām antarikṣaṃ pulītatā nabha udaryeṇa valmīkān klomnā glaubhir gulmāṃś cakravākau matasnābhyāṃ divaṃ vṛkkābhyāṃ hirābhiḥ sravantīr girīn plāśibhyām upalān plīhnā hradān kukṣibhyāṃ samudram udareṇa vaiśvānaraṃ bhasmanā ||
3.15.7.d: इन्द्रस्य क्रोडो ऽदित्याः पाजस्यं दिशां जत्रवो ऽदित्या भसद् जीमूतान् हृदयौपशाभ्याम् अन्तरिक्षं पुलीतता नभ उदर्येण वल्मीकान् क्लोम्ना ग्लौभिर् गुल्मांश् चक्रवाकौ मतस्नाभ्यां दिवं वृक्काभ्यां हिराभिः स्रवन्तीर् गिरीन् प्लाशिभ्याम् उपलान् प्लीह्ना ह्रदान् कुक्षिभ्यां समुद्रम् उदरेण वैश्वानरं भस्मना ॥
3.15.7.m: The breast belongs to Indra; / the belly-part belongs to Aditi; / the collar-bones belong to the quarters; / the rump belongs to Aditi; / rain-clouds with the pericardium; / the atmosphere with the pericardium; / the sky with the belly-cavity; / anthills with the bronchial tubes; / shrub-clumps with the glands; / the two shelducks with the kidneys; / heaven with the two kidneys; / flowing streams with the veins; / mountains with the two bladders; / stones with the spleen; / lakes with the two flanks; / the ocean with the abdomen; / Vaiśvānara with the ashes.

3.15.8.s: vidhṛtiṃ nābhyā ghṛtaṃ rasenāpo yūṣṇā marīcīr vipruṣā nīhāram ūṣmaṇā śīnaṃ vasayā hrādunīr dūṣīkābhiḥ pruṣvā aśrubhir asnā rakṣāṃsi citrāṇy aṅgair nakṣatrāṇi rūpaiḥ pṛthivīṃ tvacā jumbakāya svāhā ||
3.15.8.d: विधृतिं नाभ्या घृतं रसेनापो यूष्णा मरीचीर् विप्रुषा नीहारम् ऊष्मणा शीनं वसया ह्रादुनीर् दूषीकाभिः प्रुष्वा अश्रुभिर् अस्ना रक्षांसि चित्राण्य् अङ्गैर् नक्षत्राणि रूपैः पृथिवीं त्वचा जुम्बकाय स्वाहा ॥
3.15.8.m: The separating line with the navel; / ghee with the sap; / waters with the soup; / rays of light with the drop; / mist with the heat; / frozen water with the fat; / hail with the eye-rheum; / hoarfrost with the tears; / the demon-fiends with the blood; / wonders with the limbs; / constellations with the forms; / the earth with the skin; / to Jumbaka, svāhā!

3.15.9.s: pūṣaṇaṃ vaniṣṭhunāndhāhīnt sthūragudayā sarpān gudābhir vihruta āntrair apa āsyena vṛṣaṇā āṇḍābhyāṃ śeṣo vājinena prajāṃ retasā cāṣān pittena pradarān pāyunā kūṣmāñ śakapiṇḍaiḥ ||
3.15.9.d: पूषणं वनिष्ठुनान्धाहीन्त् स्थूरगुदया सर्पान् गुदाभिर् विह्रुत आन्त्रैर् अप आस्येन वृषणा आण्डाभ्यां शेषो वाजिनेन प्रजां रेतसा चाषान् पित्तेन प्रदरान् पायुना कूष्माञ् शकपिण्डैः ॥
3.15.9.m: Pūṣan with the rectum; / blind snakes with the large intestine; / snakes with the entrails; / crooked paths with the small intestines; / waters with the mouth; / the testicles with the two scrotal sacs; / the penis with the seminal fluid; / offspring with the seed; / blue jays with the bile; / clefts with the anus; / pumpkins with the dung-balls.

3.15.10.s: agnaye gāyatrāya trivṛte rāthantarāya vāsantikāya puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapatīndrāya traiṣṭubhāya pañcadaśāya bārhatāya graiṣmāya puroḍāśam ekādaśakapālaṃ viśvebhyo devebhyo jāgatebhyaḥ saptadaśebhyo vairūpebhyo vārṣikebhyaḥ puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ mitrāvaruṇābhyām ānuṣṭubhābhyām ekaviṃśābhyāṃ vairājābhyāṃ śāradābhyāṃ payasyāṃ bṛhaspataye pāṅktāya triṇavāya śākvarāya haimantikāya caruṃ savitra ātichandasāya trayastriṃśāya raivatāya śaiśirāya puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālam anumatyai caruṃ vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālam adityai viṣṇupatnyai caruṃ kāyam ekakapālam ||
3.15.10.d: अग्नये गायत्राय त्रिवृते राथन्तराय वासन्तिकाय पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपतीन्द्राय त्रैष्टुभाय पञ्चदशाय बार्हताय ग्रैष्माय पुरोडाशम् एकादशकपालं विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो जागतेभ्यः सप्तदशेभ्यो वैरूपेभ्यो वार्षिकेभ्यः पुरोडाशं द्वादशकपालं मित्रावरुणाभ्याम् आनुष्टुभाभ्याम् एकविंशाभ्यां वैराजाभ्यां शारदाभ्यां पयस्यां बृहस्पतये पाङ्क्ताय त्रिणवाय शाक्वराय हैमन्तिकाय चरुं सवित्र आतिछन्दसाय त्रयस्त्रिंशाय रैवताय शैशिराय पुरोडाशं द्वादशकपालम् अनुमत्यै चरुं वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालम् अदित्यै विष्णुपत्न्यै चरुं कायम् एककपालम् ॥
3.15.10.m: He offers an eight-pot-sherd cake for Agni associated with the gāyatrī, with the trivṛt, with the rathantara, with the spring; / an eleven-pot-sherd cake for Indra associated with the triṣṭubh, with the fifteenfold, with the bṛhat, with the summer; / a twelve-pot-sherd cake for the All-gods associated with the jagatī, with the seventeenfold, with the vairūpa, with the rainy season; / a milk-mess for Mitra and Varuṇa associated with the anuṣṭubh, with the twenty-onefold, with the vairāja, with the autumn; / a caru for Bṛhaspati associated with the paṅkti, with the twenty-sevenfold, with the śākvara, with the winter; / a twelve-pot-sherd cake for Savitṛ associated with the atichandas, with the thirty-threefold, with the raivata, with the cool season; / a caru for Anumati; / a twelve-pot-sherd [cake] for Vaiśvānara; / a caru for Aditi, the wife of Viṣṇu; / a one-pot-sherd [cake] for Ka.

3.15.11.s: agnaye 'ṃhomuce puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapatīndrāyāṃhomuce puroḍāśam ekādaśakapālaṃ mitrāvaruṇābhyām āgomugbhyāṃ payasyāṃ vāyusavitṛbhyām āgomugbhyāṃ payo 'śvibhyām āgomugbhyāṃ dhānā marudbhya enomugbhyaḥ puroḍāśaṃ saptakapālaṃ viśvebhyo devebhya enomugbhyaḥ puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālam anumatyai caruṃ vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ dyāvāpṛthivībhyām aṃhomugbhyāṃ puroḍāśaṃ dvikapālam || iti tṛtīyakāṇḍe pañcadaśamaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ ||
3.15.11.d: अग्नये ऽंहोमुचे पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपतीन्द्रायांहोमुचे पुरोडाशम् एकादशकपालं मित्रावरुणाभ्याम् आगोमुग्भ्यां पयस्यां वायुसवितृभ्याम् आगोमुग्भ्यां पयो ऽश्विभ्याम् आगोमुग्भ्यां धाना मरुद्भ्य एनोमुग्भ्यः पुरोडाशं सप्तकपालं विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्य एनोमुग्भ्यः पुरोडाशं द्वादशकपालम् अनुमत्यै चरुं वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालं द्यावापृथिवीभ्याम् अंहोमुग्भ्यां पुरोडाशं द्विकपालम् ॥ इति तृतीयकाण्डे पञ्चदशमः प्रपाठकः ॥
3.15.11.m:
He offers an eight-pot-sherd cake for Agni who frees from distress; / an eleven-pot-sherd cake for Indra who frees from distress; / a milk-mess for Mitra and Varuṇa who free from sin; / milk for Vāyu and Savitṛ who free from sin; / roasted barley for the Aśvins who free from sin; / a seven-pot-sherd cake for the Maruts who free from guilt; / a twelve-pot-sherd cake for the All-gods who free from guilt; / a caru for Anumati; a twelve-pot-sherd [cake] for Vaiśvānara; / a two-pot-sherd cake for Heaven and Earth who free from distress.
Thus ends the fifteenth prapāṭhaka in the third kāṇḍa.
